Two smocked bands divide the tiered skirt, with smaller embroidered motifs continuing into the lower tiers. Loose, fluid fit throughout. The embroidery and the fabric read as one colour story — the garnet sitting deep against the framboise base, tonal but with real contrast. Combined with Krishna flat sandals and Artemisa vest.

The embroidery is dense up front and loosens as it spreads across the shirt, which keeps it from feeling heavy. Wear tucked into tailored trousers or open over a camisole.

Long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Relaxed fit. The coral and ochre together feel sun-drenched without trying. Wear with the Simone Varanasi pant and Federica sandals. Web exclusive.

name: Kalinda Dress
description: Cotton maxi dress in soft powder blue with a geometric ikat-inspired print — repeating ogee motifs in white and dusty teal across the full length. Lightly quilted bodice with dense navy embroidery and small mirror details. Border band along the hem in the same navy thread. V-neckline with a button placket and tie detail. Sleeveless. Fluid, relaxed fit. Side pockets. The ikat geometry and the hand-worked embroidery are doing two very different things — and both land. Add the Giulietta flat leather sandals and a voile, you've got the look. Web exclusive.

name: Meera Blouse
description: Cotton blouse in soft powder blue with a geometric ikat-inspired print — repeating ogee motifs in white and dusty teal. V-neckline with a short button placket and dense navy floral embroidery framing the neckline and cuffs. Long sleeves. Relaxed fit. The embroidery follows the neckline like a collar — precise and detailed against the open geometry of the ikat. Wear with the Otto pant, Sikka belt, Afrodita sandals and your best silver. Web exclusive.

name: Celeste Dress
description: Cotton mini dress in deep black with a bold block-printed geometric pattern — repeating diamond and feather motifs in warm cream throughout, with dense border bands along the placket and hem. V-neckline with a short button placket. Long balloon sleeves that gather at the cuff. Loose, voluminous fit. The cream print on black is graphic and strong — the border bands frame it like a woodcut. Wear with bare legs and flat Krishna sandals.

name: Allan Scarf
description: Cotton gauze scarf in deep burgundy red with a dense all-over print — swirling paisley, floral and vine motifs in faded rose and dusty plum. Lightweight and semi-sheer. Wear loose around the neck, knotted at the waist as a belt, or tied in the hair.

name: Karma Pant
description: Wide-leg pant in striped cotton, soft blue with scattered white daisy embroidery across the fabric. High-rise waist with button and zip closure, front pleats. Embroidered border trim runs down both side seams. The blue sits somewhere between sky and chambray — muted, not bright. The stripe adds subtle texture without reading as pattern. Daisy embroidery is small and even, distributed across the leg. The side trim gives it a folkloric edge that feels more Rajasthan than resort. Worn here with the Virginia blouse and Malambo leather belt.

name: Ganga Tunic
description: V-neckline striped cotton midi tunic with tie cord and tassel detail, long wide sleeves with embroidered border at the cuff. Front panel densely embroidered — hearts, paisleys, scattered daisies — with a bordered pocket that sits below. Side slits at the hem. No closures, slips over the head. The blue is a washed sky — soft, faded, like it's been in the sun a few summers already. The striped cotton has natural texture that gives the embroidery depth — white thread against that quiet blue, the work is dense but the overall feel is light. Worn here with the Giulietta sandals.

name: Oriane Top
description: Sleeveless top in 100% cotton lace, warm off-white. Round neck with front button closure, vertical pin-tucks alternating with lace insertion panels running the full length of the top. Cropped length, sits at the waist. The white is soft and warm, not stark. Tight pin-tucks and open lace panels alternating — all texture and lightness, no print needed. Worn here with the Simone White Fuji pant and Edgar jacket.

name: Sienna Dress
description: Maxi dress in cotton dobby, warm white. Thin tie straps, straight neckline with ruffle trim and front button detail. Smocked bodice that fits close, then releases into a full tiered skirt with ruffle panels. Maxi length, low back. White that's lived-in, not laundered. Cotton dobby has a subtle woven texture — lightweight but with enough body that the skirt moves well without being sheer. Worn here with the Federica sandals.

name: Elvis Sleeveless Blouse
description: Sleeveless blouse in lightweight cotton with a tonal windowpane check. Smocked yoke across the chest with ruffle trim at the shoulders and neckline. Band collar, button-down front. The body gathers from the yoke and falls loose and full. Nuage is a soft off-white. The check is woven tone-on-tone so it reads as texture more than pattern. The smocking is dense and detailed, with small ruffled edges that give the shoulders shape without adding bulk. Cotton is fine and slightly sheer. Works with the Vincent Almond.

name: Paloma Shirt
description: Cotton shirt in deep cobalt blue with a bold all-over floral print. Large dahlia-like blooms in deep burgundy and dusty blush, with dark foliage throughout. Classic collar, button placket, gathered yoke at the shoulder. Long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Relaxed fit. The print is dense and saturated — the kind of blue that anchors everything around it. Combined here with Otto pant and Sikka belt. Web exclusive.

name: Maria Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Relaxed fit. Mixed print construction—vertical stripes on the body, contrasting block print at the yoke, collar, and cuffs. Teal and cream vertical stripes cover the body. Yoke, collar, and cuffs feature layered block print—dense floral motifs, geometric borders, and vine details in teal and cream. The mix feels collected, like different textiles brought together. Patterns meet at the shoulders and cuffs, grounding the stripes. Wear it buttoned low or tie it at the waist. Tuck it into high-waisted denim like Charlie or leave it loose.

name: Cristina Sleeveless Dress
description: Maxi dress in lightweight cotton. V-neckline, adjustable tie straps at shoulders, button-down front. Fitted bodice, gathered waist, tiered skirt. Turquoise and ivory vertical stripes with block print borders at the waist and hem. Turquoise and ivory stripes run through the body. Block print borders break the tiers—geometric vines and florals at the waist, denser floral motifs at the hem. The mix of stripe and print feels instinctive, like different textiles meeting naturally. Throw it on over a bikini or wear it out with sandals. Adjustable straps let you set the fit. Easy summer staple.

name: Constanza Top
description: Thin-strap ivory top in cotton stripe dobby with a lace panel front. V-neckline, finger-width straps. Drawstring tie at the waist. Cropped length. The stripe dobby gives the cotton a subtle woven texture, almost imperceptible. The lace panel covers the front—detailed but lightweight. The drawstring cinches at the waist and gives it shape. Layered under Edgar jacket with Charlie bleack denim. The lace does enough on its own, keep the rest simple.

name: Etta Sleeveless Dress
description: Maxi dress in lightweight cotton with subtle texture. Smocked bodice with button placket, adjustable spaghetti straps. Gathered waist, tiered skirt. Soft sky blue base with scattered cream embroidered motifs throughout. Soft sky blue—pale and airy, not bright. Small cream embroidered florals scattered across the entire dress. Smocked bodice creates texture and stretch, with buttons running down the center. The tiered skirt falls loose and easy. Cotton has gentle weight, breathable and soft. Throw it on with flat federica sandals or dress it up. Adjustable straps let you set the fit. Works for the beach or dinner after. Easy summer dress with character.

name: James Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton with subtle texture. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Smocked yoke with cream embroidery, balloon sleeves with elastic cuffs. Relaxed fit. Soft sky blue base. pale and airy, with scattered cream embroidered motifs throughout. Small cream embroidered florals scattered across the body. Smocked yoke creates texture and depth, with dense embroidery framing the shoulders. Balloon sleeves gather at the cuffs. Cotton has gentle weight, breathable and soft. Tuck it into high-waisted bleach Charlie jeans.

name: Paoli Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in cotton broderie anglaise. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Smocked yoke with lace detailing, balloon sleeves with elastic cuffs. Relaxed fit. Warm ivory with eyelet perforations throughout. Warm ivory, soft as old linen. Cotton broderie anglaise scattered across the body—small eyelet perforations that catch light. The smocked yoke adds depth and texture, framed with delicate lace. Balloon sleeves gather gently at the cuffs. Tuck it into your favorite Charlie´s. Our summer staple with soul.

name: Gino Dress
description: Maxi dress in cotton broderie anglaise with lace inserts. V-neckline with button placket running down the front, sleeveless. Fitted bodice with lace detailing at the chest and shoulders, gathered waist, tiered skirt with lace trim between each tier. Warm ivory with eyelet perforations throughout. Cotton broderie anglaise with small eyelet perforations scattered across the fabric—lets light and air through without feeling delicate. Lace inserts frame the bodice and run between the tiers, adding depth and craftsmanship. The bodice fits close, the skirt falls loose and tiered. Moves with you, breathes easy. Wear it to the beach over a bikini, take it to dinner with flat sandals, cinch it with a belt if you want. The kind of dress that works anywhere without trying. Easy summer staple.

name: Francesca Short Dress
description: Short dress in cotton with subtle texture and scattered eyelet details. Round neckline with button placket, long balloon sleeves with lace trim and button cuffs. Pintucked bodice with lace inserts running vertically, gathered waist, tiered ruffle hem with lace trim. Warm ivory throughout. Warm ivory that gets softer every time you wear it. Cotton with tiny scattered eyelets—light catches them just right. Pintucks and lace inserts run down the bodice like something from an old family photograph. Balloon sleeves with delicate lace at the cuffs. The waist sits easy, the hem flutters when you walk. Feels lived-in from day one. Throw it over your bikini straight from the beach, wear it to dinner with that one pair of sandals you never take off, add boots when summer fades.

name: Allegra Skirt
description: Maxi skirt in cotton with lace inserts. Elastic waist, tiered construction with lace trim between each tier. Soft white with textured details throughout—pintucks, lace bands, and broderie anglaise at the hem. Soft white cotton that feels lived-in from the start. Each tier is separated by delicate lace trim—horizontal bands that add depth without weight. Pintucks run vertically in places, broderie anglaise finishes the hem with a ruffle. The elastic waist sits easy, the tiers move with you. Light, breathable, gets softer every wash. Wear it with Camila if you're committing to full white-on-white summer energy. Works with Federica sandals, works barefoot.

name: Miguelon Pant
description: Flared pant in cotton broderie anglaise. High waist with side zip closure. Fitted through the thigh, flares from the knee to the floor. Soft white with eyelet perforations throughout—floral patterns scattered across the fabric. Soft white cotton with tiny eyelet florals punched through—the kind of detail you notice up close. Fitted where it matters, then lets go at the knee into a proper flare that skims the floor. The side zip keeps the waist clean and flat. Breathes like nothing, moves like everything. Wear it with the matching Irene blouse if you're committing to the look, or throw on your favorite tee and call it done. Combined with Afrodita sandals.

name: Luigi Dress
description: Maxi dress in cotton broderie anglaise. Halter neckline with lace ruffle collar, deep V-front, open back. Gathered waist, tiered skirt with lace trim between tiers. Soft white with eyelet perforations throughout. The halter ties at the back of your neck, lace ruffle frames your face. Deep V at the front, open back. Cotton broderie anglaise with tiny eyelet florals punched through—lets light and air move easy. Tiered skirt separated by delicate lace, each tier catching the breeze differently when you walk. Beach ceremonies, long lunches, summer nights when anything complicated feels wrong. Flat sandals and done.

name: Irene Blouse
description: Blouse in cotton broderie anglaise. Round neckline with lace ruffle collar, lace-up front with tassels. Long balloon sleeves with elastic cuffs. Relaxed, cropped fit. Soft white with eyelet perforations throughout—floral patterns scattered across the fabric. Soft white cotton covered in tiny eyelet florals—breathes easy, catches light. Round neck with a delicate lace ruffle collar, lace-up front with tassels you can adjust however loose or tight you want. Balloon sleeves gather at the cuffs. Cropped length hits right where high-waisted anything starts. Pair it with Miguelon pants for full commitment, or throw it on with your favorite denim, our Charlie´s.

name: Sita Pareo
description: Pareo in lightweight cotton. Rectangular wrap with embroidered borders along the edges and scattered embroidered motifs throughout. Soft aqua blue base with deep navy embroidery—floral patterns and geometric details. Tie it at the waist over a bikini, wrap it as a skirt for lunch by the water, use it as a beach blanket if the mood strikes. Does everything, asks for nothing. The kind of piece that lives in your beach bag all summer.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Pareo in lightweight cotton. Rectangular wrap with horizontal stripe patterns throughout—geometric bands, ikat motifs, dotted textures. Warm clay, cream, navy, and rust tones. Each band feels like a different textile tradition stitched together. Light, breathable, wraps and ties however you want it. Tie it at the waist over a bikini, wrap it as a skirt for wandering around, throw it over your shoulders when the sun gets too much. The kind of piece that works everywhere—beach, market, dinner. Lives in your bag all summer.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Cotton pareo with fine crinkle texture. Block-printed in a bold chevron pattern — wide zigzag bands alternating between mint green and deep fuchsia, filled with small dotted and floral motifs, with a border band along the hem. Wraps and ties at the waist; midi length. Graphic and summery. Wear over a swimsuit knotted at the hip.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Cotton pareo with fine crinkle texture. Block-printed in a bold chevron wave pattern — alternating bands of turquoise and warm sand, filled with dense floral and paisley motifs in the same tones. Solid turquoise border along the hem. Wraps and ties at the waist; midi length. Graphic and summery. Wear over a swimsuit, knotted at the hip.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Pareo in lightweight cotton. Rectangular wrap with horizontal stripe patterns throughout—geometric bands, ikat motifs, flowers in ivory and moustard color over a bright red base. Wraps and ties at the waist; midi length. Graphic and summery. Worn as a dress.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Cotton pareo with fine crinkle texture. Block-printed in warm sand with a large central diamond in dark aubergine, trailing vines and leaves in charcoal, garnet florals, and scattered paisley motifs. Chevron and border bands frame the edges in the same deep tones. Wraps and ties at the waist. The print layers multiple motifs that read as one bold graphic from a distance — the kind of block-print work that reveals itself slowly. Worn over two bandanas knotted as a top.

name: Samba Pareo
description: Cotton pareo in indigo blue. Block-printed with a repeated floral medallion motif in faded off-white — each motif slightly irregular, the way hand-applied print always is. The fabric has a fine horizontal crinkle texture that gives it natural body without stiffness. Wear it as a skirt over a swimsuit or with a simple top, knotted at the hip or wrapped straight. One of those pieces that works on the beach and off it.

name: Manuela Dress
description: Button-down midi dress in a soft paisley print. Fitted waistband that defines the silhouette, opening into a gently flared skirt with natural movement. Short sleeves keep it light and easy for everyday wear. Styled here with our Mies khaki sandals.

name: Pua Shirt
description: Cotton short sleeve shirt in warm ivory with a bold all-over floral print — large blooms and trailing vines in coral, lavender, powder blue and sage. Contrast blue striped placket and collar. Coconut buttons. Short cap sleeves. Relaxed, slightly oversized fit. The contrast stripe placket against the floral print is the detail that makes it — structured against loose, graphic against painterly. Wear tucked into the Cher jeans.

name: Moana Shirt
description: Cotton shirt in soft blue with a fine woven stripe. Classic collar, button placket, long sleeves with buttoned cuffs. Large contrast panel across the front — a fluid, asymmetric placement of embroidered floral fabric in dusty pink, lavender, coral and sage on a muted champagne ground. Relaxed, slightly oversized fit. The print panel sits like a scarf draped across the shirt — unexpected and effortless. Combined here with Pika pants and Sikka belt.

name: Mary Shirt
description: Cotton lurex shirt in warm ivory with a repeating medallion print — large oval bouquets of dusty rose florals framed by teal leaf sprigs, scattered across the fabric. Classic collar, button placket. Long balloon sleeves with gathered yoke at the back. Relaxed fit. The lurex runs through the fabric as a fine metallic thread, barely visible in daylight. Paired here with Otto Maiden pants, Afrodita sandals and Malambo belt.

name: Anne Dress
description: Cotton lurex maxi dress with long balloon sleeves that gather at the cuff. Deep V-neckline with button placket running the full length. Elasticated waist that gathers the fabric and defines the silhouette without a belt. Tiered skirt with volume and side pockets. Block-printed all over with a repeating oval medallion — rose clusters framed by teal and sage leaf borders on warm ivory. The lurex runs through the fabric as a fine metallic thread, subtle in daylight and more visible in the evening. The print has a Mughal textile reference — formal in its structure, softened by the dusty rose and muted teal tones. Wear open over a slip or buttoned up. Krishna flat sandals or nothing at all.

name: Edgar Bandana
description: Cotton bandana in warm ivory with the Gordon Roses block-print — scattered deep rose clusters and brown-toned leaves. Lightweight and slightly sheer, with a fine contrast stitch along the edges. Wear tied in the hair, or around the neck.

name: Zara Sleeveless Dress
description: Cotton maxi dress with thin straps and a fully smocked bodice — the shirring runs from neckline to waist, fitted through the torso and releasing into a tiered, full-length skirt. Small buttons down the front center of the bodice. Gordon Roses block-print in warm ivory with scattered deep rose clusters and brown-toned leaves. The smocking gives stretch and shape without structure — fits close without feeling fitted. The skirt has enough volume to move. Wear with our Afrodita flat sandals or bare feet.

name: Angus Pant
description: Wide-leg linen trouser in warm blush sand. Block-printed all over with a scattered floral motif — clusters of deep rose blooms and brown-toned leaves that sit evenly across the fabric without feeling busy. High waist with button and zip closure, front pleats, side pockets. Wide leg that grazes the floor. The linen has a natural slub texture that gives the print depth and keeps the overall feel relaxed rather than polished. Wear with a simple fitted top and our Nehru Jacket. Works well with boots or our Krishna sandals.

name: Federica Sandals
description: Dark, grounded, made to move. Black leather straps cross with quiet confidence—no embellishments, no distractions, just raw simplicity. Fitted to move fast and stay on. Slightly worn-in, forever reliable. The kind of sandals that stay with you—through cities, through summers, through stories yet to be written.

name: Krishna Sandals
description: The Krishna Sandal in Amristar Tobacco. Rooted in Indian heritage and crafted with timeless care, the Krishna Sandals in Amristar Tobacco are a vintage treasure reimagined for the modern world. Made from rich, supple brown leather, these sandals feature intricate hand-braided details, a testament to artisanal craftsmanship passed down through generations. Their worn-in, tactile appeal speaks of journeys taken and stories lived—sophisticated yet grounded, these sandals feel like something discovered in a hidden Marketplace.

name: Krishna Sandals
description: Rooted in Indian heritage and crafted with timeless care, the Krishna Sandals in Amristar Black are a vintage treasure reimagined for the modern world. Made from rich, supple black leather, these sandals feature intricate hand-braided details, a testament to artisanal craftsmanship passed down through generations. Their worn-in, tactile appeal speaks of journeys taken and stories lived—sophisticated yet grounded, these sandals feel like something discovered in a hidden Marketplace.

name: Giulietta Sandals
description: Rooted in tradition, built to outlast the fight. 100% leather, rich brown like old Verona’s stone walls, worn smooth by time. The braided front strap—strong, interwoven, unyielding—holds its ground, much like the Montesco name. The ankle strap fastens with quiet certainty, a reminder that some things are meant to stay in place. Finished with a soft suede sole, grounding each step in quiet luxury.

name: Giulietta Sandals
description: Stripped back, nothing excess. 100% black leather, sleek, grounded, made to move. The braided strap adds structure, the suede sole softens with every step. The ankle strap locks in place—secure but never stiff. Made for walking fast, standing firm, disappearing when needed. No frills, no fuss—just a damn good sandal.

name: Mies Sandals
description: Less talk, more walk. 100% leather, lean, stripped to the bone—just enough to hold on. A single strap, an effortless wrap, the kind of design that disappears until you realize you’ve never taken them off. Deep khaki, like sun-faded canvas, worn by time, built for movement. No weight, no noise—just the feeling of going somewhere.

name: Afrodita Sandals
description: A bold nod to ancient elegance, the Afrodita Sandals in tapenade black are a modern take on classic gladiator-inspired design. Crafted from supple black leather, their multi-strap construction exudes strength and sophistication while offering a snug, secure fit. The minimalist buckle closure at the ankle completes the silhouette, combining timeless charm with everyday functionality. Evocative of Mediterranean shores and historic streets, these sandals bring a sense of drama and purpose to every step. Hand-finished details and a robust yet refined structure make them as enduring as they are versatile.

name: Simone Pant
description: Wide-leg pant in a dark cotton base — near-black, flat, grounding. Hand-embroidered florals break through at the waistband and ankles in concentrated bursts of red, yellow, blue, and green. The rest stays clean. High waist, side pockets. The embroidery is dense where it lands but doesn't cover the whole surface — it hits at the edges and lets the dark ground do the rest. Styled with Varanasi Rainbow Vest or Ringo shirt.

name: Artemisa Vest
description: Our vest is named after Artemisa, a symbol of wild nature and feminine independence. Woven cotton canvas brings structure and weight, marked by embroidered florals and mirrored details that read like ritual signs. Colour breaks through a deep, washed black base with intention — charged, symbolic, never decorative. Worn against bare skin, layered with ease, or paired with the matching Simone Pant for a look that feels complete. Here combined with Samba Pareo. Dog not included.

name: Cleo Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in cotton slub gauze with scattered embroidery across the body. Multicolor floral embroidery at the neckline and placket. Relaxed, fluid fit. Off-white base. The cotton is soft and breathable with a natural slub texture—slightly irregular, not perfectly smooth. Gently washed so it drapes easily without losing shape. The embroidery adds color and detail without weighing it down—intricate but light. Here paired with Charlie dark denim and Sikka belt.

name: Rani Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Cut from the signature shirt pattern—soft, breathable, falls naturally on the body. Easy structure, familiar fit. Deep black base with henna-inspired print. Floral forms and abstract markings that feel hand-drawn rather than repeated. Borders and scattered elements create rhythm across the surface—organic and expressive without overloading it. The print has depth and movement. Wear it buttoned up for a graphic look or leave it open and layer it. Works with jeans, works with trousers. Dark and quietly expressive. Paired here with Marina pant, Malambo belt and Mies sandals.

name: Eleonora Dress
description: Shirt dress in lightweight cotton gauze. Collared, button-down front running full length, long sleeves with button cuffs. Drawstring at the waist to cinch or leave loose. Soft, fluid fall that moves easily around the body. Deep black base with henna-inspired motifs—inked symbols rather than prints. Central forms echo leaves, bodies, and calligraphic strokes, balanced and almost symmetrical with Japanese restraint and precision. The contrast reads graphic and ritualistic, more mark than decoration. Wear it loose for a long, uninterrupted line or cinch the waist for definition. Works with flat sandals or boots.

name: Simone Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in soft cotton with layered indigo floral print. High waist with button and zip closure, two front pockets. Relaxed through the leg with natural fall. Cotton fluid and easy, designed for movement. Indigo print runs in layered shades of blue—peony florals blend into smaller repeating motifs. Pattern dense and rhythmic, feels immersive rather than decorative. Indigo tones anchor the look, give depth and serenity. Wear it with the matching Ayako shirt or pair with denim shirt like we did with Thelma. Works with sandals or boots.

name: Ayako Shirt
description: Short-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton voile. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Soft, fluid hand that moves naturally with the body. Breathable and calm. Indigo print with layered blues—peony florals within smaller repeating motifs. The composition feels continuous, like vegetation along a long path. Indigo tones bring depth and stillness, making the florals feel part of the landscape rather than decoration. Works great with our Lucky jeans.

name: Tito Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in soft cotton with woven stripes and delicate embroidery down the leg. Low-rise waist, relaxed fit through the leg. Cotton light and breathable, fluid and close to the body. Red Sea is deep burgundy, sun-warmed and rich. Subtle woven stripes and embroidery trace the leg, reference Bedouin textiles. Fit relaxed yet feminine, falls softly with movement and rhythm. Wear it low on the waist with bare skin or pair with the matching vest or light blouse. Works with sandals or boots.

name: Petra Vest
description: Cropped vest in textured yarn-dyed cotton stripes with white and blue embroidery. Round neckline, button-front closure. Dense embroidery across the front—symbolic motifs and vertical bands. Cotton stripes have dry, substantial hand, built to hold shape. Red Sea is deep burgundy with vertical dark stripes. White and blue embroidery creates graphic rhythm across the surface. Motifs feel like protective marks, intentional rather than decorative. Rooted in nomadic craft tradition. Combined with Javiera shirt and Gilberto pants.

name: Freya Dress
description: Lightweight cotton midi dress. Collared shirt-dress silhouette, button-down front running full length, long sleeves with button cuffs. Tie at the waist to cinch or leave loose. S oft, fluid feel that falls straight and moves with ease. Deep saturated indigo base with white floral lines running continuously across the fabric. The pattern is graphic and understated—more about rhythm than ornament. Flowers feel sketched and slightly irregular, giving the dress character without softening it. Wear it cinched for definition or relaxed and open. Works with flat sandals or boots. Clean, fluid, understated.

name: Simone Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in soft cotton with white floral line print on deep indigo base. High waist with button and zip closure, two front pockets. Relaxed drape through the leg. Cotton light and breathable, worn-in feel from the first wear. Deep indigo base crossed by white floral lines—graphic and direct. Print bold but controlled, more about contrast than decoration. Flowers appear tangled and irregular, give the pant edge. Combined with Ringo shirt and Sikka belt. Works with sandals or boots.

name: Mina Sleeveless Shirt
description: Sleeveless shirt in lightweight cotton. Classic collar, button-down front. Soft gathering at the shoulders creates volume. Relaxed, effortless silhouette. Soft, breathable, easy drape that moves naturally. Indigo base printed with all-over ivory floral vine motif—washed, artisanal feel. The gathering at the shoulders adds soft volume without bulk. Designed to blouse slightly when tucked or fall loose for an undone look. Wear it with eyelet whites, like Theodore. Tuck it in or leave it loose. A summer staple with quiet character.

name: Allan Scarf
description: Cut in lightweight cotton, the deep indigo base is marked with white floral lines that run freely across the surface. Graphic and fluid, the print feels drawn rather than decorative. Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Simone Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in lightweight cotton with soft washed finish. High waist with button and zip closure, two front pockets. Relaxed and fluid through the leg. Cotton breathable and gentle, falls naturally without resistance. White Fuji is calm milky off-white, closer to cream than bright white. Clean and understated, lets texture and silhouette lead. Quiet structure gives shape without rigidity. Wear it with matching Sake story pieces or pair with simple layers like Oriane top.

name: Cleo Blouse
description: Cotton voile blouse — light, slightly textured, with natural transparency. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. The fabric is washed soft and sits away from the body rather than on it. Pale chalky white base with indigo floral lines, loose and irregular. Darker indigo print at the yoke, placket, and cuffs — enough contrast to anchor the lighter ground. The mix of patterns feels unplanned, like layers added over time rather than matched on purpose. Styled with Mizu pant and Criollo belt.

name: Allan Scarf
description: Cut in lightweight cotton, the chalky base is marked with navy floral lines that run freely across the surface. Graphic and fluid, the print feels spontaneous and irregular. Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Masako Jacket
description: Jacket in cotton slub. Round neck, button-down front, long sleeves, patch pockets at the front. Clean, relaxed silhouette that sits easily on the body and layers without effort. Hand-painted motifs scattered across the surface. Cotton slub brings natural irregularity and softness—depth and subtle lived-in feel. White Funji is a softened white, luminous and calm rather than crisp. Hand-painted motifs add an artisanal, instinctive gesture that stands out quietly against the base. Here layered over Otto pant night blue. Tactile, expressive, made to be worn often.

name: Karina Sleeveless Shirt
description: Sleeveless blouse in cotton. Lace panels at the shoulders. Sits close to the body without being tight. Deep, almost inky blue base—heavy in color but light in feel. Tiny white embroidered marks scattered across the surface, irregular and spaced like traces rather than pattern. They break the depth of the blue without softening it. Lace panels at the shoulders add texture and tension, not decoration. Wear it with Simone pant. Holds its ground next to stronger pieces.

name: Otto Pant
description: Straight-leg pant in cotton-linen mix. Sits softly at the waist with subtle pleats at the front. Straight fall through the leg. Button and zip closure, side pockets and back pockets. Embroidered detailing along the hem and pockets. Airy cotton-linen blend moves with natural fluidity—structure without stiffness, comfort without losing shape. The pleats add volume and ease of movement. Embroidery at the hem and pockets is quiet and tactile, refined rather than decorative. Here paired with Piti blouse. Works with flat sandals or espadrilles. Made for warm air and long hours under the sun.

name: Otelo Jacket
description: Lightweight linen jacket with cotton lace inserts. Round collar, open button-front closure, long sleeves, two side pockets. Soft yet structured silhouette that sits naturally on the body. Delicate lace traces the edges and seams with precision and restraint. Ivory linen, lightweight and breathable. Cotton lace inserts add texture and depth, not decoration—a reminder of traditional techniques and hand-finished work. The lace follows the construction lines, speaking of time and patience rather than ornament. Layer it over dresses or simple tops. Works with jeans or linen trousers. Here combined with Constanza and Otto matching pant.

name: Virginia Blouse
description: Relaxed blouse in cotton-linen blend with delicate embroidered details. Classic collar, button-down front, long sleeves with gentle volume. Cotton-linen breathable and fresh, natural texture improves with wear. Ivory Whisper is soft cream, brings calm and clarity. Embroidered details add quiet interest without taking over. Relaxed fit with clean shape. Wear it tucked into high-waisted Pepe pants. Works on its own or layered.

name: Otto Pant
description: Named after Edgar Degas, this Otto pant reflects the impressionist fascination with light, movement and everyday moments. Cut in fluid cotton-linen, with a relaxed drape, it falls naturally along the leg, creating a silhouette that feels calm and refined. The deep night blue recalls a Parisian summer evening — a dark sky touched by distant lights, the quiet hum of the city after sunset. Delicate embroidered details appear like fleeting impressions, echoing Degas’ way of capturing atmosphere rather than precision. Paired here with Blanca blouse and Criollo belt. The standard Otto measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Otto Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Edgar Jacket
description: Inspired by Edgar Degas’ poetic view of daily life, Edgard Jacket brings an artistic sensibility into the everyday wardrobe. Light in structure and easy in fit. Its deep blue tone evokes evenings spent in Paris — museum visits as the light fades, followed by long walks through Montmartre under a darkening sky. The jacket feels weightless yet present, designed to layer naturally and adapt to the rhythm of the day. A piece that connects art, movement and modern wearability — subtle, expressive and quietly luminous. Combined here with Irene blouse and Pike pant.

name: Otto Pant
description: Inspired by Edgar Degas’ years in New Orleans in the 1870s, a period marked by a slower, more introspective rhythm. The city, deeply rooted in the cotton trade, shaped this calmer chapter — slower days, intellectual focus, and a closer connection to material and place. Crafted from a cotton and linen blend, The soft blush tone feels muted and thoughtful, a counterpoint to the intensity of Night Blue. Relaxed in fit and fluid in movement, this pant is about simplicity and balance — understated, grounded, and quietly refined. Here combined with Pua shirt. The standard Otto measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Otto Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Edgar Jacket
description: Inspired by Edgar Degas’ family life in New Orleans, this jacket reflects a quieter, more intimate chapter of the artist’s story. Far from Paris, his time there was shaped by routine, tradition, and the simple rituals of everyday life. Crafted from a cotton and linen blend, the Edgar Jacket feels natural and breathable, designed to be worn with ease and to age beautifully over time. The antique blush tone adds warmth and softness, evoking sunlit summer days and a sense of calm continuity. Here combined with Constanza top and Charlie bleach denims.

name: Otto Pant
description: Straight-leg pant in cotton-linen blend. Relaxed through the leg with natural straight fall. Sits comfortably at the waist with pleats at the front. Button and zip closure, side pockets and back pockets. Breathable cotton-linen combines lightness with quiet structure—easy on the body while holding shape. Unforced drape that moves naturally. Moss is an earthy green with muted, mineral undertone, softly washed as if shaped by time, light, and air. The standard Otto measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Otto Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Otto Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in pale dusty blue cotton-linen blend. Mid-rise waist with button and zip closure, two front pockets. Relaxed through the leg with straight fall. Breathable fabric combines lightness with structure. Maiden is pale dusty blue with cool undertone—calm, washed, slightly worn-in. Cotton-linen blend feels easy on the body while holding shape. Unforced drape, natural movement. Paired here with Mary shirt and Malambo belt. The standard Otto measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Otto Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Dada Shirt
description: Relaxed shirt in fine cotton dobby. Collared, button-down front, long sleeves with button cuffs. Pajama-inspired silhouette, easy and carefree. Designed to be worn without rules. Light blue base with vertical wine-colored stripes—warm and deep, relaxed rather than polished. Draws from vintage pajama shirts and inherited pieces. The stripes feel intimate and familiar, like fabric borrowed from another time. Throw it over a bikini after a day at the beach, pair it with a pareo, or wear it with jeans. Works loose and unbuttoned or styled however you want. Salt in your hair optional.

name: Poe Bandana
description: Cut in lightweight cotton dobby, echoing vintage washed red pajama lines and traditional sailor stripes, blending the ease of beachwear with the familiarity of inherited pieces Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Loretta Jacket
description: Denim jacket in sturdy yet supple denim. Button-front closure, two side pockets. Slightly puffed sleeves with embroidered cuffs. Structured but relaxed fit that sits comfortably on the shoulders with ease of movement. Lived-in feel from the first wear. Washed blue denim with weight but not stiffness. The sleeves have volume but stay structured, not soft. Embroidery at the cuffs adds detail without excess—strong, practical, effortlessly cool. Layer it over dresses, shirts, or bare skin. Works both with Charlie jeans or printed pieces.

name: Amelia Dress
description: Washed cotton denim, soft from the start — no breaking in needed. Long shirt dress with a full button-down front, collar, long sleeves with button cuffs. Removable self-tie belt that lets the silhouette go loose or cinch at the waist. Ivory embroidery at the yoke and cuffs. Enough detail to lift the denim, not enough to compete with it. The fabric is light, fluid, closer to a worn-in chambray than stiff denim. Works with boots, works with flat sandals. A dress that runs on autopilot.

name: Thelma Shirt
description: Thelma Shirt is part of our Arizona denim story — a tribute to open landscapes, slow mornings, and clothes made to be lived in. Cut in soft denim with a worn-in feel, it carries that sun-faded attitude of pieces that have seen long days outdoors. The shape is relaxed and easy, designed to move with the body rather than sit stiffly on it. Rusty white embroidery details at shoulders and cuffs are subtle but intentional, giving the shirt a quiet strength that feels both feminine and grounded. Arizona denim is about freedom and instinct. Dust on your boots, hair tangled by the wind. Here combined with Simone pant and Malambo belt.

name: Gilberto Pant
description: The Gilberto Pant in Folklorique draws from tradition reimagined through movement and travel. Inspired by folk garments and regional dress, it carries the feeling of pieces discovered along the way — worn, collected, and naturally folded into everyday life. There’s a sense of wandering woven into it. Cut in a soft cream base, the pant is grounded and calm, allowing the embroidered details at the waist and hems to stand out with quiet extravagance. Deep, folkloric tones frame the silhouette, adding character and contrast without overpowering the ease of the fit. Here combined with Javiera Shirt and Krishna Sandals.

name: Antonella Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in soft cotton with red poppy embroidery. Round neckline with V-opening, button cuffs. Relaxed, effortless silhouette. Inspired by traditional Ukrainian blouses. Off-white base with bold red poppy embroidery framing the neckline and cuffs. The embroidery cuts through the soft cotton with graphic strength—precise and emotional at the same time. The silhouette stays simple, letting the embroidery do the work. Wear it tucked into Charlie jeans.

name: Freya Dress
description: Unstructured shirt dress in the same hand-dyed mineral green as the Rani. Long sleeves, full length, no shaping — the fabric falls straight and the tie-dye does more with the extra surface. The colour shifts between translucent and saturated depending on how the light hits. Small all-over embroidered motifs across the surface, same as the shirt, giving the loose silhouette some grip. Without them it would drift — with them it holds together. Each piece is unique due to the handcrafted tie-dye process. Slight variations in tone and pattern are part of it.

name: Rani Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in a hand-dyed mineral green. The tie-dye moves between translucent and saturated — no two pieces land in exactly the same place. Small all-over embroidered motifs across the surface give the colour something to hold onto. The base is loose and reactive, the detail is tight and repeated. That contrast is what makes it work — raw colour kept in check by structure. Each piece is unique due to the handcrafted tie-dye process. Slight variations in tone and pattern are part of it. Here combined with Theodore pant and Sikka Belt.

name: Freya Dress
description: Freya carries colour as depth and density across a long, fluid silhouette. Cut as an unstructured, long-sleeved shirt dress, it falls freely on the body, allowing the tie-dye to shift and settle with movement. The garnet-toned base moves through rich, saturated layers, like pigment pressed into fabric by heat and time. Small all-over motifs anchor the surface, giving rhythm and balance to the intensity of the wine colour. Due to the handcrafted tie-dye technique, each piece is unique and slight variations in colour may occur.

name: Rani Shirt
description: Long-sleeve collared blouse in tie-dyed cotton with small all-over motifs. Button-down front, classic collar. Tie-dye base moves through deep garnet tones—rich, saturated, grounded warmth. Small motifs anchor the surface, give rhythm to the intensity. Rani Granate is deep garnet with layered pigment, feels mineral and dense. Handcrafted tie-dye technique means each piece is unique, slight color variations occur. Cotton soft and breathable. Tuck it into high-waisted pants like Lirio or wear it loose. Works on its own or layered.

name: Poe Bandana
description: Our soft garnet color tie-dye bandana where colour settles like pigment in water — fluid, instinctive, and quietly expressive. Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Rani Shirt
description: Long-sleeve collared blouse in tie-dyed cotton with small all-over motifs. Button-down front, classic collar. Tie-dye base moves through sapphire blues—shifts between intensity and transparency. Small motifs punctuate the surface, give structure and rhythm. Rani Zafiro is deep sapphire blue with layered pigment, feels cool yet vibrant. Handcrafted tie-dye technique means each piece is unique, slight color variations occur. Cotton soft and breathable. Tuck it into Cher Pant. Works on its own or layered.

name: Rani Shirt
description: Long-sleeve collared blouse in tie-dyed cotton with small all-over motifs. Button-down front, classic collar. Tie-dye base moves through salmon-toned coral—sun-warmed, mineral, light-charged. Small motifs soften and balance the intensity. Rani Coral is warm coral with layered pigment, vibrant yet composed. Handcrafted tie-dye technique means each piece is unique, slight color variations occur. Cotton soft and breathable. Tuck it into high-waisted Charlie pants or wear it loose. Works on its own or layered.

name: Treasure Vest
description: Our Halo Moon vest is conceived as an artisanal talisman. A piece rich with mirrorwork and embroidery, designed to be worn close and kept over time — not seasonal, but personal. The surface catches and reflects light softly, like moonlight breaking across water. Light aqua brings a sense of calm luminosity, echoing night reflections, travel, and quiet ritual. Each mirror feels intentional, protective, almost symbolic — less decoration, more meaning. This is a vest as an amulet: bohemian in spirit, spiritual without excess. A starting point for a personal archive of pieces collected through life.

name: Yamato Vest
description: Quilted vest in a soft cherry-blossom pink — named after the Japanese tradition of pausing to watch the flowers. The fabric has a matte, powdery finish, warm but muted, nothing sugary. Tailored cut borrowed from menswear, with reversed buttoning. The fit is structured through the shoulders and chest, with clean lines that sit closer to the body than the Mia. Artisanal quilting throughout, detailed and even. Hanami layers over dresses, over shirts, over knits — here paired with Louise Wild Iris. A vest with enough presence to anchor a look and enough restraint to let everything else breathe.

name: Mia Vest
description: Our quilted vest in a saturated pink — closer to peony than bubblegum, rich without being sweet. The colour is the point. Generous volume, soft structure. The quilting adds body and texture, keeping the shape rounded and padded without stiffness. Collarless, open front, cropped enough to work over dresses and looser layers. Here styled with Anne dress and our furry friend.

name: Piti Shirt
description: Relaxed shirt in cotton with fine stripe and floral print. Classic collar, button-down front, chest pocket, long sleeves with soft cuffs. Inspired by pyjama silhouettes. Fine stripes act as backdrop, florals emerge naturally across the fabric. Hulton Soul feels intimate and close to the skin—balanced and lived-in. Print expressive without excess, absorbed into the fabric rather than placed on top. Cotton soft and easy. Wear it loose, open or buttoned. Tuck it into Otto pant or leave it out. Works on its own or layered.

name: Vicky Dress
description: Long-sleeve shirt dress in cotton with stripe and floral print. Classic collar, button-down front, self-tie lace at waist. Soft washed black stripes run through the fabric, bold floral motifs scattered across. Print flows uninterrupted along the body. Hulton Soul feels instinctive and lived-in—stripes and florals meet in fluid composition. Cotton soft and easy. Self-tie at waist adjusts the fit—wear it loose or cinched. Wear it on its own with boots or sandals. Belt it tighter or leave it loose.

name: Pepe Pant
description: The Hulton Soul print comes alive on the Pepe Pant through a layered dialogue of stripes and florals. Vertical washed black lines form a quiet, almost faded structure, while oversized blooms drift across the surface with instinctive placement — imperfect, expressive, alive. Cut with a long, flattering silhouette and a wide leg, the fit enhances movement and gives the print space to breathe. There’s a tension between order and spontaneity: graphic stripes grounding the composition as florals break free, bursting with vivid colour — flashes of red, inky tones and deep greens — like nature slowly reclaiming its space. Paired with Virginia blouse and Malambo belt. Nehru jacket added for layering.

name: Nuca Scarf
description: Fine washed black stripes and painterly blooming florals collide at a smaller scale, making the contrasts feel sharper and more graphic. Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Piti Shirt
description: Relaxed shirt in cotton with bold floral print over fine stripes. Classic collar, button-down front, chest pocket, long sleeves. Pajama-inspired silhouette. Florals layered and full, stripes barely contain the energy. Bolton Soul in rouge—warm, bold, instinctive. Print feels alive and rhythmic. Cotton soft and easy, relaxed fit tempers the intensity. Wear it loose, open or buttoned. Tuck it into Cher pants or leave it out.

name: Beatrice Dress
description: The Bolton Soul print takes on a vivid, expansive presence on the Beatrice Shirt Dress. Stripes and florals stretch across the body in a continuous flow, creating movement and depth with every step. In Rouge, the print feels radiant and full-bodied. Colour blooms freely, grounded just enough by linear elements to keep balance. Fully buttoned down and adjustable at the waist with a self-tie lace, the dress plays between classic form and expressive surface.

name: Lucas Blouse
description: The Bolton Soul print is presented here in its most direct form. Without sleeves, the pattern sits closer to the body, allowing colour and scale to take focus. Florals appear fuller and more saturated, set against a subtle striped red base that brings structure and rhythm. Finished with a buttoned front and a clean collar, the blouse balances graphic impact with a controlled silhouette. A strong, wearable piece where print leads and form follows. Paired with Pika pant and Sikka belt.

name: Nuca Scarf
description: Fine washed red stripes and painterly blooming florals collide at a smaller scale, making the contrasts feel sharper and more graphic. Meant to be worn with nonchalance — as a foulard, a top, a belt or knotted at the collar. Less about finishing a look, more about attitude, movement and the mood it creates.

name: Gus Jacket
description: Stone-washed aubergine base jacket with dense embroidery—looping florals, curling vines, small geometric echoes. Fuchsia pinks and warm oranges glow against the darker ground, lifted by citron yellow and balanced by greyed blue and cool green threads. The embroidery is tactile, almost architectural, yet softened by hand. Each stitch is intentional. The contrast between the deep base and luminous embroidery gives the jacket weight and presence. Expressive, lived-in, quietly powerful. Combined with Otto moss pant.

name: Akash Jacket
description: Cropped open-front jacket in ivory cotton, fully embroidered in tonal threads — warm sand, chalk, pale linen. The embroidery is raised, almost relief-like, covering the entire surface. Same structure as the work disappearing into itself: you see texture before you see pattern. Floral and geometric motifs across every panel, rounded and dense, blending into each other rather than standing apart. All hand-stitched, all slow. The tonal palette keeps it quiet — this is a piece that reads as one colour from a distance and reveals its detail up close. Collarless, no closure, boxy cut that hits above the hip. Constanza layers over white, over linen, over anything neutral.

name: Pati Jacket
description: Cropped open-front jacket in deep indigo, fully embroidered in ivory, soft teal, and washed ink. The coverage is total — geometric panels, floral motifs, chain-stitch borders — all hand-worked across every surface. No base fabric showing through. The palette stays tonal and muted, nothing bright. Collarless, unlined, boxy through the shoulders with a slightly wider sleeve. The cut is simple because the surface does everything. Hits just above the hip, clean edge, no closure. Pati goes over a simple top and Cher jeans and that's enough. The jacket is the outfit.

name: Arbind Blouse
description: Button-down blouse in soft ivory cotton with broderie anglaise detailing. Classic collar with eyelet embroidery at the yoke, long sleeves with scalloped eyelet cuffs, scalloped hem with daisy motifs worked into the fabric. Buttons all the way down the front. V-neckline that sits just right. The broderie is punch-work—small perforations creating floral patterns that let light through. Traditional technique but not fussy. The ivory is warm, not stark white. Cotton that breathes. Worn loose over our Charlie light denim.

name: Arbind Blouse
description: Button-down blouse in soft light blue cotton with broderie anglaise detailing. Classic collar with eyelet embroidery at the yoke, long sleeves with scalloped eyelet cuffs, scalloped hem with daisy motifs worked into the fabric. Buttons all the way down the front. V-neckline that sits just right. The broderie is punch-work—small perforations creating floral patterns that let light through. Traditional technique but not fussy. The blue is soft and washed, not bright. Cotton that breathes. Tuck it into our Tito pant.

name: Thalia Vest
description: Cropped vest in off-white cotton handloom jacquard with raised floral pattern. Round neckline, wooden buttons down the front, finished with a ruffle peplum at the hem. Sleeveless, hits just above the natural waist. The jacquard weave creates texture—roses and florals worked into the fabric rather than printed on top. Handloom cotton means slight variations in the weave, part of the process. The merengue shade is soft and warm, not stark white. Here layered over Vicky dress.

name: Alba Dress
description: Long dress in cotton patchwork with vertical panels. Button-down front running full length, long sleeves with subtle embroidery at the cuffs. Fluid, relaxed fit that falls easily from the body. Pale contrasts and softened greys—faded checks, small scattered motifs, washed panels that meet gently. The patchwork moves vertically, panel by panel, creating natural rhythm. The embroidery on the sleeves is subtle, almost like a trace. More memory than decoration. Wear it buttoned up and composed, or loosen it as the day warms. Works with flat sandals or boots. The patchwork does the work. Total length of the dress is 140 cm.

name: Cosette Skirt
description: Long tiered skirt in soft cotton patchwork. Elasticated waistband at the back, button-down front running center length. Fluid, easy sway with each tier. Moves gently, never precious. Pale, worn ash tone—hushed and lived-in, like fabric brushed by light rather than dyed. Panels of small checks and delicate motifs come together in gentle rhythm, each one slightly different. The patchwork feels assembled slowly, like margins filled in over time. Wear it with simple tops like Zhou or tucked blouses. Works with flat sandals or boots.

name: Noemi Blouse
description: A patchwork shirt in milky whites, pale greys, and faded ink tones — nothing sharp, nothing defined. Small repeated motifs across the body, fine checks along the sleeves, a central panel in a cooler stone shade that holds the rest together. Black embroidery runs vertically down the front. Delicate but graphic, it cuts through the soft palette and gives the shirt its edge. The colours are muted, powdery, the kind that look better after a few washes than before. Cut loose through the body. Sleeves to push up, buttons to fasten or leave open. Worn into denim, layered under knits — Noemi doesn't ask for much attention, it just works. Here combined with Otto Ivory and Malambo belt.

name: Elta Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in cotton. Collared, button-down front with ruffles along the button line. Lace inserts and fine stitching throughout. Long sleeves with volume and ease. Loose, unforced fit. Cloud Thread drifts between washed white and pale blue—a quiet blend that feels airy but grounded, like color seen through morning haze. Ruffles add softness without sweetness. Lace inserts and stitching feel like traces, subtle and tactile rather than decorative. Wear it open or closed, sleeves pushed up or down. Works with high-waisted Theodore pant or jeans. Romantic in an unstudied way. Intimate without being precious.

name: Omaris Sleeveless Blouse
description: Cloud thread in washed white and pale blue — a gentle mix that feels airy and tactile, like fabric warmed by the sun. The surface is softly gathered, creating texture and movement that follows the body without holding it too tightly. Light and intimate, shaped around the body rather than placed on it. Cut short and close, the top reveals just enough — a line of waist, a subtle sense of skin when the body shifts. Small ruffles at the shoulders bring a sweetness that never turns naïve, balanced by the cropped length and the quiet confidence of the fit. Kept it simple with Charlie bleach denim and added Otelo jacket for layering.

name: Blanca Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in soft single gauze cotton. Mandarin collar, partial button front, embroidered button cuffs. Lightweight with naturally crinkled texture. Volume sits low, blouses naturally when tucked or falls clean when worn loose. Warm off-white base with dense deep blue embroidery across the chest, shoulders, and back yoke. Paisley bands, fine geometric stitches, and curved borders create structure at the top, then open into a softer gathered body. The contrast is graphic but easy. Tuck it into tailored Otto navy pant or wear it loose with denim. The embroidery does the work. Clean, structured, graphic.

name: Salma Blouse
description: Wrap blouse in soft cotton with subtle embroidery scattered across the surface. Wraps across the body and ties at the side, long sleeves, relaxed peplum at the waist. Embroidery barely raised, meant to be felt more than seen. White Magnolia is warm cream, closer to ivory than pure white—soft glow, almost skin-like. Cotton gathers softly at the waist, falls into fluid peplum. Easy shape without structure. Wear it with high-waisted pants like Charlie. Tie it tighter or leave it loose.

name: Filippo Vest
description: Filippo takes its cues from a man’s suit, then lets feeling take over. The cut is classic, almost formal, but the sky-blue tone softens everything — light, open, slightly vulnerable. Grey embroidery runs across the surface in a quiet, all-over rhythm, like a thought repeated under the breath. The vest sits close to the body without stiffness. Buttons are placed on the reverse, a deliberate inversion that breaks the rules gently, the way emotion does. It’s tailored, but never severe — structure held together by softness. Filippo feels intimate and restrained at once. Worn alone against the skin or layered over a shirt, it carries the tension of Il Primo Bacio: hesitation, closeness, and the moment just before contact.

name: Ludovico Pant
description: Ludovico echoes the language of classic menswear, filtered through lightness and ease. The sky-blue fabric feels airy and calm, while grey embroidery spreads subtly across the trousers, adding texture without weight — a quiet insistence rather than decoration. The cut is relaxed but precise, sitting comfortably at the waist and falling straight through the leg. There’s nothing sharp here, nothing rigid. The trousers move easily, following the body instead of controlling it. Worn with the Filippo vest or on their own, Ludovico carries the tenderness of Il Primo Bacio: confidence softened by emotion, elegance interrupted by feeling. A masculine silhouette, worn with openness. The standard Ludovico measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Ludovico Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Gabriela Blouse
description: Gabriela feels alive in movement. A white blouse worn while walking, catching light as it shifts between trees and shadow. The tone is soft and natural, never stark — a white that feels warm against the skin. Embroidery runs across the front like a quiet relief, adding texture without interrupting the flow. The cut is relaxed and fluid, made to move with the body rather than hold its shape. Worn loose, slightly open at the neckline, sleeves falling naturally as the day unfolds. The embroidery brings just enough structure, anchoring the lightness of the fabric without weighing it down. Paired with Karma pant.

name: Brahma Pant
description: Relaxed pant in patchwork cotton. Button closure at the waist, back pocket. Vertical embroidery traces a line along the leg. Loose fit designed to sit naturally wherever it falls on your waist. Made to move with the body. Rich blues, warm reds, and muted tones meet through patchwork—stitched side by side without hierarchy. The mix feels instinctive. Vertical embroidery adds rhythm and elongation, grounding the patchwork like a path guiding the eye. Color runs through the pants with intention, never loud but always present. Wear them loose. Works with simple tops that let the patchwork speak. Shaped by travel, rooted in craft, alive with rhythm.

name: Claudia Blouse
description: Peasant blouse in soft cream cotton gauze with navy embroidery across the chest, shoulders, and sleeves. V-neckline with lace-up closure and navy tassels, long sleeves with button cuffs. The embroidery runs in vertical bands down the front, geometric patterns worked into the gauze. The lapis lazuli shade is warm cream, not stark white. Cotton gauze makes it breathable and light. Embroidery is dense at the yoke and shoulders, then continues down the sleeves in panels. The lace-up neckline adds structure to the loose fit. Tuck it into high-waisted Vincent pant to get our styling!

name: Irina Sleeveless Blouse
description: Sleeveless blouse in soft cream cotton gauze with navy embroidery covering the front panel. Round neckline with embroidered trim, button-down front, fitted through the body, finished with a ruffle at the hem. Sleeveless with embroidered detail framing the central panel. The embroidery is geometric—bands of cross-stitch patterns worked into the gauze. The fit is closer to the body than our typical blouses, more structured. Ruffle at the hem softens the look without overdoing it. Cotton gauze keeps it light. Worn loose over Charlie light blue denim and paired with our Federica sand sandals.

name: Dida Shirt
description: Collared blouse in ivory cotton schiffli with vertical pintucks down the front. Button-down closure all the way to the hem, long sleeves with button cuffs finished with lace trim. Lace trim details at the collar and cuffs. The schiffli fabric has eyelet perforations worked throughout the entire blouse, giving it texture and lightness. Full moon is warm ivory, not stark white. Cotton schiffli is broderie anglaise—small punched holes creating patterns across the whole fabric. Pintucks run down the chest in narrow bands, adding structure on top of the textured base. Regular length, hits at the hip. Tucked in Ludovico pant. Add Filippo vest to get the total look.

name: Camila Top
description: Cropped sleeveless top in ivory cotton schiffli with lace-up front. Round neckline with ruffle trim, lace-up closure down the center, finished with a ruffle peplum at the hem. Lace trim details frame the front panel and edges. The schiffli fabric has eyelet perforations throughout, light and breathable. Lace-up front adds structure to the cropped silhouette. Ruffle at the hem softens the look. Full moon is warm ivory, not stark white. Paired here with Allegra skirt.. which will be coming out soon.

name: Javiera Shirt
description: Collared blouse in black cotton seersucker with broderie anglaise covering the entire front. Button-down closure, long sleeves with ruffle cuffs. The broderie work creates floral and leaf patterns across the chest and down the front—eyelet embroidery layered over the textured seersucker base. Regular fit through the body. Onyx is deep black. Broderie anglaise adds density and detail to the front panel. Ruffle cuffs soften the sleeves without bulk. Regular length, hits at the hip. Works perfectly with Gilberto.

name: Noa Jacket
description: Light and flexible. A soft jacket in a denim-blue shade that feels worn-in and familiar without being literal — the fabric smooth and fluid, closer to a shirt than a jacket. Designed to layer over shirts and blouses, adding form without weight. A fabric tie at the waist lets the silhouette shift — loose and open, or gently shaped. Patch pockets and metal buttons nod to workwear, softened by the lightness of the fabric and the relaxed cut. Noa moves naturally with the body. A jacket to throw on, adjust, and wear all day. Here paired with Brahma pant.

name: Pike Pant
description: Pike is grounded and direct. A pant inspired by workwear lines, reinterpreted through a light and fluid fabric. The colour is a denim-blue tone — familiar and casual in mood, but far from traditional denim. Fine pinstripes run through the fabric, adding structure and vertical rhythm without making it feel tailored. The silhouette is straight and relaxed, sitting comfortably on the hips and falling naturally through the leg. Cargo-style pockets introduce a functional note, balanced by the softness of the material. Pike is designed for daily wear. Easy to style, easy to move in. Here combined with Irene blouse and Edgar Jacket.

name: Lucky Pant
description: Lucky has presence. A pant with a harder structure and a clear stance, built from a denim fabric designed to hold its shape. The blue tone is deep and worn-in, crossed with fine vertical stripes that sharpen the silhouette and bring definition to the surface. The fit is loose through the leg, with volume created by two front pleats that open the shape and give width. The waist is cinched and defined, anchoring the body before the fabric drops straight and wide. Controlled at the top, generous below — deliberate, balanced, strong. Here paired with Ayako shirt and Krishna sandals.

name: Luna Blouse
description: Button-down blouse in washed black viscose with paisley floral print. Crew neck with gathering, long balloon sleeves with button cuffs. Oversized fit through the body, regular length. Print features florals, paisleys, and vines in pinks, turquoise, burgundy, and beige across the black base. Night is deep black. Viscose stripe has a subtle ribbed texture that catches the light. Balloon sleeves gather at the shoulders and taper at the wrists. Print feels like old textiles—dense and layered without being busy. Tuck it into our Otto pant and tie it up with Sikka belt. Added Artemisa vest for that extra punch!

name: Louise Dress
description: Long-sleeve dress in black viscose with paisley floral print. Crew neckline with gathering, tie waist, two-tier skirt with ruffle details. Lined to the knee. Print features florals, paisleys, and vines in pinks, turquoise, burgundy, and beige across the black base. Night is deep black. Viscose stripe has that subtle ribbed texture. Balloon sleeves and gathered neckline add volume on top, tie waist defines the silhouette, tiered skirt flows from there. Lining keeps it opaque and structured. Print dense but readable. Wear it with boots or sandals. Add Yamato vest to complete the look.

name: Lea Skirt
description: Long tiered skirt in black viscose with paisley floral print. Elastic waist, two-tier construction with ruffle details, decorative border at the hem. Print features florals, paisleys, and vines in pinks, turquoise, burgundy, and beige across the black base. Night is deep black. Viscose stripe has subtle texture. Elastic waist sits comfortably, tiers add movement without bulk. Border at the hem finishes it off with extra detail. Print layered and rich. Paired here with Artemisa vest as a top.

name: Ginevra Dress
description: V-neck dress with gathering at the shoulders, short kimono sleeves, tie waist. Two-tier skirt with a ruffle between tiers, maxi length. Cut in viscose stripe—subtle ribbed texture that catches light. Paisley floral print across the entire dress. Soft cream base, like faded linen left in the sun. The print brings muted burgundy, dusty teal, warm mustard, terracotta—colors that look settled into the fabric over time. Viscose stripe has gentle give and fluid weight. The print feels borrowed from a vintage textile archive. Works with flat sandals or wooden platforms. Tie the belt loose or cinch it. Keep jewelry simple—shell necklaces, brass bangles.

name: Bianca Sleeveless Shirt
description: Sleeveless blouse with a stand collar, button-down front, vintage-style buttons. Soft pleating at the shoulders, boxy silhouette. Cropped length hits at the natural waist. Same paisley print—cream base with burgundy, teal, mustard, terracotta motifs. Warm cream, not stark white—the shade of old cotton washed a hundred times. Ribbed viscose stripe adds texture. The cropped length keeps it modern despite the vintage print. Tuck it in or leave it out, the boxy cut works either way. Here layered over Theodoro pant.

name: Theodore Pant
description: Same construction as our Shell version—high-waisted wide-leg trouser in cotton embroidered twill. Button and zip closure with belt loops. Two front pockets, two back pockets. Straight wide leg with embroidered eyelet pattern throughout the fabric. Cerulean is light blue washed with white, like denim that's been bleached by saltwater and sun. The base color shifts between pale blue and almost-white depending on the light. Same eyelet embroidery as the Shell, same cotton twill weight. Wear it with the matching Florence vest or mix it up with Rani tie dye shirt. The washed blue feels lived-in from the start.

name: Cecilia Jacket
description: Cropped jacket in cotton embroidered twill. Round neck, button-down front with five metal buttons. Long sleeves with gathering at the shoulders and button cuffs. Side pockets. Relaxed, boxy fit that hits at the hip. Same embroidered eyelet pattern as the Theodore pant and Florence vest—small floral and geometric perforations across the fabric. Cerulean is light blue washed with white, like denim left to fade in saltwater. The color shifts between pale blue and almost-white depending on how the light hits it. Wear it over the matching Theodore pant for a full set, or style it with Otto linen pant and Constanza top like we did.

name: Florence Vest
description: Same construction as the Shell version—masculine-cut vest in cotton embroidered twill. V-neck with wide, pronounced lapels. Three metal buttons, two small pockets at the waist. Embroidered eyelet pattern throughout. Tailored fit with structured shoulders. Cerulean is light blue washed with white, like sun-faded denim. The base shifts between pale blue and almost-white. Same eyelet embroidery, same structured cotton twill. The wide lapels make it work over printed blouses or simple dresses. Pair it with the matching Theodore pant or style it over something loose. The tailored cut balances fluid pieces underneath. Here mixed with Otto Ivory pant and Ringlo shirt.

name: Theodore Pant
description: High-waisted wide-leg trouser in cotton embroidered twill. Button and zip closure with belt loops. Two front pockets, two back pockets. The leg falls straight and wide from hip to hem. Embroidered eyelet pattern throughout—small floral and geometric perforations across the fabric. Shell is warm cream, like undyed canvas left in the sun. The embroidery creates texture without adding color, just subtle perforations that let light through. Cotton twill gives it structure and weight, holds the wide leg without collapsing. Pair it with the matching Florence vest or any tucked shirt like Linda. Works with sandals, works with boots.

name: Florence Vest
description: Masculine-cut vest in cotton embroidered twill. V-neck with wide, pronounced lapels. Three metal buttons down the front, two small pockets at the waist. Same embroidered eyelet pattern as the Theodore pant—small floral and geometric perforations across the fabric. Tailored fit with structured shoulders. Shell is warm cream, the color of undyed canvas. The embroidery adds texture through perforations, subtle but present. Cotton twill holds its shape, gives the vest weight and structure. The wide lapels frame whatever you wear underneath—works over blouses, dresses, or on its own. Layer it over the matching Theodore pant for a full set or wear over any dress. The masculine cut works with feminine pieces underneath. Tuxedo-inspired without the formality.

name: Bonifacio Shirt
description: Cotton stripe blouse with contrasting yoke and cuffs in cotton-viscose mix. Round neck, button-down front with buttons running the full length. Long balloon sleeves with gathering at the shoulders and button cuffs. Relaxed, oversided fit that hits at the hip. The body is soft light blue with white pinstripes—classic shirting stripe. The yoke panel at the chest and cuffs are cream with vertical embroidered lines, like a traditional men's dress shirt adapted. The mix of cotton stripe and embroidered cotton-viscose gives it texture without trying too hard. Works with printed pants like Lirio over here.

name: Caroline Blouse
description: Off-white cotton blouse with fine vertical stripes running through it — woven with a touch of lurex so it catches the light without making a scene. Small embroidered sun-like motifs scattered across the fabric, simple but sharp. Band collar, full button front, and generous sleeves with soft gathers at the shoulder. Easy shape, clean lines. It tucks in properly, but also works loose and undone. Looks innocent. Isn’t boring. Paired here with Mizu pant and Sikka tobacco belt.

name: Caroline Blouse
description: Cropped blouse in cotton lurex stripe. Round neck with button-down placket. Long balloon sleeves with dramatic volume and button cuffs. Gathering at the shoulders and neckline. Oversized, boxy fit that hits above the waist. Deep black base with vertical metallic stripes in gold and bronze lurex. Small star motifs scattered across the fabric, also in lurex. The metallic threads catch light without being loud about it. 95% cotton, 5% metallic—enough shine to make it special. Tucked in to our high-waisted Charlie´s.

name: April Blouse
description: Long-sleeve blouse in lightweight cotton voile. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Soft, fluid hand that moves naturally with the body. Indigo print with layered blues—peony florals within smaller repeating motifs. The composition feels continuous, like vegetation along a long path. Dense, rhythmic, quietly immersive. Indigo tones bring depth and stillness, making the florals feel part of the landscape rather than decoration. Combined with Otto pant and Afrodita sandals.

name: Augusta Dress
description: A navy-and-ivory micro gingham that earns its keep. The yoke is dense with hand-embroidered florals in faded rose, forest green, and ochre — the kind of work that takes days, not hours. Twin red tassels hang at the chest like a quiet punctuation mark. Wide butterfly sleeves with an embroidered chevron border. The body gathers from an empire seam into a generous tiered skirt that moves with real weight — not stiff, not flimsy. Midi length that hits just right with flat boots or bare feet on warm stone. Cotton gingham. Relaxed fit. Pull-on style.

name: Pika Pant
description: Cargo pant in sun-faded khaki cotton twill. Mid-rise waist with button and zip closure, wide leg that falls straight. Two front pockets, two cargo pockets on the thighs with button-flap closures. Utility stitching throughout adds structure. The khaki is washed soft but the twill holds its shape. Military-inspired without the costume factor—functional design that makes sense. Cargo pockets that actually work, fabric with weight to it. Pair it with a tucked or knotted shirt like Bruna Terracota. Works with sandals or boots.

name: Noa Jacket
description: Four-pocket jacket in sun-faded khaki cotton twill. Classic collar, shoulder epaulettes, wooden-tone buttons down the front. Two chest pockets with button flaps, two lower patch pockets. Long sleeves with button cuffs. Hits mid-thigh. The khaki is washed soft, the cotton twill has structure. Utility styling that works—pockets that hold things, epaulettes that add detail without excess. Here layered it over Lirio pant and Rani shirt.

name: Thalassa Short Dress
description: Short dress in sun-faded khaki cotton twill with lace-up front. Classic collar, shoulder epaulettes, long sleeves. Four patch pockets—two at chest, two at hips. Lace-up closure from neckline to waist with metal eyelets, hidden placket underneath for coverage. Mini length, hits mid-thigh. Khaki washed soft, cotton twill gives structure. Lace-up front adds edge. Shoulder epaulettes and multiple pockets functional, not decorative. Military utility translated into dress. Wear it with boots or layer with a jacket. Works belted or not.

name: Lotus Jacket
description: Cropped jacket in viscose slub with tonal embroidery. Deep black base with black embroidered leaves and flowers across the fabric. Mandarin collar, Japanese-inspired closure with frog ties down the front. Raglan sleeves with button cuffs and tie details. Two front pockets with curved flaps. Relaxed fit that hits above the waist. The embroidery is tone-on-tone—deep black on deep black—so the pattern reveals itself through texture rather than color. Viscose slub has that slightly irregular weave that gives it depth. The mandarin collar and frog closures. Wear it over the matching Zhou vest and Xian pants for a full look, or style it with jeans.

name: Xian Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in viscose slub with tonal embroidery. Deep black base with black embroidered leaves and flowers. High-waisted with pleats at the front. Button and zip closure, two back pockets. Full length with a wide, straight leg. The embroidery is subtle—tone-on-tone black so it reads as texture.
