Viscose slub has weight without being heavy, holds the wide leg without collapsing. The pleats add structure at the waist. Wear it with the matching jacket and top for a complete set, or pair it with a simple blouse. The wide leg works with flat sandals like Krishna or heeled boots.

name: Zhou Vest
description: Sleeveless top in viscose slub with tonal embroidery. Deep black base with black embroidered leaves and flowers. V-neckline, side ties that knot at the front, ruffle peplum hem. Cropped length. Fitted through the body with a flared peplum. Same tone-on-tone embroidery as the jacket—the pattern shows up through texture, not contrast. The side ties add detail without overcomplicating things. Viscose slub keeps it from feeling too polished. Pair it with the matching Xian pants or copy-paste our look, with Cosette skirt.

name: Kumo Dress
description: Shibori-inspired print in midnight navy and sky blue, inspired by traditional Japanese dyeing. Cut in 100% cotton with smocking across the chest and long sleeves with embroidered cuff details. Buttons down the front to the waist, round neckline with embroidered trim. Lined to the knee so it moves easy but keeps its shape. The print mimics kumo shibori—cloud dyeing—where patterns bloom across the fabric in organic bursts. Named for the technique, though this is printed rather than hand-dyed. Dots and florals scatter across navy like stars breaking through night sky. Works on its own with sandals or layered under the Gatsby blazer for contrast.

name: Sora Blouse
description: Cropped blouse in shibori-inspired print—midnight navy with sky blue dots and florals. Cut in 100% cotton with smocking at the chest, round neckline trimmed with embroidered flowers. Long sleeves with embroidered cuff details and trim running down the sleeve. Buttons partway down the front, finished with a soft peplum ruffle at the hem. Sora means sky in Japanese. The print feels like looking up at clouds breaking apart. Cropped length hits at the natural waist, works tucked or left loose over high-waisted pants. Pairs well with Charlie dark denim.

name: Mizu Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in midnight navy with sky blue shibori print. Cut in cotton sheeting with a high waist and two pleats at the front. Side and back pockets. The leg falls straight and wide, finished with an embroidered border at the hem. Mizu means water in Japanese. The print flows like indigo spreading through fabric, organic and unpredictable. Cotton sheeting gives it weight and structure, keeps the wide leg from feeling too soft. Combined with Cleo blouse and Federica Sandals. Added Gatsby for layering.

name: Stella Shirt
description: Light-wash denim covered in midnight blue paisley embroidery across the chest, shoulders, and sleeves. Cut in 100% cotton, regular fit. Classic collar, metal snap buttons, long sleeves with snap cuffs. The pattern is dense—paisleys, florals, geometric shapes worked into the fabric like charting constellations. Sun-faded denim with dark stitching creates contrast without shouting. Named Constellation because that's what it looks like—shapes and swirls scattered like stars across a night sky. Works well with Matteo Pant.

name: Linda Blouse
description: Classic vichy check in brown and cream. Cut in a cotton-viscose blend with a slightly oversized fit. Peter Pan collar with tie detail at the neck, full button-down front, long sleeves with button cuffs. Gathered at the shoulders for a bit of volume without looking pouffy. The check is small and traditional—picnic blanket vibes but make it wearable. The fabric has some drape to it thanks to the viscose. Works tucked into high-waisted pants like Theodore or left loose. Pairs well with the City Palace Nehru jacket if you're layering.

name: Daisy Sweater
description: Open-knit sweater in cream cotton with two daisy flowers worked into the chest. Crew neck, long sleeves with ruffled cuffs that add a bit of charm without overdoing it. The knit is light and breathable, textured enough to be interesting but not heavy. Cropped length that hits right at the waist. Margherita means daisy in Italian—seemed like the right name for a knit covered in them. The texture has that handmade feel even though it's machine-knit. Perfect combo with our Charlie´s!

name: Matteo Pant
description: Fitted pant in cream cotton with dense floral print in soft red covering the whole pant. Decorative border at the hem. Cut in cotton with 2% elastane. Mid-rise waist, fitted through the leg but not tight—straight from hip to ankle. Cropped length above the ankle. Two back pockets. Print bold but red soft enough not to overpower. Border detail at the bottom adds finishing touch, handmade textile feel. Works with simple white shirt or layer with more pattern. Here combined with Stella Blouse and Krishna sandals. Total length measurements is 102.5 cm.

name: Vincent Pant
description: This pant does more than it seems. The vertical striped print is packed with small floral details that only show up when you get closer — that’s the trick. High-waisted with a fitted top and a subtle flare at the hem, finished with a lace-up front that keeps it sharp and slightly unexpected. It’s not a basic, but it works like one. Paired here with the Claudia Blouse.

name: Bobby Blazer
description: Single-breasted blazer in slate grey with a fine chalk stripe — same fabric as the Ralph pant, same quiet suiting energy. The stripe reads almost as texture: even, fine, better in person. Notch lapel, breast pocket, flap pockets at the hip. The shoulders are defined but not padded, the body follows a clean line without pulling tight. Structured enough to read as tailoring, light enough to wear without a second thought. Bobby works as a suit with Ralph like here, or on its own over denim, over a knit, sleeves pushed up. A blazer that borrows from menswear without taking it too seriously.

name: Ralph Pant
description: A high-waisted straight leg in smoky grey cotton, pinstriped in pale cream. The kind of stripe that reads almost as texture — fine, even, and better in person than on screen. The fabric sits between tailoring and ease: enough body to keep the line, enough give to feel relaxed. Flat front, clean side pockets, a single welt pocket at the back. The cut is generous without being wide — a straight leg that falls clean from the hip. Ralph works tucked, belted, rolled at the ankle, left alone. A pant that stays out of the way.

name: Nehru Jacket
description: Indian tailoring with a band collar, four pockets, wooden-tone buttons. Cut in 100% cotton, warm tobacco shade that works across seasons. The pockets work, the buttons stay put, the fit makes sense. Wear it with Theodore pants, throw it over a tee, button it up with jeans. Does what you need it to do.

name: Gatsby Blazer
description: Named after Gatsby's side of the bay—the one with new money and big parties. Classic blazer cut in 100% cotton, soft off-white. Oversized fit that actually works, not the kind that swallows you. Two wooden-tone buttons, notch lapels, two front pockets. Fully lined so it holds its shape. The proportions are looser than a traditional blazer but still structured enough to look sharp. Throw it on over a tee or wear it properly with a shirt. Works with printed pants, works with denim, works on a horse if that's your thing.

name: Bobby Blazer
description: Summer suiting with vertical stripes in dusty grey and mellow cream. Cut in a cotton-linen blend that actually breathes. Two wooden-tone buttons, classic lapels, two front pockets. Fully lined to keep the structure but stays light. The stripes are narrow and clean—classic tailoring without the corporate vibe. Works as a full suit with the Tomy pant, but honestly just as good on its own with jeans or thrown over a dress. Italian seaside energy without overthinking it.

name: Tomy Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in those same vertical stripes, dusty grey and mellow cream. High waist with a button closure, two pleats at the front, side pockets. The leg is wide but not overwhelming—hits the right balance between relaxed and put-together. Made to match the Bobby blazer for a full suit situation, but works solo with a basic tee or a tucked shirt. The summer pant that gets worn on repeat.

name: Lirio Pant
description: Wide-leg trouser in cotton with a touch of elastane. High waist with button and zip closure, two pleats at the front, side pockets. Wide, easy leg that hits the floor just right. Moves without losing shape. Soft botanical print—lilies, stems, and wildflowers in faded pinks, blues, and yellows on cream. Feels like an old garden illustration, the kind pressed between pages of a vintage book. Pair it with matching Narciso shirt for a full look, or mix it but with Rani like our stylist. Works with flat sandals or boots. Easy, fluid, botanical. Total length measurements is 108.5 cm for a size S.

name: Narciso Shirt
description: Named after the narcissus flower—delicate, a little wild, impossible to ignore. This shirt comes in a soft floral print with peachy-pink blooms scattered across cream cotton. Oversized fit with a classic collar, full button-down front, long sleeves. Roomy enough to feel easy but still looks pulled together. The colors are faded and soft, like they've been sitting in sunlight for years. Works tucked into high-waisted pants or left loose over jeans. Matches the Botanica Lirio pant for a full print-on-print situation, or keep it simple with denim. Paired here with Pika pant and Sikka belt.

name: Morrison Pant
description: Pink and white geometric print inspired by traditional ikat weaving. Cut in cotton with 2% elastane. Two back pockets. High waist with lace-up ties at the front, fitted through the hips, then opens up below the knee into a wide leg. The fit is the thing here—it's not just wide-leg, it's structured on top and loose on the bottom. Shows your waist, gives you room to move. The print has that hand-dyed look, all those soft diamonds repeating. Feels global without trying to be a souvenir. Here tucked into Daisy knit.

name: Marina Pant
description: Season after season, these are one of our best-selling pants. Made in Spain, always. Cut in high-quality linen with a clean button-and-zip closure. It shows up all over this season’s shoot because it works with pretty much everything — dressed up, relaxed, or somewhere in between. The standard Marina measures 104.5 cm in total length (size S). If you want it longer, there’s Marina Long, with a 111 cm length.

name: Charlie Pant
description: Classic denim, done the Maison way. Mid-rise waist with a clean fit through the hip and a straight leg that opens slightly at the hem. Finished with a button fly — solid metal buttons that give it that old-school feel. The wash is light and worn-in, like a pair you’ve had forever and never stopped wearing. Easy, flattering, no drama. Paired here with Daisy knit.

name: Charlie Pant
description: Classic denim, done the Maison way. Mid-rise waist with a clean fit through the hip and a straight leg that opens slightly at the hem. Finished with a button fly — solid metal buttons that give it that old-school feel. The wash is dark and vivid, like a pair you’ve had forever and but is still intact. Easy, flattering, no drama. Paired here with Salinger blouse.

name: Cher Pant
description: This one starts at the waist. Straight-leg denim, closer through the top and finished with a soft flare. Comfortable, flexible, and easy to wear from day one. Mid-rise, clean through the leg. Braided detail stitched directly into the waistband. Paired here with Piti Blouse and Noa Jacket.

name: Sikka Belt
description: Sikka takes its name from the Hindi word for coin. A 100% brown suede leather belt detailed with metal coins set along the strap, alternating between gold and silver tones. The mix adds rhythm and contrast, catching light differently as the belt moves. The leather comes in a dark, chocolate shade, rich and grounded. Soft to the touch but firm enough to hold its shape, it’s designed to age naturally, gaining depth and character over time. The solid buckle anchors the belt with a balanced, confident finish. Worn at the waist or low on the hips, Sikka brings texture and presence to any look.

name: Sikka Belt
description: Sikka takes its name from the Hindi word for coin. A 100% suede leather belt detailed with metal coins set along the strap, alternating between gold and silver tones. The mix adds rhythm and contrast, catching light differently as the belt moves. The leather comes in a warm, earthy shade, rich and grounded. Soft to the touch but firm enough to hold its shape, it’s designed to age naturally, gaining depth and character over time. The solid buckle anchors the belt with a balanced, confident finish. Worn at the waist or low on the hips, Sikka brings texture and presence to any look.

name: Criollo Belt
description: Crafted in 100% cowsplit leather, Criollo belt takes its name from open wetlands and sun-faded landscapes. The leather comes in a light, natural tone with a dry, slightly washed feel that recalls salt, earth, and time. The belt is finished with silver-tone metal flower hardware, sculptural and softly aged. The floral detail adds character without excess, bringing a subtle ornamental touch rooted in tradition rather than decoration.

name: Thar Belt
description: Thar speaks of heat, dust, and repetition. A belt shaped by desert tones and bold threadwork, where colour carries meaning rather than decoration. The suede leather base comes in a warm, sand-washed shade — dry, grounded, sun-worn. Black and red embroidery runs across the strap in a graphic, instinctive rhythm. Black brings depth and weight; red adds pulse and intensity. Together, they hint at karma — cause and effect stitched into the surface, passion held in balance rather than excess. There’s a playful edge to the design, almost childlike at first glance, but anchored by symbolism and craft.

name: Malambo Belt
description: This one comes from Argentina. Gaucho-style oval buckle, black woven strap. That’s the idea. Solid, practical, and easy to wear. The kind of belt that just works with everything.

name: Malambo Belt
description: This one comes from Argentina. Gaucho-style oval buckle, light brown woven strap. That’s the idea. Solid, practical, and easy to wear. The kind of belt that just works with everything.

name: Masai Belt
description: Masai Kilimanjaro takes its name from the highest mountain in Africa. A symbol of strength, endurance, and quiet presence. Crafted in 100% leather, the belt comes in a warm, desert-washed tone, dry and grounded, with a naturally worn feel. The surface is built through rows of hand-set beads, forming a graphic, rhythmic pattern. Like Kilimanjaro itself, the beaded design is created through repetition — small elements coming together to build height, weight, and presence. Each bead adds substance, turning simplicity into something quietly monumental. Finished with a square metal buckle, clean and architectural, the belt balances structure with texture.

name: Bruna Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight stripe dobby cotton. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Relaxed fit. Classic shirt shape with soft, textured hand feel. Companion piece to the Samba pareo. Vertical stripes mixed with ikat-style motifs and small geometric borders in warm terracotta, deep indigo, and washed cream. Patchworked but balanced—graphic without being loud. The dobby cotton adds subtle texture. Wear it open, tied at the waist, or buttoned low and effortless. Works with the matching pareo or pairs back to Pika pant. Web exclusive.

name: Bruna Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight stripe dobby cotton. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Relaxed fit with slight gathers at the shoulders and back yoke. Classic shirt shape with soft, textured hand. Deep indigo blue base overprinted with washed-out florals and circular motifs in pale sky tones. The pattern feels sun-faded, like it's been rinsed in the sea a few times. The dobby cotton adds subtle texture. Wear it open, half-buttoned, or tied at the waist. Matches the Samba Indigo pareo for the full set, or pair it Pike Pacific or anything that's already lived a little. Web exclusive.

name: Bruna Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight stripe dobby cotton. Collared, button-down front, button cuffs. Relaxed fit with gentle gathers at the shoulders and back yoke. Classic shirt construction with soft, slightly textured surface. Deep raspberry, ink navy, and warm cream arranged in diagonal bands, florals, and small geometric borders. The pattern is bold and layered—feels collected rather than matched, like different textiles brought together. Strong but balanced. The dobby cotton adds depth to the print. Tuck it into high-waisted Otto linen to sharpen up, or wear it loose and let it do its own thing. Matches the Samba Raspberry pareo for the full set. Web exclusive.

name: Bruna Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton. Structured collar, button-down front, long sleeves with subtle volume. Relaxed fit. Soft, fluid with natural drape. Easy to tuck or wear loose. Patchwork-inspired composition blends turquoise tile motifs with earthy floral panels in warm sand and brown tones. Contrast print placement gives it a handcrafted, collected feel—bold but balanced. Pair it with the matching pareo for a coordinated look, or style it with neutral pants like Otto Linen for something more understated. Works tucked or loose.

name: Bruna Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight stripe dobby cotton. Collared, button-down front, structured button cuffs. Relaxed fit with gentle gathers at the shoulders and back yoke. Classic shirt shape with soft texture that gives subtle movement. Saturated carmine red layered with soft cream florals and fine vine details. Denser border frames the shoulders and yoke, then opens into larger blooms through the body. Bold but warm—sun-soaked rather than sweet. The dobby cotton adds depth to the surface. Wear it with washed denim for strength or ivory linen for contrast. It carries the color on its own. Matches the Samba Carmine pareo for the full set. Web exclusive.

name: Fiorella Dress
description: Long-sleeve dress in cream viscose with paisley floral print. Crew neckline with lace trim detail at the back yoke, long balloon sleeves with wide cuffs, tie waist with matching belt. Single-tier skirt with decorative border at the hem. Lined to the knee. Print features florals, paisleys, and vines in burgundy, turquoise, beige, and plum across the cream base. Day is cream whitish, not stark white. Viscose stripe has that subtle ribbed texture. Balloon sleeves gather at the shoulders and taper at the wrists with elastic. Lace trim at the back yoke adds detail without fuss. Tie belt defines the waist, skirt flows from there. Border at the hem finishes it off. Print dense and layered like old textiles. Wear it with boots or sandals.

name: Salinger Shirt
description: Long-sleeve shirt in lightweight cotton dobby. Classic collar, button-down front, embroidered button cuffs. Relaxed but clean fit. Subtle woven stripe adds quiet texture and depth. Soft, breathable, easy against the skin. Warm off-white base with delicate navy embroidered motifs scattered across the body. Denser floral embroidery frames the shoulders and collar. Two vertical embroidered bands run along the placket, creating structure and elongation. Tuck it into high-rise Charlie Denim, or wear it loose for a softer silhouette.

name: Dada Dress
description: The Dada Dress in Pearl Jam. Cut in a unique, self-embroidered cotton fabric, the maxi v-neck dress screams summer. We've let the fabric and the silhouette do most of the noise with this one - we've just added delicate lace inserts across the sleeves and ruffled cuffs. Comes with a separate cotton voile lining. Pair with sea shells and vintage leather sandals.

name: Asha Blouse - Caki
description: The Asha Blouse in Positano Caki. Rendered in soft viscose modal, the off-white blouse plays with a charming combination of khakhi embroidery, khakhi lace and khakhi beads which help to bind the gatherings at the shoulders and sleeves. A special yet every-day blouse which can be combined endlessly. Paired here with our Carlota linen skirt and vintage indian sandals.

name: Franziska Blouse
description: The Franziska Blouse in Ischia Latte. The half-button-up blouse is cut in soft cotton gauze and highlights an eye-catching, multi-tone, single-thread floral embroidery running across the neckline. Paired here with our Twiggy pants in Bengala - another of our season's best-sellers. Don't forget to complement with plenty of accessories (top tip: this season we found plenty of 'Maison Hotel approved' vintage bling at a market in Cairo).

name: Sandrine Blouse
description: The Sandrine Bllouse in Primavera Raspberry. Cut in delicately airy cotton gauze, the blouse features dye-to-match lace inserts, sublime string-tassel-pompom combo, smocking details across the neck and cuff and an intricate, single light raspberry embroidery running across the front, sleeves, neckline and cuffs. Paired here with our all-time favourite Marisa linen pants.

name: Sandrine Blouse
description: The Sandrine Blouse in Tinos Sand. Cut in delicately airy cotton gauze, the blouse features dye-to-match lace inserts, sublime string-tassel-pompom combo, smocking details across the neck and cuff and an intricate, single-tone embroidery across the chest, sleeves and neckline. Paired here with our Indira pants in White Stripes and one of our hand-embroidered leather belts.

name: Carlota Skirt
description: The Carlota Skirt in Candy Pistachio. Cut in the same high-quality linen as our best-selling Marisa Pants, the Carlota is also made in Spain. Fully button-up, the skirt is a wardrobe staple and you'll find yourself using it recurrently this season (and many more to come). Paired here with one of Asha embroidery-and-lace blouse.

name: Telma Vest
description: The Telma Vest in Pink Flamingo. Why not make it reversible, we though? Why not combine a print with cut-work, we thought? The lightly-quilted cotton vest offers two possibilities: On the 'front' side it offers a small, all-around motif print, and on the back you have an imperfectly attached, same-print-fabric, all-around star design. Paired here over our Dada printed dress.

name: Lala Dress
description: The Lala Dress in Rust Flamingo. Cut in super-soft cotton voile and hand-printed in Rajasthan, the 'mid-and-match' Lala maxi v-neck dress features a relaxed silhouette and comes with a separate inner lining which, perhaps unsurprisingly, we don't like to use :) Paired here with vintage leather boots and some vintage bling.

name: Bob Blouse
description: The Bob Blouse in Kaleidoscope Petunia. Cut in soft cotton voile, the pink-rust-crimson-pastel blue hues work gorgeously over this vintage design print, and makes it an easy all-rounder. Matching thin lace inserts across the front and chest add the perfect finishing touches. Don't let looks deceive you: the piece can be paired with much more than a bikini.

name: Lala Dress
description: The Lala Dress in Blue Lagoon. Cut in super-soft viscose, the Lala maxi v-neck dress features a relaxed silhouette and comes with a separate inner lining which, perhaps unsurprisingly, we don't like to use :) The mix-and-match of the floral and indigo motif prints work gorgeously; a thin navy lace acting as separations between the panels. Paired here with vintage leather boots.

name: Lina Blouse
description: The Lina Blouse in Caribe Blue. Our best-selling blouse this season. Period. Number One. Numero Uno. Rendered in our signature super-soft cotton gauze, the half-button up blouse highlights a intricate floral embroidery across the chest and bottom sleeves, and an all-around motif-and-flower embroidery across the blouse. Finished with a border embroidery detail across the neckline. The Lina Blouse is very versatile and pairs with anything and everything, but remember to treat it with care.

name: Jomy Kimono
description: The Jomy Kimono in our 'Elvis Paisley' Print. This lightly-quilted kimono is rendered in 100% cotton and comes with a matching belt, as shown. The colour combo of this floral and paisley print is brought to life because of the colour combo: the traditional carmine red and the faded aqua work beautifully over the light ivory base making the piece look like true vintage. Paired here with our now classic Marisa linen pants.

name: Indira Pant
description: The Indira Pant in our 'Elvis Paisley' Print. Wondering whether this actually warrants a product description when the images speak for themselves. Cut in soft, rustic cotton linen blend, the paisley and floral vintage-inspired print is no doubt one of the season's best-sellers. It actually is all about the colour combo: the traditional carmine red and the faded aqua work beautifully over the light ivory base making the piece look like true vintage. Paired here with our Lina blouse.

name: Alberta Blouse
description: The Alberta Blouse in Athenea Bone. Rare is there a collection where we don't try and re-invent the romantic blouse, and this season wasn't going to be any different. Cut in a high quality cotton dobby, the button-up blouse features two types of thin lace inserts and just-so-slight oversize sleeve with same-fabric ruffles. Certainly a blouse to pair with everything, but look how stunning it works with an all-white look with these Ross Disco pants.

name: Kalinda Dress
description: The Kalinda Dress in Mirissa Atlántico. Once in a while one of us gets hit by a unique ray of inspiration and we're gifted with a truly stunning piece. And the paisley-inspired Kalinda is the result of one of these moments. Cut in super soft cotton voile with an attached cotton voile lining, the highlight of this dress is no-doubt it's incorporated quilted vest, and the combination of two-tone floral and border embroidery. The dress runs true to size, but can be a bit narrow across the chest, so feel free to go up a size if this is the area where you usually need more room. Paired here with vintage leather sandals and some ocean-inspired necklaces.

name: Delphine Dress
description: The Delphine Dress in Mirissa Atlántico. Cut in super-soft cotton voile together with an attached inner lining, the paisley-inspired dress is a must-have high summer piece. So so easy to wear, you'll find yourself pulling it out of the wardrobe constantly between May and September. Top tip: Don't flat iron it to make it look perfect. Instead, light-iron and slightly 'hand crush' for a more authentic, imperfect look.

name: Giada Vest
description: The Giada Vest in White Stripes. Our Giada Vest is rendered in a special, rustic type of cotton weave stripe fabric and features all-around floral motif embroidery. The wooden buttons give a very special final touch, but it is actually the contrast indigo floral print on the back which puts the icing on the cake. Paired here over the Lala Dress from the 'Mirissa Atlántico' story.

name: Emilia Jacket
description: The Emilia Jacket in Garçon Shell. The joyous cotton-linen blend herringbone jacket features large front pockets, horn buttons on the sleeves and a generous back slit. Paired here with our Marisa Linen pants and our indigo-motif printed blouse.

name: Violetta Belt
description: The Violetta Belt in Blue Orchid. Our most special belt this season, the intricately embroidered, three-tone floral embroidery works gorgeously over the suede leather base and antique gold buckle.

name: Federika Belt
description: The Federica Belt in Capri Caramel. Made in 100% leather, the belt features an intricate, three-tone single thread embroidery. Paired here over our Indira White Stripes pant and the Bob Atlántico Blouse.

name: Cartago Belt
description: The Cartago Belt in Mediterranean Blue. Rendered in suede leather, the Cartago features an intricate off-white embroidery with delicate vintage gold beads and buckle. Paired here with the Marisa Pants.

name: Cartago Belt
description: The Cartago Belt in Sahara Beige. Rendered in suede leather, the Cartago features an intricate crimson embroidery with delicate vintage gold beads and buckle. Paired here over the Jomy Kimono.

name: Mathilde Pareo
description: The Mathilde Pareo in Macedonia. Cut in cotton cambric, the 'Macedonia' features a diagonally printed vintage design with a generous border. Don't try to search the bikini top on our website: it is a single piece we created out of some sort of table-top accessory.

name: Mathilde Pareo
description: The Mathilde Pareo in Mare. If you love our pareos but are looking for something more serene yet equally special, 'Mare' is the way to go. Cut in soft cotton cambric. We love to think of our pareos as versatile pieces which can be used in a multitude of ways: a timeless piece which will only win in character over time.

name: Kalpana Jacket
description: The Kalpana Jacket in Tutti Frutti. We thought hard about introducing this piece into the collection, but with Maison Hotel you can expect the unexpected. Cut in a light cotton canvas, the Kalpana jacket features a heavy-thread, tutti frutti embroidery which would have had Bob Marley (rest in peace) turn his head. Finished with single thread embroideries across the bottom hem and a lace in the cuffs.

name: Lala Dress
description: The Lala Dress in Trapéze Cucumber. Cut in uber uber soft cotton voile, the Lala maxi v-neck dress features a authentic Jaipur tie-dye taken to another level. Traditional tie-dye is a hand-made blind process which results in each piece being absolutely unique. No two pieces are ever exactly the same. The Lala comes with a separate inner lining. Paired here with leather sandals and vintage accessories we found in a market in Cairo.

name: Telmo Vest
description: The Telmo Vest in Trapéze Antartic Blue. The lightly quilted Telmo vest is cut in soft cotton voile which is later authentically tye-dyed in Jaipur. Pairs perfectly with the Bob Blouse in Vintage Palm and our Ross Disco pants.

name: Tess Pant
description: The Tess Pant in Trapéze Iron Maiden. Incredible what you can do with authentic Jaipur tie-dye when you put your mind to it. Cut in soft viscose crepe, these pants are not only a joy to wear because of their posterior elastic and wide legs, but because of the colour hues achieved by this ancient, hand-made technique. You can pair it up for a refined bohemian look or do as we've done here: turn a sarong into a bikini top and ready to go.

name: Toppik Hair Building Fibers
description: GENERAL INFORMATIONS Toppik Hair Building Fibers are ideal for men and women who want to disguise the challenge of thinning hair; acting as a hair thickener so you can feel confident at all times. Toppik uses keratin-derived fibers that are safe, natural and blend undetectably with your existing hair to create the appearance of naturally thicker, fuller hair. ABOUT IT! We only use the highest quality products derived from natural wool sources in the manufacturing of our hair building fibers – which means no nasty side effects. The premium Keratin used to create our hair fibers is almost identical to that of human hair, allowing the fibers to bind and blend naturally with existing hair. HOW IT WORK! Toppik Hair Building Fibers have a strong natural static charge that creates a magnetic effect, tightly binding the fibers to even the finest strands of human hair. Our hair fibers are suitable for active wearers, as the waterproof fibers protect against perspiration and are resilient even in rain, wind, and snow! To remove, simply wash your hair thoroughly with shampoo. To find out more about how Toppik works, visit our how it works page. COLOR OPTIONS! To ensure that your Toppik hair fibers blend in seamlessly with your hair, it’s important that you pick the color that best matches your hair color. So we’ve put together a choice of five different hair colors to best match your hair, all of which come in natural shades to blend undetectably with your hair. Let your golden hair shine with our blonde hair fibers, give dark brunette hair a boost with our black fibers or get your brown hair to stand out with our range of light and dark brown fibers. LONG LASTING! Toppik Hair Fibers are resistant to wind, rain, and perspiration, providing a reliable solution for those looking to maintain a fuller look throughout their day-to-day activities. EASY REMOVABLE The hair fibers can be washed out with regular shampooing, and they won't cause any damage to existing hair.

description: Discover the new Advanced Genifique Serum formula, derived from the science of the microbiome. We now know more about what makes skin look healthy and beautiful. Our skin lives in harmony with a community of billions of beneficial microorganisms called the skin microbiome. When the skin microbiome is strong and balanced, the skin is better able to defend itself against external aggressions, recover and repair itself. After 20 years of advanced research, the new Advanced Genifique acts on the skin microbiome thanks to its enriched formula. This new formula reinforces the fundamental functions of the skin's youthfulness: recovery and defence against external aggressions. - From 7 days, the first results are visible: the skin appears more luminous and smoother. - After just one bottle, the skin recovers faster. Advanced Génifique, which acts on the cutaneous microbiome, is made for all women, regardless of their age or skin type. It is the first beauty gesture by Lancôme. - Tested under dermatological control. It is proven that Advanced Génifique acts on the cutaneous microbiome, which is essential to the skin's resilience and its ability to recover. From 7 days, the first results are visible and skin is visibly brighter and smoother. After just 1 bottle, the skin recovers faster and looks visibly rejuvenated: +57% smoother skin* +52% sparkle* +48% firmness* Its texture is fluid, light and quickly penetrates the skin. *Clinical evaluation after 8 weeks, 34 women. The Advanced Génifique face serum : - Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. - Skin's tone and texture regains radiance, luminosity, firmness and uniformity. - Skin recovers faster.

Within hours after application, skin elasticity and firmness are improved, and the eye area is moisturized with hydration lasting up to 24-hours. Following five years of research into efficacious ingredients to target skin aging and wrinkles, a customized artificial intelligence algorithm combed through more than 1 billion potential peptides; one hundred novel peptides were screened in vitro as a result of this prediction, and four were selected for their anti-aging and anti-wrinkle potential for further evaluation done in vivo, returning one sequence that showed outstanding results for wrinkle reduction. The resulting sequence became the new ingredient in this formula. SKIN CONCERNS: Wrinkles, fine lines, roughness, dehydrated skin, loss of firmness SAFETY MEASURES: Tested for tolerance under ophthalmological control. Absolue The Serum is a concentrated anti wrinkle serum that helps accelerate epidermal cell renewal to ultimately achieve younger-looking skin. Infused with an exclusive blend of Grand Rose Extracts, Vitamin E, Pro-Xylane, and a gentle Exfoliating Acid Complex, Absolue The Serum revitalizes skin with millions of new surface cells. Immediately, skin is firmer and more hydrated, and tone is improved. Over time, skin looks smoother and plumper, glowing with youthful-looking radiance. WHAT ELSE YOU NEED TO KNOW Inspired by Longevity Science: Our latest Absolue formulations have been inspired by a promising field of research called Longevity Science, which studies innovative ways to extend the human lifespan, thereby achieving the dream of eternal youth. In this spirit, Lancôme laboratories have spent 10 years studying how to extend the longevity of youthful-looking skin by learning more about how skin ages over time. These rich scientific insights helped enhance the formulation of Absolue the Serum, an indulgent serum that is both effective and luxurious. Infused with Grand Rose Extracts: This serum contains an exclusive blend of Grand Rose Extracts, including the newly patented Absolue Perpetual Rose™, which is grown on the Plateau Valensole in the South of France. Unlike other roses that bloom just one or twice a year, The Perpetual Rose™ blossoms with vitality in every season – a true phenomenon of nature. To help preserve the integrity of these exceptional hybrid roses, they are hand-harvested with care in the early morning when the flowers begin to bloom. This perfume is inspired by the Chinese people's love for the lightest and most delicate scents. Encased in a chic black and gold monogrammed packaging, inspired by the DG Logo Bag, this palette invites you to amplify your creativity with endless makeup looks to flaunt from day to night. Complete with a detachable chain, mirror, and double-ended brush applicator, it’s a chic addition to your makeup bag.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Everlast Foundation 24H
description: The Everlast Foundation has been crafted with a life-proof formula that offers a full coverage flawless finish with 24H long wear and no transfer. Designed with a skin-loving touch, it provides a blurring and smoothing effect with all-day shine control that ensures complexion perfection with a 3D matte seamless result. Available in 40 inclusive shades, it caters to everyone and every skin, with easy-to-navigate options for the ultimate everlasting confidence. The Everlast Foundation comes in a beautiful glass bottle with a gold cap sealed by the iconic Dolce&Gabbana Sacred Heart.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Everlast Concealer 24H
description: The Everlast Concealer is designed to complete your flawless skin routine alongside the Everlast Primer and Foundation. This high-performance concealer delivers seamless, 24H* long-lasting coverage to keep you feeling confident all day. Its natural matte finish smooths effortlessly over the skin, camouflaging imperfections with crease-proof* results and sweat and waterproof* resistance. Whether lifting and brightening the under-eye area with a lighter shade or perfectly matching the concealer to your foundation for a seamless blend, this versatile formula adapts to every need. Available in 30 shades that perfectly complement the Everlast Foundation range. Encased in a sophisticated frosted vial with a gold cap, sealed by the iconic Devotion Sacred Heart, the concealer features a bespoke applicator designed for precise multi-way application.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Everkiss Liquid Lipstick
description: The Everkiss Liquid Lip has a soft matte, moussy texture that is no-transfer and long-lasting for up to 16H*, immediately releasing intense, high-coverage color on the lips, giving extreme lip definition thanks to its precise applicator. Available in nine shades made up of nudes, pinks, corals, and iconic reds.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Everfull Xl Mascara 36H
description: The Everfull XL Mascara increases lash volume by +205%***, immediately lifting every lash with visible results that last all day. The innovative formula comes in one Total Black shade that is ultra-glossy, and sweat-proof, for impactful fluttering lashes that keep your gaze looking flawless all day.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Everfull Hi-Definition Mascara 36H
description: The Everfull Hi-Definition Mascara delivers 36H* of defined volume and length with a high-performing formula that is sweat-proof, tear-proof, and water-resistant*. Featuring a new hi-definition arched wing brush applicator with short bristles to comb and separate lashes from the root, it provides an infinitely long lash effect without clumping. The innovative formula comes in one Total Black shade that is ultra-glossy for an impactful gaze that lasts all day.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Ever Icon Eye Palette
description: Elevate your eye makeup routine with the Ever Icon Eye Palette, the ultimate go-to for creating versatile looks that transition effortlessly from day to night. Each palette empowers you to tell your own color story and become your own Icon. Designed as the perfect on-the-go companion, it features 6 long-lasting shades in a variety of stunning finishes, from matte and satin to soft metallic and sparkle, endless combinations for every occasion and season. With a tested 10H wear* and smudge-proof** performance, the shadows provide superior grip and crease-proof results, ensuring a flawless look that lasts. Available in three captivating color harmonies, 01 Amber Venus with iconic browns, 02 Rose Goddess with sophisticated pinks, and 03 Chrome Star with sleek grays.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Illuminating Face Oil in Powder Luminizer

name: Dolce & Gabbana Cheeks&Eyes Match Blush & Eyeshadow Powder

This beautiful powder does not crease on the eyelids and keeps the skin feeling hydrated throughout wear.

name: Dolce & Gabbana Brow Restyler Pencil

Its micro tip ensures precise application, while the dual-ended design features a spoolie for brushing brows to perfection. Delivering life-proof performance, the formula is transfer-proof, smudge-proof, sweat-proof, and waterproof*. Available in 6 shades to match any brow tone, the pencil glides on easily, making it your go-to ally to create a custom brow look. Encased in a sleek black and gold design inspired by Dolce&Gabbana fashion codes, the Brow Restyler Pencil is a must-have for stunning, long-lasting brows.

name: Collagen Booster LED Mask
description: Light therapy is a non-invasive anti-aging treatment that emits specific wavelengths of light onto the skin. There are three types of highly effective light therapies: Red, Blue, and Infrared Light Therapy. How do Red and Infrared Light Therapy work? They emit photons of specific frequencies carrying defined energy that penetrates deep into the skin, activating collagen-producing cells (fibroblasts) to help reduce wrinkles, scars, and inflammation. How does Blue Light Therapy work? Blue light therapy is a highly effective treatment for clearing inflammatory acne. The photons emitted by blue light have broad antimicrobial effects, particularly against the acne-causing bacteria Propionibacterium. By killing bacteria within oil glands, blue light helps shrink these glands and reduce acne breakouts. How to use : After cleansing, place the mask comfortably and adjust the head elastic to hold it. Connect the controller to the mask via the USB lead wire and turn it on. Choose your preferred LED mode. When the light turns off, remove the device. We recommend a full 2.5-hour charge before the first use. Recommended Treatment Time Red + NIR: 10 minutes, 5 days per week Red: 3–5 minutes, 5 days per week Blue: 3–5 minutes, 5 days per week Recommended Treatment Period: 8 weeks minimum

Gently massage until fully absorbed. Always apply sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher during the day, as Bakuchiol may increase skin sensitivity to sunlight. Use at night for optimal results. name: Turkish Coffee With Cardamom
description: Turkish coffee made with Brazilian beans roasted and grounded finely with cardamom. PREPARATION Measure the amount of cold water you will need. Place your pot of water on the stove and turn the heat to medium-high enough to heat up the water Add about 1-2 heaping tea spoons (or 1 tablespoon) of coffee per demitasse cup (3 oz). Do not stir it yet. Just let the coffee "float" on the surface because if you stir it now you might cause it to clump up. Add sugar to taste. Do not stir it yet, Let the water warm up little bit as above. When the coffee starts to sink into the water and the water is warm enough to dissolve your sugar, stir it several times and then turn down the heat to low. You should stir it several times, up until your brew starts to foam When you see the bubble "ring" forming on the surface, turn down the heat a little bit more or move your pot away from the heat source. Pay attention to the bubbles that are forming at this stage. Bubbles should be very small in size. From this point on watch your coffee carefully. Do not let the temperature get hot enough to start boiling. The key idea here is to let the coffee build a thick froth and that occurs approximately around 158 F or 70 C Keep it at the "foaming" stage as long as you can without letting it come to a boil. You might even gently stir your brew a little bit at this stage. The more froth, the better it will taste. SOLD IN: Aluminum Foil 450g (0.99lb)

name: Annonce de Bélair-Monange Grand Cru Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2020
description: Annonce enjoys the same attention as the Grand Vin: meticulous vineyard work undertaken with respect for the environment followed by a manual harvest once the grapes have reached optimal maturity. Vinification takes place in concrete and stainless-steel vats, where maceration and extraction are gentle and measured in order to allow the fruit its highest expression. The wine is then aged in French oak barrels. Although Annonce exhibits great charm in its youth, a few years of cellaring or a few hours of decanting will be largely rewarded.

name: Domaine E. Guigal Red Côtes du Rhône France 2023 Magnum 1.5L
description: This wine is of consistently high quality in all vintages. Connoisseurs will enjoy its classic expression of the Syrah grape variety combined with the Grenache grape.

name: Crozes-Hermitage Les Alexandrins Rhône France 2023
description: Beautiful deep-purple colour with shiny reflections. Precise and aromatic, the nose is typical of Syrah on this stony plain of Crozes Hermitage with notes of small red and black fruit and pepper. All in delicacy, the mouth offers a silky tannic structure and beautiful aromas of smooth red fruit. A wine with great elegance.

name: Champagne Petite Fleur de Miraval
description: Petite Fleur opens with a magnificent springtime floral bouquet of peony and hawthorn, carried by tangy, crisp red fruits like raspberry and redcurrant. The palate is vibrant, juicy, and fleshy, chiseled with fresh, lemony citrus notes reminiscent of ruby grapefruit and mandarin, leading to a subtle and ethereal finish. The very signature of the great terroirs of the Côte des Blancs, rooted in the noble purity of the chalk.

name: La Croix De Carbonnieux White Pessac-Léognan Bordeaux France 2023
description: A pale yellow colour typical of our varieties and a freshness subtly impregnated with aromas of exotic fruits and grapefruit. These wines benefit greatly from the wonderful minerality characteristic of Carbonnieux and the Pessac-Léognan soil. The white Croix de Carbonnieux is a wine for Epicureans.

name: Côte Rotie Maison Les Alexandrins Rhône France 2023
description: Seductive deep-red dress with beautiful undertones. Complex, the nose offers a superb aromatic bouquet, harmoniously blending smoky notes reminiscent of ash with aromas of cherries, mocha, and delicate hints of minerality and graphite. The palate continues with elegance, featuring a beautiful balance, a dense and smooth texture with perfectly integrated silky tannins, and a long aromatic finish with notes of violet and licorice. A particularly refined wine that already provides great pleasure despite its youth.

name: Saint Joseph Maison Les Alexandrins Rhône France 2024
description: A beautiful, deep purple-red robe with garnet highlights. This wine opens with a superb, complex, and intense nose offering aromas of cherries, blackcurrants, and pepper, followed by notes of spice and toast that reveal aging in barrels and “demi-muids”. Rich and well-balanced, the palate is supported by a beautiful tannic structure with freshness and subtle tension, a mineral expression of this magnificent terroir. A wine of character, both powerful and approachable, that truly elevates Syrah.

name: Cornas Maison Les Alexandrins AOC Rhône France 2023
description: Beautiful deep-red colour with shimmering highlights. Intense, the nose reveals a complex aromatic bouquet with notes of black fruit and spices, such as cade wood and white pepper. Rich and opulent, the palate offers a beautiful density and silky, powerful tannins, typical of the terroir, which will delicately blend over time. Cornas in all its splendor, this powerful and elegant wine requires a few years of aging to reveal its full complexity.

name: Saint-Joseph Domaine E. Guigal Rhône France 2021
description: Filled with red fruit aromas and elegant tannins, this wine is a fine expression of this up-and-coming appellation from the northern Rhône.

name: La Vieille Ferme Rosé Rhône France 2025
description: Beautiful light pink colour, this lively an balanced wine offers a beautiful freshness, with delicate red fruits. on the palate, this very aromatic wine shows fresh fruits notes with a great persistence.

name: La Vieille Ferme White Rhône France 2025
description: Beautiful pale-yellow color, the bouquet is delicate white-flesh with an attractive aromatic intensity. the mouth is full of freshness, rich with mineral acidity. the final is aromatic and mouth-watering and has a lot of balance.

name: La Croix De Carbonnieux Pessac-Léognan Bordeaux France 2021
description: A fine ruby colour and a nose of red fruits with that smoky touch in the wines from Léognan that is so pleasant on the palate. A little less powerful than Carbonnieux and greatly appreciated in gastronomy it can be drunk young and lends itself to a large choice of wine and food pairings.

name: Château Tour du Roch-Milon Pauillac Bordeaux France 2020
description: Château Tour du Roch-Milon is a classic Pauillac with aromas of blackcurrant, light tobacco, and gentle spice. On the palate, it is medium-bodied and smooth, with fresh dark fruit flavors, soft tannins, and a balanced, slightly herbal finish.

name: La Vieille Ferme Red Rhône France 2024
description: Beautiful red color with purple highlights, with a lot of freshness, this rich and spicy wine offers red and black fruits aromas, the palate is beautifully balanced, crunchy, with silky tannins and a very long and aromatic finish.

name: Villa Antinori Rosso Toscana IGT Italy 2023
description: Villa Antinori is ruby red in color. The nose is intense, intriguing and presents fruity notes of black cherries and plum jam together with hints of boxwood, tobacco, and vanilla. The palate is mouth filling with supple, velvety tannins sustained by outstanding freshness and pleasant sapidity.

name: Peppoli Chianti Classico DOCG Tuscany Italy 2024
description: Pèppoli is a bright ruby red color. The nose is vibrant and expressive, offering fresh notes of cherries, raspberry jelly, and pomegranate juice with floral sensations of violets and geraniums. The palate is lively and dynamic: an energetic entry leads to a juicy, flavorful mid-palate followed by a long, savory finish characterized by soft, sweet tannins.

name: Guado al Tasso Marchesi Antinori DOC Bolgheri Tuscany Italy 2018
description: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and occasionally a small amount of Petit Verdot to best represent the complexity and elegance of the Bolgheri terroir. This wine has been produced since 1990 from vineyards on alluvial soils whose composition ranges from clay-sand to clay-loam with rocky deposits know as “scheletro”. The Guado al Tasso estate’s most characteristic geographic feature is the Bolgheri Amphitheater, a beautiful plain encircled by rolling hillsides that faces the Tyrrhenian Sea. The shape of the territory creates a unique microclimate with beneficial temperature fluctuations. The estate’s vineyards are located at the foot of the amphitheater, an optimal position as cold nocturnal breezes cool down the vines. These particular climatic conditions give the grapes pronounced aromas and guarantee a perfect ripening of the berries.

name: Barbaresco Prunotto DOCG Piedmont Italy 2021
description: Barbaresco is an intense garnet red color. The nose delivers complex aromas of red fruit and hints of spices. The palate is full-bodied, velvety and closes with a persistent aftertaste.

name: Château Musar Red Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2018
description: The Chateau Musar Red of this year is a dark blood red colour with a rich, fragrant fruit nose; mulberries, black cherries, plums with a hint of mocha. The palate is very intense and concentrated, it’s full of volume and characterised by forest and black fruits with elegant spice. The tannins are soft and juicy and it has a lengthy finish. Chateau Musar Red is a vibrantly powerful vintage and cellared well it will keep for decades. A great match for red meats, especially game, seasonal casseroles and mature cheeses.

name: Bourgogne Cuvée Latour Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2024
description: Bourgogne Blanc "Cuvée Latour" is made from a selection of the best Chardonnays from the Côte Chalonnaise. This results in a full-fledged totally authentic white Bourgogne with the consistency and finesse of the great white Villages. This wine has a pretty light golden colour with a slight greenish tint, a deep elegant aroma and a medium-full body with a gentle vanilla creaminess. An enchanting ensemble of fruit and acidity culminating in a strong, complete finish

name: Rose Elegance Bouquet
description: Exotica Our exquisite bouquet of 24 assorted roses with greenery, hand-crafted by our expert florists, complements any occasion with unforgettable style. Note: Because only the freshest roses are selected for this bouquet, actual rose colors will vary due to local availability.

name: IXSIR Arak 37.5cl
description: Produced using ancient traditional methods. IXSIR Arak is a tribute to the traditional Lebanese drink and its history. It is triple distilled from the finest Obeideh grapes, indigenous to Lebanon.

name: La Dame de Boüard AOC Montagne-Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2019
description: Medium-bodied with a pleasantly chewy texture and plenty of juicy red and black fruit in the mouth, it has an earthy finish.

name: Château Clou du Pin Red Bordeaux France 2023
description: The wine shows an elegant aroma, notes of woven black and red currants, underbrush, cedar, earth, and tar. The wine has a restrained, elegant but at the same time expressive taste with hints of fruit, well-balanced acidity and a long, pleasant aftertaste.

name: Chablis La Chanfleure Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2024
description: La Chanfleure is an old word used synonymously with "tâte-vin", it is actually the pipette used by the cellarmen to take some wine from the barrel to taste it during the vinification. We chose to link the term "La Chanfleure" to some of our wines in order to assign them an additional recognition element. Chablis is an isolated island of vineyards in the northern section of viticultural Burgundy. Maison Louis Latour's Chablis "La Chanfleure" is the ultimate expression of what the Chardonnay grape is capable of on the region's famous kimmeridgian limestone slopes. Chablis "La Chanfleure" 2023 has a bright and pale yellow colour. Its nose is floral with honeysuckle aromas. Round and fresh on the palate, it reveals hints of almond and lemon. Nice length.

name: Santa Cristina Campogrande DOC Orvieto Classico Italy 2024
description: Santa Cristina Bianco is a straw yellow in color. The nose is dominated by the intensely fruity notes of bananas and citrus fruit typical of Grechetto and Procanico, and by candied fruit, characteristic of Viognier as a variety. The palate is balanced, savory, and with a good freshness and softness along with the fruity notes which recall the aromas felt on the nose.

name: Villa Antinori Bianco IGT Tuscany Italy 2024
description: Villa Antinori Bianco is straw yellow in color with greenish hues. On the nose it is refined, elegant, fruity and floral with notes of banana, pineapple, white blossoms and candied fruit. The palate is balanced with good persistence and a mineral finish.

name: Brouilly Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2024
description: The name and reputation enjoyed by Brouilly, a Cru of Beaujolais, is a fairly recent phenomenon. The Brouilly is produced from grapes grown on the ideally situated southerly facing, pink granite slopes which gain maximum exposure to the sun's warming rays. As a result, the Gamay fruit produced here reaches maximum ripeness. Once harvested by hand, the fruit is fermented in whole bunches of grapes in open vats. Brouilly is a soft, perfumed wine, which marries tenderness with richness. Brouilly 2024 has an attractive garnet-red colour. The nose reveals notes of raspberry and blackberry. The palate is full and generous, with notes of undergrowth. Beautiful freshness, with a long, persistent finish.

name: Scarlet Kiss
description: 1x Bourgogne Red Cuvée Latour Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2023 10x Red Roses from Exotica

name: Love In Bloom
description: 1x Mionetto Prosecco DOC Rosé 75cl 10x Red Roses from Exotica

description: 1x Chablis Domaine des Malandes Burgundy France 2023 6x Red Roses from Exotica

description: 1x Mionetto Prosecco DOC Treviso Brut 1x Charcuterie Box for two from Eats Gourmets 1x Sablés Gourmets Chocolate Box

description: 1x Champagne Drappier Carte D'Or Brut 1x Charcuterie Box for two from Eats Gourmets 1x Sablés Gourmets Chocolate Box

description: 1x Château Ferran AOC Pessac-Léognan France 2019 1x Charcuterie Box for two from Eats Gourmets 1x Sablés Gourmets Chocolate Box

description: 1x Château Le Marin AOC Bordeaux France 2019 1x Charcuterie Box for two from Eats Gourmets 1x Sablés Gourmets Chocolate Box
