description: 1x Champagne Drappier Carte D'Or Brut 6x Red Roses from Exotica

name: Heart's Desire
description: 1x Château Sainte-Marie AOC Entre-Deux-Mers Bordeaux France 2024 1x Charcuterie Box for two from Eats Gourmets 1x Sablés Gourmets Chocolate Box

name: Bourgogne Red Cuvée Latour Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2023
description: Of a brilliant ruby color, our Bourgogne rouge "Cuvée Latour" reveals aromas of red fruits and undergrowth on the nose. The palate is ample with notes of blackcurrant, sour cherry and liquorice. Nice finish with silky tannins.

name: Santa Cristina Pinot Grigio DOC delle Venezie Italy 2024
description: Pinot Grigio Santa Cristina is straw yellow in color. The nose is delicate yet intense with aromas of bananas & citrus fruits. Its palate is well balanced, light and soft.

name: Pian delle Vigne DOCG Tuscany Brunello di Montalcino Italy 2020
description: Pian delle Vigne Brunello di Montalcino is ruby red in color. Complex on the nose with balsamic hints of menthol and cloves that lead over to fruity aromas of cherries, plums, dates, and notes of cinnamon. A soft and balanced entry on the palate is silky smooth, characterized by soft tannins and sustained by exceptional freshness. Flavors linger on the finish with aromas of vanilla and light hints of violets, typical of Sangiovese.

name: Tignanello Marchesi Antinori IGT Tuscany Italy 2022
description: Tignanello 2022 is intensely ruby red in color with purple hues. The wine opens impressively with aromas of cherries, ripe black cherries and pomegranate seeds with delicate notes of violets that lead to fresh balsamic hints. The bouquet is completed by elegant hints of vanilla and cotton candy. Supple savory tannins impart a dynamic impact on the palate, dense yet fresh. The wine closes with a lengthy finish that echoes aromas perceived on the nose.

name: Aloxe-Corton Bouchard P & F Burgundy France 2019
description: Notes of berry fruit on the nose. Originating in the Côte de Beaune but located on the border with the Côte de Nuits, this wine is an interesting blend of structure and elegance.

name: Château La Serre Grand Cru Classé Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2014
description: Château La Serre is a Merlot- and Cabernet Franc-dominated wine with aromas of blackberry, plum, licorice, and tobacco. On the palate, it is medium to full-bodied, juicy, and smooth, with well-integrated tannins and a long, creamy finish.

name: Clos de Vougeot Grand Cru Bouchard P & F Burgundy France 2017
description: This is exceptionally toasty and the oak fights with the pungently earthy red berry fruit aromas. There is outstanding richness and volume to the extract rich big-bodied flavors that possess excellent power and obvious muscle, all wrapped in a dynamic and explosively long finish.

name: Champagne Roederer Cristal Rosé Vintage 2014
description: Pink hue with slightly coppery tints. Dynamic bubbles forming a lingering bead. Pure, precise and dazzling bouquet. The intense Pinot noir aromas take us back to the harvest time with its pure, ripe and concentrated fruit: zesty red berries (red currants, wild raspberries, blackcurrants) and raspberry liqueur. Then come sweet spice and smoky notes with a hint of reduction (smoky, spicy) from the Pinot noir with its notes of undergrowth.

name: Château La Fleur-Pétrus Bordeaux France 2017
description: Château La Fleur-Pétrus is one of the most renowned vineyards of Pomerol. It is composed predominantly of Merlot, which lends silkiness and generosity to the wine. Cabernet Franc, planted on gravel and fine clay, contributes rigor and complexity, while a small percentage of Petit Verdot, planted on fine gravel, offers a hint of spice to the finish. The wine combines a unique elegance with the generosity and structure typical of the great vineyards of Pomerol. An attentive tasting reveals remarkable refinement, complexity, and a touch of violet.

name: Château La Conseillante Pomerol Bordeaux France 2016
description: Château La Conseillante exemplifies the elegant style of Pomerol. It offers aromas of raspberries, mulberries, and spring flowers. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with pure fruit, seamlessly integrated tannins, balanced acidity, and a soft, velvety finish. This classic wine is ethereal in its elegance and precision, showcasing the finesse characteristic of the estate.

name: Santa Cristina IGT Umbria Italy 2024
description: Santa Cristina Bianco is a straw yellow in color. The nose is dominated by the intensely fruity notes of bananas and citrus fruit typical of Grechetto and Procanico, and by candied fruit, characteristic of Viognier as a variety. The palate is balanced, savory, and with a good freshness and softness along with the fruity notes which recall the aromas felt on the nose.

name: Pommard Bouchard P & F Burgundy France 2016
description: Fruity and musky aromas with just the right touch of oak. Structured and firm, this wine has a pronounced personality. Full-bodied in its youth, it softens with age. Good ageing potential.

name: Collines de L'IF AOC Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2019
description: Second wine of the fabulous L'IF, the Saint-Émilion estate of Jacques Thienpont (owner of Le Pin). Intense aromas of dark fruit and oak barrels, with a hint of savory earth and old iron. The palate is full of rich blackberry and black cherry fruit, violets, and ripe tannin, dusty and long. A superb wine, all the more impressive given the challenges of the vintage.

name: Château de Beaucastel Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rhône France 2022
description: Magnificent deep-color of an intense ruby-red. Typical of Beaucastel, the nose is rich and complex but very fresh, with an opulent aromatic bouquet dominated by notes of fresh fruit and spices. Full-bodied, soft, eminently silky, this very elegant wine reveals a superb, dense structure on the palate, very fine tannins and gourmet aromas of fresh red fruit, currants and noble spices. The finish has great length, ample and harmonious. A fruity vintage with great aging potential.

name: Montecristo No.4
description: This Cuban cigar was constructed immaculately — with its smooth wrapper has very few veins and no hard or weak spots. It features a Marevas shape, which is considered the typical Habanos shape. You can expect bold earthy notes without being overpowering — with complements of fresh wood and a touch of spice.

name: E.P. Carrillo Triumph Trilogy
description: EP Carillo Triumph Trilogy brings together three of the finest cigars ever released into one package, offering a buffet of rich sumptuous savory flavors. 1 E.P. Carrillo Encore Majestic (5.38 x 52)- #1 rated cigar of 2018 by Cigar Aficionado-Rated 96 by Cigar Aficionado. 1 E.P. Carrillo Pledge Prequel (5 x 50)- #1 rated cigar of 2020 by Cigar Aficionado-Rated 98 by Cigar Aficionado. 1 E.P. Carrillo La Historia E-III (6.85 x 54)- #2 rated cigar of 2014 by Cigar Aficionado-Rated 94 by Cigar Aficionado.

name: La Flor Dominicana Sampler Selection Toro
description: If you’re a fan of LFD cigars and full-bodied yet flavorful cigars, then this sampler was made just for you. Each boxed sampler comes with the following toro-sized cigars: 2 x La Flor Dominicana Air Bender - a potent and spicy smoke with a rustic, red-hued Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. 2 x La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero - An ultra-strong cigar with a dark Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed Colorado maduro wrapper. 1 x La Flor Dominicana Ligero Cabinet Oscuro - A full-bodied smoke with a deep dark chocolatey Ecuadorian Sumatra-seed wrapper. 1 x La Flor Dominicana Ligero Natural - A potent cigar with a milk chocolatey Ecuadorian Habano wrapper. Packed with ligero leaves, it is hailed as LFD's first full-bodied cigar.

name: La Aurora Cameroon Gran Toro
description: La Aurora is known for its high-quality construction, and the Cameroon Gran Toro is no exception. It usually features a consistent and even burn, a firm ash, and a smooth draw, all of which contribute to a pleasurable and uninterrupted smoking experience.

name: Casa Turrent Origins Cuba
description: Mexico’s largest Tobacco producer. This farm, located in San André, is the largest in Mexico with 350 hectares dedicated to tobacco production. Known for years for its T-Amo and Revolution brands, the son takes over and manages the mixing, marketing and sales. Father and son are constantly in exchange and control their tobacco in the warehouse and factory.

name: Zino Nicaragua Toro
description: Zino Davidoff was an adventurer and a pioneer in the cigar world. He loved to discover and enjoy life to the fullest. Inspired by his personality, we have developed a cigar line that reflects his spirit and zest for life. This toro, seduces at first sight. Wrapped in a soft and silky Connectictut wrapper, it is easily lit. The first puffs offer notes of wood, undergrowth and spices. Little by little, the tempo accelerates, the aromas intensify with notes of leather and spices. The last third becomes more greedy with notes of cocoa and coffee with cream. A cigar of medium strength and greedy aromas.

name: Paradiso Quintessence Robusto Cigar
description: The La Aroma de Cuba brand was put on the market by Ashton Distributors Inc. in late 2002. At the time, the cigars were made in Honduras. A few years later, production halted and the brand was in a temporary transitional phase. Since the beginning, La Aroma de Cuba has promised to deliver the premium experience at a very reasonable price. This was Ashton's vision for the brand, and the company has kept its word.

name: La Flor Dominicana Double Ligero Maduro 654
description: La Flor Dominicana Double (LFD) Ligero DL-654 Maduro showcases the art of crafting powerful cigars, especially in its Grande size. Harvested from the top of the tobacco plant, Ligero leaves are renowned for their intense flavors. This blend doubles down on Ligero, making it one of the boldest cigars on the market. With Dominican binder and filler from their estate, enclosed in an Ecuadorian Sumatra sun-grown wrapper, it's a true powerhouse. La Flor Dominicana is famed for causing "cold sweats" among aficionados, and the DL-654 Maduro is no exception—prepare with a hearty meal before lighting up!

name: La Aroma Del Caribe Mi Amor Belicoso
description: The La Aroma de Cuba brand was put on the market by Ashton Distributors Inc. in late 2002. At the time, the cigars were made in Honduras. A few years later, production halted and the brand was in a temporary transitional phase. Today, La Aroma de Cubas are produced in Nicaragua at My Father Cigars. The brand is still owned by Ashton, but the company has expanded the La Aroma line by many degrees. Of all its different versions and extensions, Mi Amor has been a perennial high-performer within the pages of this magazine. The combination of dark, Mexican San Andrés wrapper with Nicaraguan filler has made it a go-to for fans of Nicaraguan cigars. The price is also attractive. Since the beginning, La Aroma de Cuba has promised to deliver the premium experience at a very reasonable price. This was Ashton's vision for the brand, and the company has kept its word.

name: Davidoff Winston Churchill The Late Hour Series Robusto
description: "The Late Hour Series" reflects the darkness during which Sir Winston was at his most creative. Davidoff has selected an oily Ecuadorian wrapper in a beautiful dark chocolate colour, introducing the first blend featuring tobacco aged in the finest Scotch single malt whisky casks. This Robusto format provides intensified flavours of wood, spice, coffee, dark chocolate, dark fruit and vintage leather, creating bold palate stimulation and a rich aroma.

name: Romeo Y Julieta Mille Fleurs
description: The Mille Fleurs, meaning “Thousand Flowers” , delivers a floral-forward experience with sweet cocoa and cedar notes. Medium in body, this 50-minute smoke develops hints of pepper and leather in the second third, making it a balanced and approachable Cuban cigar.

name: E.P. Carrillo Encore - Majestic
description: After the critically acclaimed La Historia Ernesto had to do it again and Encore was the only way. The second part to a series of cigars Encore is the master’s way of having another great performance for all to enjoy. We each have an encore in us and rise to that challenge when requested, just like the master Ernesto Perez-Carrillo. Awards Majestic: 2018 No. 1 Cigar of the Year – Cigar Aficionado rated 96

name: E.P. Carrillo Pledge - Prequel
description: “I will never stop working with the best tobaccos and bringing new and innovative blends to you.” – Ernesto Perez-Carrillo Jr. From the same legendary brand that brought you La Historia and Encore, E. P. Carrillo Cigars proudly presents Pledge – a Bold Expression from the master himself and the highest rated Cigar Aficionado Cigar of the Year for 2020, gaining a 98 point rating and becoming an instant classic. Awards Prequel: 2020 No. 1 Cigar of the Year – Cigar Aficionado rated 98 Prequel: Tobacco Business Best Dominican Cigar of 2021 Prequel: Cigar Journal Best Dominican Cigar of 2021 Prequel: Cigar Dojo Cigar of the Year 2020

name: Edición Roja Nueve
description: Introducing the coveted archetype of modern cigar innovation: Edición Roja. An Edición Roja cigar is carefully designed with Amour in mind. It is to be experienced, not merely smoked. Crafted with care, every cigar tells the story of a unique blend of spicy sweetness, soft allure, and creamy embrace. Sense the ambience change as soon as an Edición Roja is lit. Notice its fragrant aroma waltzing across the air as a savory, piquant taste gently lingers on your lips. Edición Roja, where passion meets luxury.

name: E.P. Carrillo New Wave Connecticut Brillantes
description: Connecticut-wrapped cigars have long been a staple in the cigar world, but only Ernesto Perez-Carrillo can take a Connecticut and turn it on its head. Introducing the New Wave Connecticut cigar, a blend that is anything but typical. Designed to be rich and flavorful with a surprising kick of spice, this cigar redefines what a Connecticut can be. Awards 92 Points Cigar Aficionado: Feb 01, 2024 89 Points Cigar Aficionado: Aug 01, 2020

name: Gold Edition Pequeño
description: A symphony of opulence and craftsmanship, Gold Edition stands as a masterpiece of lavish splendor and exquisite artistry. Each cigar is meticulously fashioned using only the finest aged tobacco leaves, culminating in a matchless smoking experience that caters to the most discerning connoisseurs. Enrobed in a carefully aged jewel of a leaf, its intricate and sumptuous flavors recount a tale of magnificence, quality, and complexity. Gold Edition Cigars are a statement of prestige, a testament to the consummate art of fine living. Indulge in a Gold Edition Cigar and relish the essence of creamy refinement.

name: Gold Edition Gran Robusto
description: A symphony of opulence and craftsmanship, Gold Edition stands as a masterpiece of lavish splendor and exquisite artistry. Each cigar is meticulously fashioned using only the finest aged tobacco leaves, culminating in a matchless smoking experience that caters to the most discerning connoisseurs. Enrobed in a carefully aged jewel of a leaf, its intricate and sumptuous flavors recount a tale of magnificence, quality, and complexity. Gold Edition Cigars are a statement of prestige, a testament to the consummate art of fine living. Indulge in a Gold Edition Cigar and relish the essence of creamy refinement.

name: Introduction to Wine Tasting
description: Join us for an introduction to wine tasting led by Henri Debbane. This session will guide you through the basics of wine, helping you understand aromas, flavors, and how to taste wine with confidence. A relaxed and enjoyable experience designed for anyone curious to learn and appreciate wine more deeply. 🍷 Secure your spot by paying online or at the store. Limited spots available.

name: Champagne Roederer Brut Rosé Vintage 2013 Magnum 1.5L
description: A light, bright and clear rosé. Fabulous! Fine, steady stream of bubbles, evenly distributed across the glass. On the palate the wine is soft and smooth yet also piercingly fresh. A well-integrated wine with excellent body, pleasant freshness, long length and delicate mouthfeel. The body softens gradually and coats the palate with a velvety smoothness underpinned by a pleasant salinity and delicate hints of tannin from the flesh and skins of the Pinot noir grape. The finish is fresh, long and very persistent.

name: Champagne Roederer Brut Blanc de Blancs Vintage 2017
description: Intense yellow hue with bright, luminous tints. An even flow of creamy, ultra-fine bubbles. Bouquet of harvest (almonds), spring flowers (honeysuckle) and citrus (lemon). Juicy and rounded, the wine is drawn out into a fresh, powdery finish. The palate crescendos like a torrent of white mountain water, with a lingering sweetness from the wood ageing complementing the saline length and structure imparted by the white chalk of Avize.

name: IXSIR Grande Réserve Rosé Lebanon 2025
description: IXSIR ROSE 2025

name: IXSIR Grande Réserve White Lebanon 2025
description: Looking at IXSR Grande Reserve White, the eye is seduced by its pure golden hue. The nose is enticed by an explosion of white flowers, peach and citrus fruits. The palate is enthralled by a nice equilibrium between mellowness and liveliness that leaves a final, equally wooden taste, which gives the wine a highly distinctive character.

name: IXSIR Altitudes Red Lebanon Limited Edition 2022 - Reve Mjabber
description: Floating leaves and a serene girl drifting above Beirut's vibrant nights, this artwork captures our ability to let go and float our troubles away. It highlights how we've kindled our souls amidst beauty and struggles, with the city's lights shining like hopeful dreams, illuminating peaceful nights full of endless possibility.

name: IXSIR Altitudes Red Lebanon Limited Edition 2022 - Maya Akiki
description: Beirut is everywhere: seen from distant mountain campfires, from rooftops, or as a memory of joy and tradition. Like fireflies at night, Beirut is magical and glowing, reminding us of its everlasting light.

name: IXSIR Grande Réserve Red Lebanon Limited Edition 2019
description: This year, the special design by Oscar Hassrouthy captures the IXSIR emblem sparkling with hope, a reflection of Lebanon's spirit and the light that continues to inspire.

name: IXSIR Altitudes Red Lebanon Limited Edition 2022 - Luciana Hobeika
description: The soul of Beirut isn't just in its buildings or streets but in the light its people bring. With every corner lit, we remind ourselves that warmth doesn't come from the streets alone, it comes from us.

name: Yamazaki 12 Years Old Single Malt Japanese Whisky
description: The Yamazaki whisky is Suntory's flagship single malt whisky, from Japan’s first and oldest malt distillery. With a range of options from Yamazaki Distiller's Reserve to 12, 18, and 25 years old, all of these prized whiskies contain carefully blended components aged in American, Spanish, and Japanese Mizunara oak.

name: Mortlach The Katana's Edge - Diageo Special Releases 2023 Whisky 70cl
description: From the Diageo Special Releases 2023 comes this Mortlach expression, ‘The Katana’s Edge’, a Speyside Scotch finished in Kanosuke Japanese whisky and Pinot Noir casks. It was bottled at 58% ABV and its intriguing cask profile is matched by its blend of sweet and savoury flavours.

name: The Macallan 18 Years Old 2020 Release Double Cask Single Malt Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: Nose of rich dried fruits (raisins/sultanas), ginger, orange peel, vanilla and cinnamon. Palate soft and rich with mature oak, spice, clove and citrus. Finish lingering with toasted oak, dried fruit and a warming ginger/orange zest edge.

name: The Macallan 18 Years Old 2021 Release Double Cask Single Malt Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: Nose opens with dried figs/raisins, orange zest, subtle clove and nutmeg plus wood tones. On the palate caramel, toffee, dark cherries, cinnamon, roasted almonds and sherry-influenced oak. The finish is long and elegant, with lingering dried fruit, oak spice and gentle warmth.

name: Niño sin Amor Tepeztate Mezcal 70cl
description: Carefully produced from an exclusive selection of 12-15 year old AGAVE AMERICANA VAR. OAXACENSIS agave , this mezcal captures the essence of the Mexican countryside in every sip.

name: Niño sin Amor Arroqueño Mezcal 70cl
description: Carefully produced from an exclusive selection of AMERICANA VAR. OAXACENSIS agave 10-15 years old , this mezcal captures the essence of the Mexican countryside in every sip.

name: Niño sin Amor Ensamble Mezcal 70cl
description: Carefully produced from an exclusive selection of 8-15 year old ANGUSTIFOLIA AND POTATORUM agaves, this mezcal captures the essence of the Mexican countryside in every sip.

name: Niño sin Amor Espadín Mezcal 70cl
description: Carefully produced from an exclusive selection of 6-8 year old ANGUSTIFOLIA HAW agave, this mezcal captures the essence of the Mexican countryside in every sip.

name: G4 Blanco Tequila 70cl
description: The purest expression of Blue Weber agave, G4 Blanco is authentic and approachable with a delicate minerality and gentle aroma derived from agave and spring water from their own farm, collected rainwater, and their Grandfather’s yeast. These are the only ingredients in G4. Clear, crisp flavors and a silky texture make it a hit with tequila lovers across the board.

name: Dominus Estate Christian Moueix Napa Valley California USA 2012
description: A magical blend of 93% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Petit Verdot and 2% Cabernet Franc, this estate-crafted blend exudes elegance, etching out silos of herb, lavender, cedar and earth around savory-laced texture. A powerful concentration of dark chocolate appears on the lengthy finish, the wine sourced from dry-farmed, impeccably tended vines. Cellar through 2027." - 95/100, Wine Enthusiast

name: Jose Cuervo Especial Reposado Tequila 70cl
description: Produced by the famous Jose Cuervo company, Especial Gold is a blend of reposado and unaged blanco Tequilas - It's a perfect choice for making Margarita cocktails- and has a mild agave flavour.

name: Teeling Irish Whiskey Small Batch Gold Gift Box 70cl + 2x Glasses
description: Teeling Small Batch Irish Whiskey is the flagship of our award-winning Irish Whiskey range. It is a celebration of our spirit of innovation here at Teeling Whiskey, with each step of the process imparting a distinct character unique to us. Hand-selected casks of grain and malt whiskey are initially fully aged in ex-bourbon barrels, then married together in Central American rum casks for up to 12 months for a unique, dried fruit profile.

name: The Famous Grouse Sherry Cask Finish Blended Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: The full blend is married in ex-sherry casks to further enhance their sweet, rich, and smooth characters. The Sherry Cask Finish is a decadent blend of festive flavours including chocolate, almonds, dried fruits, and sweet spices.

name: The Famous Grouse Blended Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: Balanced, biscuit-laden palate with a core of thick, creamy malt. Just a hint of spice and the vaguest whisper of smoke really bring a great deal of complexity.

name: Johnnie Walker Gold Reserve Blended Scotch Whisky 75cl
description: A soft and sweet arrival with honey, vanilla, toffee, and butterscotch, all of which are delivered by a noticeably light and waxy/silky texture. A gentle apple flavour arrives after a couple of sips and there seems to be a slight banana flavour in there too. As the fruit pokes through, there is a slowly building spice and apple turnover set of flavours. The smoke note from the nose barely registers as the spices start to take hold.

name: Oban 10 Years Old Coastal Orchard - Diageo Special Releases 2024 Single Malt Whisky 70cl
description: Nose: light and seemingly high-pitched, with something in between pine needles and white flowers. Green apple, along with grassy notes and lemon. Salty sea air comes out, with a light hint of mustard. Green oak spice (nutmeg and pepper) adds to the sharpness. Mouth: a layer of sweet fruits (tart apples, stewed peaches, sultanas), but pungent spice quickly overshadows the fruitiness. Ginger, white pepper and quite some salty notes again. Then firm peppermint and almost a rye element as well. More floral notes. There’s a hint of salted caramel and walnuts underneath, but it’s less sherried than I expected. Finish: medium length, with more oak spice, a bit of peppery heat and citrus.

name: Benriach The Twelve Single Malt Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: To make Benriach Twelve, Benriach spirit is three cask matured for at least twelve years in sherry casks, bourbon barrels and port casks. The whisky from each cask is then expertly married together to create a smooth, sherry-rich single malt, layered with baked fruit, maple honey and cocoa, perfectly balanced with a lingering sultana and spiced mocha finish.

name: Benriach The Original Ten Single Malt Scotch Whisky 70cl
description: The Original Ten encapsulates the signature smooth and multi-layered character of Benriach. Three cask matured for at least ten years in bourbon barrels, sherry casks and virgin oak, to create layers of luscious orchard fruit, sumptuous honeyed malt and toasted oak, all interwoven with a subtle trace of smoke.The perfect introduction to our signature style and richly layered Speyside Single Malt.

name: Domaine de l'Olivette Bandol France 2014
description: Domaine de l'Olivette Bandol shows a deep ruby hue with aromas of blackberries, ripe plums, garrigue herbs, and hints of leather and spice. On the palate, it is full-bodied and structured, with firm yet integrated tannins, layers of dark fruit, earthy undertones, and a long, savory finish that reflects the classic Mourvèdre-driven style of Bandol.

name: Beluga Noble Vodka 70cl + 1x FREE Glass
description: A superb super-premium Vodka made using non-GM ingredients. It's quite rare that a vodka (or any white spirit for that matter) impresses us to the point of wanting to tell people about it. Beluga is one of those rare spirits. Well worth a go. Light oat and citrus sweetness, with a mellow touch of honey coming through. Hints of spice develop.

name: Kamiki Sakura Wood Blended Malt Japanese Whisky 50cl
description: Inspired by the sacred Sakura Tree which symbolizes the fragility of life with its beautiful yet short-lived blossoms, we have finished our Kamiki Whisky at Sakura casks after aging in Yoshino Sugi casks. Nose: Cherry candy with ripe banana, chestnuts, and cinnamon on the nose. Palate: Woodiness, sandalwood, and gentle spice, before sweet Sakura pedals. Finish: Spicy cherry with savory notes, leading to a floral, spring-like finish.

name: Dimple 15 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky 75cl
description: The key characteristic of Dimple is how light and understated it is. The nose is floral and toffee and caramel sweet, underscored by a dry woody note. The flavor has a medium-bodied, butterscotch and toffee character, with a light, but still spicy pepper note and a tinge of dry wood. The flavor unfolds off the pepper, leaving a restrained afterglow with light warmth.

name: Latourba Chardonnay Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2022
description: Latourba’s single vineyard Chardonnay, aged in barrels, bright yellow-gold with rich peach, pineapple and citrusy scents. Rich honeyed mouthfeel with great acidity, flavors of tropical fruits on a background of smoke and dried fruits . aromas of peach, pineapple, ripe citrus, mango, smoked, oak, creamy.

name: Latourba Litaj Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2016
description: Deep red colour with purple hues, aromas of red fruits, spices, black pepper, dark chocolate and mint. Round, full-bodied palate, complex with vibrant acidity and strong, well-structured tannins. Long lasting aftertaste with flavors of cedar, dark forest fruits and tobacco.

name: Latourba Petit Verdot Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2018
description: Latourba’s single vineyard Petit Verdot combines the unique aromas of leather, prune, dark forest fruits and tobacco. Aged in barrels with an earthy texture, it moves with vibrant acidity and powerful, well-structured tannins.

name: Kristina de Latourba Sparkling Brut Rosé Wine
description: A dedication to the queen of Latourba. A luminous salmon-pink sparkling with delicate bubbles, offering bright aromas of fresh strawberries, raspberries and red currant. On the palate it’s crisp and playful with juicy cherry and raspberry jam flavours, finishing clean and lingering with a subtle creamy mousse.

name: Latourba Unique Sparkling Brut White Wine
description: Unique is the first Lebanese sparkling wine ever made. Bright and elegant with fine bubbles, notes of green apple, citrus, and brioche. Crisp, refreshing, and perfectly balanced with a clean, dry finish.

name: Marqués de Riscal Arienzo Crianza DOC Rioja Spain 2019
description: A fresh, fruity wine with a lovely attack, bringing a reminder of red-berried fruit mingling with the coconut and vanilla aromas from the oak. Full and supple with a long finish. A wine with a character which showcases the quality of the grapes used to make it.

name: Mionetto Prosecco DOC Rosé 20cl
description: This Rosé is the result of soft pressing of red and white grapes (Pinot Noir + Glera). Peach blossom color with shiny reflections accompanied by a fine, lively perlage. Intense fragrant, fruity nose with hints of violet, raspberry, morello cherry and wild strawberry.

name: Mionetto Prosecco DOC Treviso Brut
description: Made from 100% Glera grape, light straw in color with bright yellow highlights. Aromas of golden apples, peach and honey. Well-balanced acidity provides a fresh and lively mouthfeel with a clean dry finish.

name: Château Lagrugère Bordeaux Supérieur France 2022
description: Château Lagrugère is located in the heart of the Entre-Deux Mers region just east of Bordeaux, the broad region of rolling hills and mixed farming between the Garonne and the Dordogne rivers, hence the name “between the two waters” or “between the two seas.” Today a château in the Entre-Deux-Mers will often produce both a red and a white wine, depending on the nature of the terroir.

name: Marqués de Riscal DOC Rueda Spain 2024
description: A bright, straw-yellow coloured wine. As you expect from a verdejo wine, on the nose it has high aromatic intensity, with tropical fruit and hints of fennel and fresh grass. In the mouth it is both syrupy smooth and refreshing, with a slightly bitter finish which is typical of the variety making it long and pleasant to drink. Overall it is a fresh, well-balanced wine.

name: EL IXSIR White Lebanon 2022
description: Clear limpid color with golden touches. Wine with elegant and delicate aromas of flowers, white-fleshed fruits, infused plants and spices, underpinned by a subtle complexity. On the palate the purity of a great Viognier blends with the fullness of Chardonnay to deliver a smooth yet firm wine with a remarkable elegance, minerality, and depth.

name: EL IXSIR Red Lebanon 2020
description: A deep purple-ruby color. Nice complexity of aromas with red fruits, blackberry liqueur, touches of incense, and notes of mint and cedar sap. The palate a continuation of the nose, suave and intense, with a nice mineral tension characteristic of great limestone terroirs. A fresh finish and an extended length which reveals a great aging aptitude.

name: IXSIR Grande Réserve Red Lebanon 2019
description: Rich in minerals and saturated with Mediterranean character, this wine unleashes exuberant aromas of mature fruits and spices. Its concentrated taste enrobed in a fine texture gives it an attractive liveliness, while its rich and mellow yet always-complex palate lasts until the final touch of fruit.

name: Château St. Thomas Red Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2018
description: An intense and deep ruby red robe. A complex nose of conifers, spices, rosemary, ginger and chocolate, confirm the very beautiful aromatic potential of Chateau St Thomas. The palate is delighted to taste the harmony and generosity of this rich wine. Well-melted round tannins with rich remarkable persistence. Full bodied wine with a great personality.

name: Ksara Château Rouge Bekaa Valley Lebanon 2019
description: A Bordeaux blend with a splash of Mediterranean sunshine. Full-bodied, filled notes of red and black fruit, cedar and bell peppers. Can benefit from being put down – especially the younger vintages – or drunk immediately. Our older Château vintages are constantly evolving. As a rule of thumb, those who want a dominant fresh fruit and spice should opt for the younger vintages, while those who look for a wider spectrum of flavors will enjoy the older releases. It is also fun to buy various vintages and compare them with friends.

name: Barolo Prunotto DOC Piedmont Italy 2020
description: Barolo is garnet red in color. The nose is complex and generous with pleasing notes of violets and forest undergrowth. On the palate, it is well balanced with velvety tannins.

name: Condrieu Domaine E. Guigal Rhône France 2016
description: This white wine has remarkably pure aromas complimented by a soft roundness. A typical expression of the Viognier grape with its aromas of white peach and apricot. Brilliant clear golden yellow. Intensely flowery (violets), and fruity (apricot, peaches and citrus) on the nose. Fresh and round.

name: Les Jardins de Babylone Didier Dagueneau Jurançon France 2009
description: Thick and liqueur-like, good strong sweetness and a solid streak of acidity that brings a brightness, a vivacity to the wine; orange peels and honeysuckle on the nose, pineapple and tropical fruits; flavors of tangerine and Grand Marnier, fresh and bright; spice and nuts on the long finish... worthy of great cellars, this outstanding, truly exotic dessert wine must be experienced.

name: Château Bourgneuf Pomerol Bordeaux France 2016 Magnum 1.5L
description: Wonderful creamed black fruits are allied to smoky, tarry notes on the palate to give a gloriously pitch-perfect rendition of Pomerol in 2011. Black Forest cake notes leading the way, followed by loam, plum sauce, roasted fig and singed alder flavors that form the core and finish.

name: Château Bélair-Monange Premier Grand Cru Classé Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2014
description: Incredibly perfumed aromas of roses and violets, as well as blue fruit and lavender. Full-bodied and powerful, yet so full of finesse and vibrance. The height of elegance! Such depth of chalk and dark berries. It goes on for minutes.

name: Château Grand Village Bordeaux Supérieur France 2018
description: Grand Village Rouge is a red wine coupage made mainly using Merlot with a lower percentage of Cabernet Franc. It is made by the Château Grand Village and is classified as AOC Bordeaux Supérieur.

name: Château Lagrange Pomerol Bordeaux France 2017
description: Supple, round, generous and fruit-driven, Château Lagrange is a delightful expression of the lighter style of Pomerol wines, approachable in its youth.

name: Fugue de Nénin Pomerol Bordeaux France 2019
description: Strawberry and cherry on the nose, hints of raspberry confiture and wood oak. Firm tannins and polished finish. Pair this wine with all types of classic meat dishes, hearty fish courses like tuna, mushrooms and pasta. Blend: 95% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc.

name: Baron de Brane Margaux Bordeaux France 2020
description: The second wine of Château Brane Cantenac (2éme Cru Classé), the Baron de Brane consists of 60% Merlot and 30% Cabernet Sauvignon with small additions of Cabernet Franc and Carmenère that add depth and flavor dimension to the final wine. Black cherry, cassis, and coffee all jump out of the glass, combining with a punchy palate full of dark ripe fruits. There is a touch of tobacco that provides a warming spice to the finish, while silky, ripe tannins create a rich and glossy mouthfeel. This is a very good example of the quality you can find in a property’s second wine.

name: Gevrey Chambertin Bouchard P & F Burgundy France 2020
description: Made from Pinot Noir grape, rich in texture, laced with black cherry, pomegranate and violets notes. Showing hints of iron and earth, and long finish and sappy.

name: Chassagne-Montrachet Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2023
description: Chassagne-Montrachet is located to the south of Puligny-Montrachet in the Côte de Beaune and is one of Burgundy's greatest white wine appellations. It produces all appellations from village to Grand Cru. The word Chassagne comes from either the Latin 'cassanea' which means an oak wood, or 'cassanus' which means oak. Until the late 19th century the main settlement of this commune was known as Chassagne-le-Haut. However, in 1879, in common with other villages in the Côte d'Or, the village was allowed to change its name replacing le Haut with name of their most famous Grand Cru Montrachet. The village appellation covers just over half of Chassagne-Montrachet. Chassagne-Montrachet 2023 has a bright, pale yellow colour. Its nose reveals notes of yellow peach and a hint of muscatel, while its ample, generous palate highlights aromas of fresh almond, apricot and honey.

name: Château La Grande Métairie Bordeaux France 2022
description: Deep color and an intense smell of red fruit and blackcurrant. On the palate, it has soft tannins, with roundness, and it's well balanced with generous fresh fruit.

name: Pinot Grigio Villa D'Adige DOC delle Venezie Veneto Italy 2024
description: Straw yellow color, it has vaguely greenish reflections. The scent is delicate, pleasing but rather intense and sharp. Immediate, characteristic, with hints of acacia flowers. Dry, warm, structured and substantially harmonious flavor.

name: Miraval Famille Perrin & Brad Pitt Côtes de Provence France 2024
description: Miraval rosé is a wonderful blend of fruits aromas and freshness, made on an exceptional terroir in Provence. Attractive bright and translucent colour, a typical Provencal pale pink. The nose immediately reveals all the elegance of this Miraval Rosé with its superb aromatic bouquet delicately combining fresh fruit, freshly cut currants and roses, seasoned with a zest of lemon. The refinement continues on the palate with an ample, rich and gourmet texture, perfectly balanced by the natural acidity and minerality with saline and limestone notes specific to Miraval which continue in a long finish. A typical Miraval vintage with signature flavours. Wine Spectator 90/100 Wine Enthusiast 92/100

A bottle worth keeping long after the last sip!

name: The Chita Single Grain Japanese Whisky 70cl
description: This is a single grain whisky from the Chita peninsula in Aichi Prefecture (near Okazaki, or Mikawa region, famous for brewing soy sauce, making miso and arguably Japan's best macha). This distillery has very much 'flown under the radar'. Suntory even asked Nonjatta, the premium Japanese whisky blog, to leave it off their map of Japanese distilleries. Elegant and approachable, deliciously sweet stuff.

name: Morey-Saint-Denis Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2022
description: Our Morey-Saint-Denis 2022 has a dark ruby colour. Its nose offers scents of blackberry, blackcurrant and mocha, while its smooth, fresh palate reveals aromas of nutmeg, cherry and pepper. Nice tannic structure.

name: Château Ferran AOC White Pessac-Léognan France 2023
description: With beautiful ripe fruit expressing notes of yellow fruits and more exotic nuances like pineapple and green mango, it is already so appealing! The palate offers a lovely balance between richness and freshness, with a high-quality finish that provides great balance, delicacy, and refinement, promising excellent aging potential.

name: Les Fillottes Thienpont Pomerol Bordeaux France 2020
description: Lavish and aromatic on the nose with lots of blackberry, dark-chocolate and hazelnut character. It’s full-bodied with layers of ripe, chewy tannins and a beautiful cappuccino and berry aftertaste. 85% merlot and 15% cabernet franc.

name: Taylor's Port The Globe - Historical Collection IV
description: A deep, reddish-brown core is framed by a slender brick-red rim. The nose, rich andmature, opens with inviting aromas of coffee, butterscotch, and dried fruit, complementedby hints of plum and raisin. Surrounding this sumptuous heart are delicate layers of spice,wood, and nuttiness, as well as subtle floral notes, offering the wine a refined, intricate,and alluring complexity. On the palate, it is full-bodied and dense, with a smooth, velvetytexture. The flavours of indulgent toffee and preserved fruit linger, leading to a long,warming finish. This wine is a stunning representation of the traditional craft of cask ageingand blending,with each element harmoniously integrated to enhance both aroma and flavour.

name: Montrose Reserve Cognac Hors D'Age 70cl
description: Montrose released only 3,000 bottles of its finely crafted cognac, bolstering a collectors-only demand. Any true cognac connoisseur will understand the importance of balancing specific vintages to achieve the smoothest blend. Montrose’s Grande Champagne Hors d’Age cognac derives its earthy complexity and brightness from an equal blend of the ‘30s, ‘50s and ‘70s vintages. This 2014 bottling offers a lively and balanced profile, with candied bergamot and charred peel adding strong character to the rich grape profile.

name: Tertio de Montrose Saint-Estèphe Bordeaux France 2019
description: The colour is a deep garnet red. The intense nose reveals spicy aromas and a bouquet of fresh fruit accompanied by toasted and toasted notes. The attack is straightforward. The full and greedy mouth reveals generous tannins and nice freshness on the finish.

name: Filia de Grand Mayne Grand Cru Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2019
description: Deep purple colour and pronounced aromas of red and black fruit, matched with a ripe, medium-bodied palate with smooth tannins.

name: Annonce de Bélair-Monange Grand Cru Saint-Emilion Bordeaux France 2015 Magnum 1.5L
description: Annonce enjoys the same attention as the Grand Vin: meticulous vineyard work undertaken with respect for the environment followed by a manual harvest once the grapes have reached optimal maturity. Vinification takes place in concrete and stainless-steel vats, where maceration and extraction are gentle and measured in order to allow the fruit its highest expression. The wine is then aged in French oak barrels. Although Annonce exhibits great charm in its youth, a few years of cellaring or a few hours of decanting will be largely rewarded.

name: Haut-Batailley Verso 2nd Wine Pauillac Bordeaux France 2018
description: Visually, Verso Haut-Batailley 2018 displays a beautiful colour with purple hues. On the nose, primary aromas are mostly fruity with spicy notes and a hint of balsamic. The attack is full with refined tannin structure and dense and round mouthfeel.

name: Château Suduiraut Lions de Suduiraut Blanc Sec Bordeaux France 2023
description: With a pale yellow colour, Lions de Suduiraut Blanc Sec 2023 reveals an open and very fresh nose. It offers discreet floral notes, as well as citrus fruits such as grapefruit and lemon, followed by a touch of minerality. After a round and fresh attack, the palate develops a fleshy, crisp character with aromas of pear, granny smith and a lemony mineral note. The finish is taut and mineral, with citrus zest. This vintage is easy to digest, well-balanced, invigorating and accessible. A fine vintage to enjoy now and over the next five years.

name: Les Chênes de Macquin Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2019
description: Les Chênes (‘the oaks’) come from the trees planted as ornaments and emblems of the cru along the edge of the plateau. Selection is a major part of the quest for excellence: at Pavie Macquin, vineyards are cultivated and harvested in small increments when each vine is perfectly ripe, followed by aging of several plots. This mosaic of wines, vinified and aged separately, is used to create two final wines: the first is Château Pavie Macquin, and the second Les Chênes de Macquin. In each vintage, the generosity and the typicity of the site are expressed.

name: L'Etoile Lalande-de-Pomerol Bordeaux France 2020
description: Cherries, plums, chocolate, flowers and wet earth nuances fill the perfume. On the palate, the wine is medium-bodied, fresh, forward, soft, and loaded with all the chocolate-coated plums with a touch of licorice that you could ask for. This is already tasting great. Produced from a blend of 85% Merlot with 15% Cabernet Franc, you can enjoy it on release over the next 10-12 years.

name: Chianti DOCG Parolvini Tuscany Italy 2023
description: A vivid and brilliant red wine. The aroma is fine and fragrant, with notes of fresh fruit. The taste is harmonious, rounded and very elegant.

name: Barone Nero Parolvini IGT Veneto Italy 2023
description: Intense red color with violet shades. Full taste, Dry, sapid and consistent. Fruity scent with notes of ripe cherry. It maintains intact the characteristic drinkability and enjoyment.

name: Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie Magna Terra DOC Italy 2024
description: White wine a very light coppery reflex. Wisteria and exotic fruits scents. Dry & saline taste. Medium alcohol. All-around in pairing with food specially with seafood & vegetables recipes.

name: Liebherr WPbsi 5252 Vinidor Multi-temprature Wine Storage Fridge
description: Exterior dimensions: height/width/depth 185.4 / 59.7 / 67.5 cm Adjustable temperature range +5 °C to +20 °C Maximum number of 0.75 l Bordeaux bottles 155 Temperature zones 2 Energy efficiency class F Connectivity solution integrated , fixed

name: Les Hauts de Smith Pessac-Léognan Bordeaux France 2019
description: This wine has a dark red, almost black colour. The nose is redolent of fresh fruit (raspberries, cherries, strawberries) and, after swirling in the glass, more complex notes of spice, dried herbs, fennel, and a slight floral nuance. The wine is straightforward and well-balanced on the palate, with good concentration and plenty of volume. Despite a substantial quantity of tannin, it remains smooth and rich, with excellent balance between substance, density and freshness. The texture is delicate and precise. The finish is very long and complex with fresh red fruit, liquorice and cinnamon, as well as more terroir-induced notes of smoke and flint.

name: Riesling Hugel Alsace France 2023
description: At first this Riesling’s aromas are dashing, well-stated and floral, opening with hints of lily of the valley, elderflower and lively citrus zest. With age it takes on rocky hints of flint, tinder, hydrocarbons. The perfectly dry flavor detonates with life, energy and a clearly stated attack that remains without greenness and opens up the appetite. Lemon, lime and yuzu zest roll around the mouth right up to the acidic, delicate and addictive final note.

name: Liebherr WPbI 4201 Grand Cru Wine Storage Fridge
description: Exterior dimensions: height/width/depth 128.4 / 59.7 / 76.3 cm Adjustable temperature range +5 °C to +20 °C Maximum number of 0.75 L Bordeaux bottles 141 Noise level 38 dB Connectivity solution retrofittable

name: Taylor's Porto Very Very Old Port
description: The VVOP is the latest in a series of limited releases of very fine and rare Ports drawn from Taylor’s treasury of very very old cask-aged reserves. This unique blend is one of the oldest wines released to date. It is made from a selection of rare lots matured in wood in Taylor’s cellars, some of which have been quietly concentrating to a magical quintessence since before the Second World War. Deep chestnut brown at the centre gradually fading to amber and a narrow edge of pale straw at the rim. The age of this magical Port is immediately evident. It represents the pinnacle of what long wood ageing can achieve particularly when skilful blending provides additional definition and symmetry. The wine has the precision and intricacy of a watch movement, all its complex elements working together in harmony. The nose is intense but finely constituted and the aromas remarkably delicate and ethereal given its great age. Undertones of butterscotch, dried figs and freshly ground coffee intermingle with marzipan and sultana to give the wine an opulent, plum pudding character but this remains discreetly in the background and is lifted by fresh notes of orange peel and apricot. Hints of vanilla, cedar wood and cinnamon provide a subtle spicy redolence. On the palate the wine has a light touch displaying bright acidity and perfect balance but holds massive reserves of aroma which emerge on the long finish in a seemingly endless mellow surge. Very few Ports retain such balance and finesse after so many years maturing in cask.

name: Liebherr WTpes 5972 Vinidor Wine Chiller
description: Energy efficiency class A Product dimensions (H/W/D) 192 / 70.0 / 74.2 cm Net capacity, total 516 Maximum number of 0.75 l Bordeaux bottles 155 Temperature zones 2 Individual temperature zones 2 Connectable (SmartDevice-capable)

name: Liebherr WPbli 5031 GrandCru Selection Wine Storage Fridge
description: Exterior dimensions: height/width/depth 168.4 / 59.7 / 76.3 cm Energy efficiency class A+ Adjustable temperature range +5 °C to +20 °C Maximum number of 0.75 l Bordeaux bottles 196

name: Distillerie de Paris Single Malt French Whisky 50cl
description: Crafted in the heart of Paris, this distinctive French single malt reveals a vibrant character from the first pour. On the nose, it opens with smoky hints of damp peat, smoked bacon, and black pepper, layered with candied orange, dried apricot, and subtle herbal tones. The palate is smooth and expressive, offering a balance of malted grain, licorice, ginger spice, and caramelized notes, followed by touches of rhubarb, milk chocolate, and marmalade. Aged in a mix of new oak and chestnut barrels, it finishes long and warming with earthy undertones, toasted wood, and a whisper of medicinal herbs. A bold, modern whisky that captures the creative spirit of Paris.

name: Yoichi Non Age Single Malt Japanese Whisky 70cl
description: Yoichi Single Malt is a range of single malt expressions from the Yoichi Distillery, Nikka's first distillery built in 1934. The founder Masataka Taketsuru chose the town of Yoichi in Hokkaido because of the similar environmental conditions to Scotland, where he learned whisky-making. Yoichi malts are described as bold and strong with refined peaty notes and smokiness brought by the traditional direct coal-fired distillation. Sea breeze from the Ishikari Bay delivers a briny hint to the whisky during maturation.

name: Miyagikyo Non Age Single Malt Japanese Whisky 70cl
description: Miyagikyo Single Malt is a range of single malt expressions from the Miyagikyo Distillery. Nikka's founder Masataka Taketsuru chose a valley in the Miyagi prefecture as the site for his second distillery, and started its operation in 1969. He aimed to make a complete contrast between the two distilleries, Miyagikyo and Yoichi, with different natural environments and production methods. Miyagikyo malts are described as elegant and fruity. Made from light peated and non-peated malted barley, whiskies distilled in pot stills heated by indirect steam express a signature fruitiness and delicate mouthfeel.

name: Montagny Premier Cru "La Grande Roche" Maison Louis Latour Burgundy France 2023
description: The Montagny appellation is located about 30 kilometers south of Beaune on the hills of the southern part of the Côte Chalonnaise. 100% white, the Montagny wines have a typical freshness of the Chardonnay grape. The great quality of these wines is linked to the limestone soil and the admirably exposed hillsides. Characterized by the richness of their bouquet, they are consistent wines with a certain smoothness in the mouth but also a lot of freshness. Our Montagny 1er Cru reveals delicious floral aromas of honeysuckle. Full in the mouth with notes of almond, apricot and pepper. The finish is fresh with a hint of mint.

name: Barajas Reposado Tequila 70cl
description: Color: Brilliant Gold Body: Light and delicate Notes: Nuances of raw and cooked agave, hints of pineapple and peach, lime, and a touch of pear. Flavors: Raw and cooked Agave, herbs, lime, pear, traces of honey with gentle minerality.

name: Barajas Extra Añejo Tequila 70cl
description: Color: Golden Caramel. Body: Voluptuous and silky Notes: Fragrances of pear skin, chocolate aroma, and toffee. Gentle vanilla and spices, cooked agave, cinnamon and nuts. Flavors: Hint of cooked agave, vanilla, toffee, pepper and subtle minerality

name: Barajas Añejo Tequila 70cl
description: Color: Radiant amber. Body: Silky and well-structured body. Notes: Orange peel and jasmine with hints of plum and vanilla. Delicate spices, caramel, and cooked agave with notes of cinnamon, and pepper. Flavors: Caramel sweetness and cooked agave, cinnamon, and spicy pepper. A citrus touch with a final note of minerality.

name: Tempo d’Angélus Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2022 Double Magnum 3L
description: The tasting reveals wines with attractive colour and real fruit character. Tannins were quite abundant; however, these were perfectly managed during the extraction, ensuring the smoothness and tenderness that are characteristic of the wines of Château Angélus. The long, delicate finish on the palate is marked by the high percentage of Cabernet Franc (60%), which has left its special stamp on this really ‘unexpected’ vintage!

name: Tilt Be Teltayn - D Shop Beirut
description: The tale of a carafe, the king of every table, stands tall, two thirds firmly within the wood, and only one third peeps out, a glass of arak and two glasses of water, and the festivities of Lebanese royalty begin. D Shop Beirut is a Lebanese homegrown concept featuring home accessories, glassware, and furniture as well as lighting design pieces reflecting Middle Eastern culture and heritage. D Shop Beirut oozes warmth with every item shaped to suit individual taste. The Beirut-based company nurtures local artisans and craftsmanship by using mastered techniques to bring out contemporary pieces designed by Jean Bou Doumit. Every piece has a story to tell, giving a fresh taste for your surroundings.

name: Hammered Aluminum Ice Bucket with Mouth Blown Recycled Glass Carafe - D Shop Beirut
description: Blending raw texture with refined tradition, this piece pairs hammered aluminum with a hand-blown glass carafe, crafted by Lebanese artisans to bring heritage and modernity to your table. D Shop Beirut is a Lebanese homegrown concept featuring home accessories, glassware, and furniture as well as lighting design pieces reflecting Middle Eastern culture and heritage. D Shop Beirut oozes warmth with every item shaped to suit individual taste. The Beirut-based company nurtures local artisans and craftsmanship by using mastered techniques to bring out contemporary pieces designed by Jean Bou Doumit. Every piece has a story to tell, giving a fresh taste for your surroundings.

name: Mouth Blown Recycled Glass Wine Carafe And Wood Stopper - D Shop Beirut
description: Hand-blown by skilled Lebanese artisans and set on a solid beechwood base, this carafe tells the story of tradition meeting sustainability, where every pour honors craftsmanship and heritage. D Shop Beirut is a Lebanese homegrown concept featuring home accessories, glassware, and furniture as well as lighting design pieces reflecting Middle Eastern culture and heritage. The Beirut-based company nurtures local artisans and craftsmanship by using mastered techniques to bring out contemporary pieces designed by Jean Bou Doumit. Every piece has a story to tell, giving a fresh taste for your surroundings.

name: N°3 d’Angélus Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2020
description: A bright and fresh red with violets, berries and orange peel. Medium-bodied, crisp and crunchy. 85% merlot, 10% cabernet franc and 5% cabernet sauvignon. - James Suckling, 92-93 pts

name: N°3 d’Angélus Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2015 Double Magnum 3L
description: A bright and fresh red with violets, berries and orange peel. Medium-bodied, crisp and crunchy. 85% merlot, 10% cabernet franc and 5% cabernet sauvignon. - James Suckling, 92-93 pts

name: N°3 d’Angélus Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2019 Magnum 1.5L
description: A bright and fresh red with violets, berries and orange peel. Medium-bodied, crisp and crunchy. 85% merlot, 10% cabernet franc and 5% cabernet sauvignon. - James Suckling, 92-93 pts

name: Tempo d’Angélus Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2020 Magnum 1.5L
description: The tasting reveals wines with attractive colour and real fruit character. Tannins were quite abundant; however, these were perfectly managed during the extraction, ensuring the smoothness and tenderness that are characteristic of the wines of Château Angélus. The long, delicate finish on the palate is marked by the high percentage of Cabernet Franc (60%), which has left its special stamp on this really ‘unexpected’ vintage!

name: Glenfiddich Experimental Series Project XX No.2 Whisky 70cl
description: The second release in Glenfiddich's Experimental Series is their Project XX expression, which was made not simply by one Malt Master, but 20! 20 Malt Masters were invited to the Glenfiddich distillery and invited them to pick any expression from the thousands of casks maturing in the warehouse. The 20 chosen whiskies were then married by Malt Master Brian Kinsman to create this single malt you see before your eyes. Hooray for teamwork! Nose This smells like a bit of a beastie, lots of woody spicy notes, toffee and orange peel. Clearly some serious cask action going on here. Palate Lots of wood: cloves, cinnamon and vanilla with tingly wood tannins, all wrapped up with some sweet fudge notes. Finish Long and layered, with lingering notes of espresso and dark chocolate.

name: Glenfiddich Experimental Series Fire & Cane No.4 Whisky 70cl
description: Let the great experiment... Continue! Glenfiddich has added a new expression to its Experimental Series, unveiling Fire & Cane in mid-2018. Malt master Brian Kinsman has given some of the distillery's peated single malt a three-month finishing period in rum casks - but not just any old rum casks. He's selected rum casks from a variety of South American countries to finish this whisky, which ought to play nicely with the burly peat notes at its core. Nose Billowing soft peat notes, like distant smoke on the wind. Rich sweet toffee with zesty fresh fruit notes and spiciness. Palate Like a Highland peat campfire, with oak notes and toffee. Sharp green fruit, sweet baked apple and soft smoke. Finish Lingering smokiness and sweetness.

name: Domaine E. Guigal Red Côtes du Rhône France 2022 Half Bottle 37.5cl
description: This wine is of consistently high quality in all vintages. Connoisseurs will enjoy its classic expression of the Syrah grape variety combined with the Grenache grape.

name: The Glenlivet 12 Years Old Single Malt Whisky 70cl
description: This whisky has been called a lot of things in its time: smooth, fruity, complex, sophisticated, entertaining, classic. The Original Malt Whisky Almanac says: “A first-class malt. One of the most popular malts in the world – deservedly so.” Representing The Glenlivet’s signature style, this classic malt is first matured in traditional oak, before spending time in American oak casks which impart notes of vanilla and gives the whisky it’s distinctive smoothness. The mineral-rich water that comes from Josie’s Well helps form the flavours during mashing and fermentation, whilst the specific height and width of the copper stills add a delicate yet complex character. Keep a bottle on hand for every occasion.

name: Roc de Boisseaux Grand Cru Saint-Émilion Bordeaux France 2016
description: "Lovely, ripe blueberries with a touch of vanilla, then full, supple tannins on the plush palate, making this is an easy, modern-style St.-Emilion to enjoy right now. Drink or hold." - 92/100 , James Suckling

name: Another Hendrick's Gin
description: Surprisingly infused with orange blossom & cacao Crafted with eleven botanicals and surprisingly infused with Orange Blossom & Cacao. Another Hendrick’s intrigues the senses with bright citrus notes and a whisper of velvet indulgence. ANOTHER HENDRICK’S is what happens when a spirit discovers another side of itself. You might think of Another Hendrick’s as a twin, yet not an identical one. Although it shares the same rounded balance and peculiar soul as Hendrick’s original, it expresses that soul in a different sensory dimension, thanks to its unpredictable infusions of Orange Blossom & Cacao. Although Ms. Lesley Gracie avoids “edges and points” in the tastes of her creations, she is entirely comfortable with frontiers and horizons. To our knowledge, they are the first gin maker to discover another side of themselves and commit to distilling it. But then again, they have always suspected there was more than one way to be Hendrick’s.

name: Joseph Drouhin Chablis Grand Cru Les Clos 2023
description: A great wine, perhaps the one most able to express what the terroir of Chablis really is like. The colour is pale gold yellow, with greenish hints. Refined nose, with aromas of lily (« fleur de lys »), honey or preserved lemon. Astounding depth and velvety sensation (gras) on the palate, with some delicate marine nuances. Intense and long aftertaste. After 5 or 6 years, even more complex and subtle aromas develop in the wine. A wine of incomparable finesse. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Joseph Drouhin Puligny-Montrachet 2023
description: Discover the elegance of Puligny-Montrachet, a refined Chardonnay from Joseph Drouhin. With notes of ripe fruit, subtle oak, and minerality, this wine delivers a rich texture and bright acidity. Perfect with seafood or creamy dishes, it’s a true expression of craftsmanship in every sip. A wine of great finesse, distinguished and elegant. The aromas evoke trees in bloom and white flesh fruit, like white peaches. On the palate, there is a sensation of fresh silkiness. Long and persistent in the aftertaste. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Joseph Drouhin Chablis 2024
description: A dry and easy wine to drink. Very fresh aromas reminiscent of citrus and a small pleasant touch of fern and coriander. Pleasant and long aftertaste. It is crisp and elegant, featuring vibrant acidity and a clean, refreshing finish. This classic Chablis pairs beautifully with seafood, particularly oysters and shellfish, showcasing the purity and finesse characteristic of its Burgundy origins. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2024

name: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Reposado
description: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Reposado is aged 100% blue agave. Herbaceous essence & cooked agave flavor with stewed tropical fruits. Tasting notes Nose: Essence of agave and herbaceous notes and oak notes, including vanilla, caramel, and toast. Palate: Cooked agave and stewed tropical fruits backed by lingering notes of vanilla, clove, cinnamon, and toffee Finish: Warm and spicy

name: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Blanco
description: Jose Cuervo Tradicional Blanco is an award winning, 100% Blue Weber agave tequila made with just three ingredients: agave, yeast, and water. Tasting notes Nose: Blue agave herbaceous, subtle citrus notes Palate: Spice and sweet balance, firmness, fruit overtone Finish: Sweet and refreshing

name: Piccini Prosecco Venetian Dress 20Cl
description: A rich and refined bouquet, where the notes of white fruit and a delicate scent of white flowers transform the sensory journey into an emotional experience. It pairs perfectly with appetizers, aged cheeses, grilled vegetables and, in general, with all fish dishes. A perfect bottle to celebrate events and anniversaries 365 days a year! Country: Italy Grape Variety: Glera

name: Gavi Di Gavi Marchesi Di Barolo 2022
description: A crisp Italian white wine made from the Cortese grape. The color is a light straw yellow with pale green hues. The intense and refined aroma has fruity and floral notes, reminiscent of Golden Delicious apple and green almonds, with a strong scent of chamomile flowers. The taste is elegant, harmonious and persistent, sapid, with balanced mineral notes. It is ideal with shellfish and all fish courses. It makes for a pleasant pairing with risottos with vegetables, tasty salads and fresh or medium-ripened cheeses. Country: Italy Region: Piemonte Grape Variety: Cortese Year: 2022

name: Telmont Réserve Brut
description: BALANCED, ELEGANT, FRUITY Réserve Brut is the result of a subtle marriage of the three Champagne grape varieties. It is a blend of the wines of seven distinct years, together beautifully balanced, a perfect harmony of richness, fruitiness and freshness. A genuine expression of terroir, a tribute to the excellence and singularity of each year’s harvest.

name: Cognac Rémy Martin LOUIS XIII Limited editon gift box Chinese New Year
description: Hand Crafted Crystal Gold Leaf Animation Limited Edition Gift Box The finest and most precious eaux-de-vie, made using grapes grown in Grande Champagne, the premier cru of the Cognac region, are carefully blended over the years to create the cognac inside every LOUIS XIII Classic decanter. Provenance and time are the very essence of LOUIS XIII cognac. Each drop represents a finely tuned craft passed down from one generation of Cellar Master to the next. The eaux-de-vie are slowly aged in old Limousin tierçons (traditional aged French oak casks). Every sip is a taste of time. LOUIS XIII COGNAC, THE MASTERPIECE Colour: mahogany, amber, fascinating, glimmering, radiant, eye-catching. Liquid: harmonious; spontaneous, a realm of fragrance, a firework of aromas, a myriad of aromas, multifaceted, a dense harmony of flowers, fruits and spices. DECANTER: REBIRTH OF A REGAL TREASURE No two of these decanters are the same. Hand-crafted by skilled artisans from the finest European crystal houses, each decanter is individually numbered and unique. The distinctive design, featuring 10 distinctive spikes on each side Inspired by a Renaissance artefact found on the battlefield of Jarnac that had occurred in 1569, “gourde annulaire”. A masterpiece, a unique circular shape symbolizing balance and perfection in Renaissance art, a fleur-de-lys evoking Louis XIII style. Aesthetic, radiance, harmony, enhancement, clarity, ode, majestic, regal, graceful, intriguing, iconic. As well as an ode to craftsmanship, uncompromising, mastery, visionary minds, human hands, human skill, intricate, artefact, hand-crafted, unique creation.

name: Rémy Martin Vsop Cognac Coffret End of Year
description: Rémy Martin VSOP embodies the perfect harmony of powerful and elegant aromas. It is the symbol of the Cellar Master’s art of blending. Tasting notes Nose: An aromatic harmony of powerful elegance with notes of vanilla, dried apricot and candied pear. Palate: A balance of aromatic dried fruits and delicate liquorice give a complex flavour experience. Body: Structured and layered. A rounded harmony of dried fruits, a satisfying mouthfeel and silky texture. Eye: A warm and mysterious ochre in the bottle, a vibrant gold in the glass.

name: Rémy Martin Vsop Cognac Coffret Chinese New Year
description: Rémy Martin VSOP embodies the perfect harmony of powerful and elegant aromas. It is the symbol of the Cellar Master’s art of blending. Tasting notes Nose: An aromatic harmony of powerful elegance with notes of vanilla, dried apricot and candied pear. Palate: A balance of aromatic dried fruits and delicate liquorice give a complex flavour experience. Body: Structured and layered. A rounded harmony of dried fruits, a satisfying mouthfeel and silky texture. Eye: A warm and mysterious ochre in the bottle, a vibrant gold in the glass.

name: Rémy Martin Xo Coffret End of Year
description: Remy Martin XO is the signature of the Cellar Master who with his expertise blends hundreds of eaux-de-vie. His art of blending allows us to express the full aromatic complexity of this XO Cognac Fine Champagne. Tasting notes Nose: Explosion of flower and fruit aromas Palate: Ripe plum, candied orange, spices Finish: Full bodied and long lasting

name: Rémy Martin Xo Coffret Chinese New Year
description: Remy Martin XO is the signature of the Cellar Master who with his expertise blends hundreds of eaux-de-vie. His art of blending allows us to express the full aromatic complexity of this XO Cognac Fine Champagne. Tasting notes Nose: Explosion of flower and fruit aromas Palate: Ripe plum, candied orange, spices Finish: Full bodied and long lasting

name: Terroir De Bacchus, Sauvignon Blanc 2022
description: Terroir de Bacchus” wines come from the high-altitude vineyards of Ainata-Al-Arz (1,800 m), the highest in Lebanon and the Middle East. Shaped by rocky soils and a continental climate, they reflect a unique terroir only 30 km from the historic Bacchus Temple in Baalbek. This wine displays a pale yellow color with delicate green highlights. The nose is expressive and herbaceous, lifted by zesty citrus notes that add freshness and vibrancy. On the palate, it is lively and precise, supported by refreshing acidity that enhances its balance and energy. The finish is mineral and persistent, often revealing a subtle peppery nuance that adds complexity. Country: Lebanon Region: Lebanese village of Ainata-Al-Arz Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2022

name: Terroir De Bacchus, Chardonnay White 2022
description: Terroir de Bacchus” wines come from the high-altitude vineyards of Ainata-Al-Arz (1,800 m), the highest in Lebanon and the Middle East. Shaped by rocky soils and a continental climate, they reflect a unique terroir only 30 km from the historic Bacchus Temple in Baalbek. This wine shows a deep, vibrant color that stands out in the glass. The aroma is floral and expressive, highlighted by pronounced citrus notes that bring freshness to the bouquet. On the palate, it reveals impeccable clarity and precision, reflecting the influence of nutrient-poor soils that shape its character. The wine finishes crisp and clean, leaving a refreshing and elegant impression. Country: Lebanon Region: Lebanese village of Ainata-Al-Arz Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Terroir De Bacchus, Red 2022
description: Terroir de Bacchus” wines come from the high-altitude vineyards of Ainata-Al-Arz (1,800 m), the highest in Lebanon and the Middle East. Shaped by rocky soils and a continental climate, they reflect a unique terroir only 30 km from the historic Bacchus Temple in Baalbek. This wine displays an intense, deep color that immediately captures attention in the glass. On the nose, it reveals a subtle yet complex aroma, unfolding in delicate layers that invite closer exploration. The palate is harmonious and rich, offering a beautifully balanced mouthfeel that combines warmth with excellent structure. It concludes with a long, elegant finish, supported by refreshing acidity that enhances its overall balance and drinkability. Country: Lebanon Region: Lebanese village of Ainata-Al-Arz Grape Variety: Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2022

name: Domaine Eugénie Carrion Chablis Premier Cru 'Montmains' 2023
description: Very good Chablis, soft tongue. An elegant white wine showcasing vibrant acidity and notes of green apple, citrus, and flint. With a mineral-driven profile and a crisp finish, it pairs beautifully with seafood and creamy dishes. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Piccini Chianti Classico 2022
description: Ruby red color. Fruity nose, cherry driven, fresh palate of light cherry fruit, soft, smooth and well balanced with gentle tannins. Complex and persistent aroma, with notes of spices and berries. On the palate it is balanced, elegant, velvety, with fruity notes and soft tannins. Country: Italy Grape Variety : Sangiovese, Merlot

name: Tenuta Moraia Perpiero Toscana Rosso 2020
description: A full body, smooth tannins, and bright acidity, finishing with a satisfying touch. Ideal for pairing with roasted meats, pasta, and aged cheeses, this wine captures the essence of Tuscany. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2020

name: Tenuta Moraia Apricaia Toscana Rosso 2020
description: Features rich flavors of dark cherry, plum, and spice, with a smooth texture and well-integrated tannins. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Merlot, Sangiovese Year: 2020

name: Chateau Lynch-Bages 2019, Pauillac
description: Rich garnet-purple in color, it opens with generous aromas of cassis, black cherry, and dark berry compote, underscored by hints of violet, tar, and spice. Structured and intense, with firm tannins and lively tension, it finishes long and complex, a textbook Pauillac. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot Year: 2019

name: Saint-Joseph Le Grand Pompée 2022 - Paul Jaboulet
description: This Saint Joseph won't make you disapointed. A powerful red color with purple hues, concetrated on the nose with very ripe red fruits and sweet spices. Harmonious mouth with well integrated tannins and a magnificent length! Country: France Region: Rhone Grape Variety: Syrah Year: 2022

name: Margarita Pack
description: 1800 Silver x1 Cointreau x1

name: Aurora, Chateau 2022
description: This wine presents an aromatic profile of black and matured red fruits. On the palate, it offers a medium body, medium acidity, and high tannins. Flavors of blackberries and red berries are prominent, complemented by secondary notes of mocha and chocolate from the barrel aging. The finish is long, with subtle hints of mint. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: 50% Cabernet Sauvignon 50% Merlot Year: 2022

name: Aurora, Cabernet Franc 2018
description: This wine has fresh nose dominated by red fruits (raspberry and red cherry) and hints of cloves. It is medium bodied, with medium tannins, and acidity and a silky palate with primary flavors of red cherry, raspberry followed by toasted nuts and vanilla from the barrel ageing. This wine has a long lasting finish and shows plenty of complexity as it aerates. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: 100% Cabernet Franc Year: 2018

name: Aurélien Verdet Morey-Saint-Denis 1er Cru Les 'Monts Luisants' 2020
description: The wine offers a refined aromatic profile of fresh cherries, violets, undergrowth, and subtle spice, leading to a velvety yet structured palate with juicy red fruit, balanced acidity, and fine tannins. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2020

name: Alvina Pernot Saint Romain 2022
description: A fresh and precise expression of Saint-Romain, this wine highlights the purity and tension of high-altitude Burgundy terroir. The nose opens with citrus fruit, green apple, and white flowers, complemented by subtle mineral notes. On the palate, it is crisp and well-balanced, with lively acidity, a clean texture, and a refreshing, saline finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Domaine Darviot-Perrin Volnay "Les Santenots" 1er cru 2021
description: This wine charms from the outset with its delicate, lightly extracted red-fruit aromas, offering an immediately seductive nose. The palate is light and velvety, with fine body and a silky texture that glides effortlessly, highlighting the elegance and subtlety emblematic of great Volnay wines. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2021

name: Domaine Marchand Freres Morey-Saint-Denis 1er Cru 'Clos des Ormes' 2021
description: The aromatic profile reveals vibrant red berry fruit and floral notes , complemented by subtle nuances of spice and licorice . On the palate, it is medium-bodied , with supple yet juicy tannins , excellent balance, and a fresh, energetic finish driven by lively acidity . A poised and expressive wine. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2021

name: Domaine des Comtes Lafon, Monthélie 1er Cru "Les Duresses" 2021
description: The 2021 Monthélie Les Duresses opens with fragrant notes of fresh red berries, unfolding into a medium-bodied palate that is light, supple, and gracefully textured, with a delicate, melting finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2021

name: Piccini Rosso Toscana 2024
description: A fruity wine, with plums, berries and fresh acidity. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese, Malvasia Nera Year: 2024

name: Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore Primo Franco
description: This Prosecco displays a bright straw-yellow color. The bouquet is vibrant and expressive, offering aromas of exotic fruits and ripe apples, enhanced by delicate notes of almond and candied lemon peel. On the palate, it is gently sweet and fruit-driven, balanced by refreshing acidity, and finishes with a lively, crisp freshness. Country: Italy Region: Veneto Grape Variety: 100% Glera

name: HUMO BLANCO organic sauvignon blanc 2023
description: The bouquet is delicate and expressive, showcasing aromas of lime, nectarine, and white floral notes. On the palate, the wine is elegant and refined, with fresh, well-balanced acidity supported by a subtle honeyed texture. Flavors of lemon, lime, and exotic fruits carry through to a long, smooth, and satisfying finish. Country: Chile Grape Variety: 100% Sauvignon Blanc

name: HUMO BLANCO organic chardonnay 2024
description: This wine displays a beautiful yellow hue enhanced by luminous golden highlights. On the nose, it reveals expressive aromas of white and tropical fruits, peach, melon, and pineapple subtly complemented by delicate toasted and buttery nuances. The palate is broad and generous, offering flavours of grapefruit zest and exotic fruits, leading into a refined finish marked by elegant woody notes. Country: Chile Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay

name: Château Martinon Blanc 2023
description: This bold, fruity white is full of lemon, grapefruit, pineapple and gooseberry overtones held up with a dash of wet rock and some summer flower aromas. Fragrant on the nose with notes of honey, citrus, and freshly cut hay, this light-bodied wine offers flavors of citrus, honeysuckle, green melon, and a touch of minerality on the palate. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: 60% Semillon, 20% Sauvignon Blanc, 15% Sauvignon Gris, 5% Muscadelle

name: The Balvenie 16Yo French Oak
description: Their First Finish Exploring French Oak Sixteen years of maturation in traditional American oak casks develops an abundance of sweet vanilla, soft oak spice, and signature Balvenie honeyed warmth, forming a rich and balanced foundation. Finishing in Pineau des Charentes casks adds vibrant layers of grapefruit zest, floral geranium, glazed orchard fruits, and gentle ginger spice, creating a refined and lively complexity. Tasting notes Nose: Fresh citrus and green apple, balanced with honey, vanilla, and light floral notes. Palate: Smooth and well-rounded with flavors of sweet oak, ripe fruits, vanilla cream, warming spices, and a bright citrus lift from the French oak influence. Finish: Long, elegant, and softly spiced, with lingering notes of honey, oak, and gentle citrus freshness.

name: Cognac Rémy Martin LOUIS XIII Limited editon gift box End Of Year
