description: Hand Crafted Crystal Gold Leaf Animation Limited Edition Gift Box The finest and most precious eaux-de-vie, made using grapes grown in Grande Champagne, the premier cru of the Cognac region, are carefully blended over the years to create the cognac inside every LOUIS XIII Classic decanter. Provenance and time are the very essence of LOUIS XIII cognac. Each drop represents a finely tuned craft passed down from one generation of Cellar Master to the next. The eaux-de-vie are slowly aged in old Limousin tierçons (traditional aged French oak casks). Every sip is a taste of time. LOUIS XIII COGNAC, THE MASTERPIECE Colour: mahogany, amber, fascinating, glimmering, radiant, eye-catching. Liquid: harmonious; spontaneous, a realm of fragrance, a firework of aromas, a myriad of aromas, multifaceted, a dense harmony of flowers, fruits and spices. DECANTER: REBIRTH OF A REGAL TREASURE No two of these decanters are the same. Hand-crafted by skilled artisans from the finest European crystal houses, each decanter is individually numbered and unique. The distinctive design, featuring 10 distinctive spikes on each side Inspired by a Renaissance artefact found on the battlefield of Jarnac that had occurred in 1569, “gourde annulaire”. A masterpiece, a unique circular shape symbolizing balance and perfection in Renaissance art, a fleur-de-lys evoking Louis XIII style. Aesthetic, radiance, harmony, enhancement, clarity, ode, majestic, regal, graceful, intriguing, iconic. As well as an ode to craftsmanship, uncompromising, mastery, visionary minds, human hands, human skill, intricate, artefact, hand-crafted, unique creation.

name: Clase Azul Tequila Día de Muertos Special Edition Recuerdos
description: This is the fifth and final installment of Nuestros Recuerdos, an annual series of five limited-edition creations devoted to the most exquisite facets of Día de Muertos. This exquisite añejo tequila was crafted under the guidance of the Master Distiller, Viridiana Tinoco. The blend harmonizes tequilas aged 12 to 38 months in first-use American whiskey casks. Part of the agave was slow-cooked in a pit oven, adding rich depth and a layered profile, a tribute to the complexity of our most cherished memories. Tasting Notes Color: Deep amber with golden highlights Nose: Cooked agave, smoked wood, orange peel, caramel and clove Palate: Cooked agave, orange marmalade and delicate spiced notes of clove and cinnamon, leading to a long, lingering finish of citrus and toasted wood Served: Enjoy neat in a tulip-shaped spirits glass with a wide bowl.

name: Château Fonbel 2022
description: A juicy, expressive red bursting with red-fruit flavors, currants layered with notes of clove and nutmeg. Full-bodied and complex, it delivers generous, well-defined fruit throughout. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: merlot, cabernet sauvignon, petit verdot Year: 2022

name: Château Giscours 2019
description: A refined, elegant wine marked by remarkable precision, offering a harmonious balance of fruit, the vibrant acidity of a great vintage, and beautifully smooth, silky tannins. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot Year: 2019

name: Arnaud Boué, Coteaux Bourguignons Gamay 2021
description: Luscious and silky, this wine is supple and round. The Gamay grape contributes fruitiness and fresh red berries. On the palate, the structure is fine and crisp, with a lovely, thirst-quenching finish. Enjoy with poultry, with porcini mushrooms, bellota ham or cote de boeuf a la fleur de sel. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Gamay Year: 2021

name: Arnaud Boué Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Nuits Blanc 2022
description: This wine is always crisp, with white fruit (pear), conrolled acidity and fine minerality. The nose is brioche-like, with notes of citrus and a touch of floral, giving an open, pleasant bouquet. The palate is supple and fresh, with a typically chalky finish. Enjoy it as an aperitif, a snack with friends or with a lemon-flavored sea bass Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Le Difese 2023, Sassicaia
description: Vibrant notes of red fruit and a hint of spice. Its smooth tannins and fresh acidity create a well-rounded finish, making it perfect for pairing with grilled meats or enjoying on its own. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese Year: 2023

name: Chassagne Montrachet 1er Cru Clos La Maltroie 2023, Pierre Girardin
description: A refined Premier Cru Chardonnay from the esteemed Clos de la Maltroie vineyard in Chassagne‑Montrachet. Grown on clay‑limestone soils with organic principles, this wine offers bright citrus and white stone fruit aromas, elegant minerality, and a long, precise finish. Subtle oak adds texture without overshadowing the purity of the fruit. Ideal with seafood, poultry, or soft cheeses. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Beaune Premier Cru Les Grandes Épenotes 2023, Pierre Girardin
description: A refined Premier Cru white from Beaune’s Les Grandes Épenotes, this 100% Chardonnay reflects Pierre Girardin’s organic, terroir‑focused winemaking. Bright citrus and floral notes rise from the glass, supported by vibrant acidity and a crisp, mineral finish that echoes the chalky clay‑limestone soils on the Beaune–Pommard border. Elegant and expressive, it pairs beautifully with seafood or creamy dishes and offers excellent drinking now or with gentle aging. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Pommard Les Vignots 2022, Pierre Girardin
description: A refined expression of Pommard from the Les Vignots lieu‑dit, this 100 % Pinot Noir from Domaine Pierre Girardin combines rich red and dark fruit aromas with subtle spice and floral notes, supported by silky tannins and vibrant minerality. Fermented with indigenous yeasts and aged in French oak, it delivers structured yet elegant depth with a long, expressive finish. Ideal with roasted meats or hearty dishes, it can be enjoyed now with air or cellar‑aged for several years. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Nuits Saint Georges 1er Cru Les Damodes 2022, Pierre Girardin
description: A rich and expressive Premier Cru Pinot Noir from the Les Damodes vineyard in Nuits‑Saint‑Georges, crafted by Pierre Girardin with meticulous, sustainable viticulture. This wine shows deep ruby colour with aromas of ripe red and dark berries, subtle spice and floral notes, leading to a balanced, structured palate with elegant tannins and mineral tension. Full‑bodied yet refined, it pairs beautifully with grilled and roasted meats and will age gracefully for years. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Morey Saint Denis 1er Cru Monts Luisants 2022, Pierre Girardin
description: A refined Premier Cru Pinot Noir from the Les Monts Luisants vineyard in the heart of Morey‑Saint‑Denis. Practicing organic viticulture, Pierre Girardin crafts this wine with whole‑cluster fermentation and gentle extraction to reveal ripe red and dark berry fruit, subtle spice, and elegant structure, supported by silky tannins and fine minerality. Balanced and expressive, it pairs beautifully with roasted meats or rich dishes and offers both immediate appeal and excellent aging potential. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Piccini Chianti Red 2024
description: The ruby ​​red color of Chianti Orange shines in the glass. Its bouquet gives a pleasant fragrance of red fruits and aromatic herbs. The sip, rich and soft, is accompanied by velvety tannins towards an intense fruity finish. Ruby red color. Fruity nose, cherry driven, fresh palate of light cherry fruit, soft, smooth and well balanced with gentle tannins. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese, Ciliegiolo, Canaiolo

name: Oyster Adriatic Gin 700 ML
description: Oyster Adriatic Gin is a complex and intriguing blend of herbs and botanicals native to the Adriatic, particularly Montenegro. Oyster Adriatic Gin is bottling up the Adriatic lifestyle. Distilled to retain the flavor of native Adriatic botanicals, this gin is delightfully smooth with notes of piney mountain juniper. Tasting notes Color: Clear and transparent Nose: Piney juniper background notes of green herbs Palate: Piney notes to the fore with a rich, complex herbaceous middle with hints of anise, spice and rosemary Finish: Long, complex and savoury with a slight peppery end

name: Beluga Transatlantic Racing Vodka 700 ML
description: Immerse yourself in the spirit of sailing with Beluga Transatlantic Racing vodka. It is produced with the finest ingredients and a special recipe, capturing the essence of the sea and the thrill of the open waters. Beluga Transatlantic Racing is the ideal companion for those who seek to elevate their drinking experience while paying homage to the timeless tradition of sailing. Raise your glass, feel the wind in your sails, and embrace the beauty of the Adriatic with every sip of Beluga Transatlantic vodka. Tasting notes: Citrus notes with a light touch of licorice Food Pairing: Oysters, seafood, delicacies

name: Beluga Gold Line Vodka 700 ML with shaker Gift Set
description: Step into the spotlight and make a statement with Beluga Gold Line vodka. This flawless jewel in the Beluga crown stands as the pinnacle of vodka artistry, a blend of the unequalled craftsmanship and expertise of our Beluga master distillers, resulting in a liquid masterpiece that captivates the senses. A truly exceptional vodka, Beluga Gold Line has a unique serving ceremony, the special wax-sealed cork should be opened with the elegant hammer and brush that accompany the bottle. Beluga Gold Line complex palette makes it an essential for the most discerning of drinkers. With an exquisitely crisp taste, Beluga Gold Line is bold and luxurious, and is the perfect vodka for your martini. Tasting notes: Clear and pure taste, light notes of grains and wheat reminiscent of alpine herbs Food Pairing: black caviar, red meat dishes and red fish

name: Beluga Celebration Vodka 700 ML
description: Toast to life's special moments with Beluga Celebration vodka, a symbol of distinction and taste. Made using only the finest ingredients, it embodies the art of celebration in every drop. With a stunning double-platinum and gold-lacquered bottle, the truly special Beluga Celebration is the ideal companion to all your celebrations. Tasting notes: Fresh and elegant wheat taste with a distant hint of flowers Food Pairing: Soft cheeses, desserts

name: Beluga Noble Vodka 200 ML
description: Beluga Noble vodka is a world-renowned, premium brand, produced at the vibrant Adriatic Riviera, in Montenegro. With precise attention to the distillation process, Beluga Noble vodka is created from the finest grain spirit and pure spring water. It has a delightfully smooth, balanced taste, an excellent choice for your martini. Tasting notes: Fresh and elegant wheat taste with a distant hint of flowers Food Pairing: Red and black caviar, tartare, cold meat cuts

name: Johnnie Walker Black Label
description: Johnnie Walker Black Label is a rich, smooth blended Scotch Whisky made using only single malt and grain whiskies it spend 12 years in a cask growing into vibrant body of flavor. Tasting notes Nose: Complex, ripe and fruity peat, nutmeg and vanilla Palate: Sweet to start, syrup, white pepper, orange blossom Finish: Quite fruity and long with a note of sultanas and mixed peels

name: GRAND SUD Chardonnay Blanc 2022
description: The Grand Sud Chardonnay from Les Grands Chais de France presents itself in a brilliant, bright yellow with a hint of green. Its bouquet unfolds fruity aromas reminiscent of ripe pears and juicy apples, complemented by subtle notes of pineapple and citrus fruits. On the palate, this Chardonnay shows a harmonious balance between freshness and fullness. The well-integrated acidity gives the wine liveliness and makes it particularly pleasant to drink. An elegant hint of vanilla and a silky, lingering finish round off the overall experience, making every sip a delight. Country: France Grape Variety: Chardonnay

name: RIEDEL Bar Water Ouverture Restaurant 8 + 4 FREE (12 GLASSES)
Macallan Harmony Collection Rich Cacao
description: Macallan Harmony, crafted from a harmonious combination of European and American oak casks, this rich single malt whisky pairs in perfect harmony with fine chocolates for an elevated tasting experience. Tasting notes Nose: Chocolate fondant, honey, oak, zesty lime and ginger Palate: Dark chocolate, honey, dates and vanilla Finish: Long with rich chocolate

name: Macallan Lumina
description: Macallan Lumina, Characterized by its bold flavors with notes of creamy vanilla, ginger and wood spice, this single malt that renews the quest for excellence. Tasting notes Nose: Poached pear and sweet apples with black pepper kick Palate: Caramelized nuts, dusted cinnamon Finish: Fizzy oak and ground nutmeg

name: Macallan 18Yo Double Cask
description: Macallan 18YO Double Cask, a perfectly balanced Single Malt whisky matured for 18 years in both American and European sherry seasoned oak casks delivering a whisky with a sweeter, warmer taste. Tasting notes Nose: Dried fruits, ginger, and toffee Palate: Rich raisin and sultana with notes of caramel Finish: Warm oak spice with ginger, and sweet orange

name: Bailey's Original Irish Cream
description: Bailey's Original Irish Cream Expiry 01-2027

name: 400 CONEJOS JOVEN MEZCAL
description: 400 Conejos® Joven is an award-winning mezcal produced from 100% Espadín agave using traditional methods in Oaxaca, Mexico. Tasting notes Nose: Campfire and ash, accompanied by faint ripe fruits and light herbal notes. Palate: Soft with hints of fresh wood that are subtly combined with sweet notes of cooked agave. Finish: A pleasant and smoky finish.

name: Seguin-Manuel Bourgogne Pinot Noir
description: Nice ruby colour. It is aromatic on the nose with stylish aromas of red berries and floral nuances. Elegant, it shows nice fruit purity on the palate. It is well-balanced and generous. Tannins are well integrated to the already appealing wine. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Beaune 1er Cru Clos Des Mouches 2022, Joseph Drouhin
description: An exceptional wine. Beautiful, deep-red ruby colour, with the bright sheen of great Burgundies. Intense and fresh nose for the young wines. Primary notes of red fruit dominate, such as Morello cherry, raspberry, blackberry. There are hints of complexity with smoky flavours evolving towards liquorice. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Domaine Tortochot Gevrey-Chambertin 'Les Corvées' 2022
description: A fruity, quite firm wine, good length in the mouth, very ample, with firm tannins. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Macon Villages 2023
description: Fresh and light. On the nose its floral and fruity. Very straightforward and direct on the palate, with a very pleasant aftertaste. A fresh and vibrant white wine from the Burgundy region, made primarily from Chardonnay grapes. It features bright flavors of green apple, pear, and citrus, with a crisp acidity and a mineral undertone. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Stoli Gluten Free
description: Meticulously crafted, gluten free STOLI vodka is made from 100% corn spirit and is triple-filtered through quartz sand and a birch activated charcoal column to ensure its outstanding quality and unparalleled smoothness. Tasting notes Nose: Neutral with soft natural notes Palate: Cream corn and butterscotch, not sweet. Soft and smooth, not oily Finish: Fresh and pure finish

name: RIEDEL Veloce All Purpose Tumbler (Set of 2)
Malbec Mendoza 2022, Achaval Ferrer
description: Bright ruby red in color, this wine is fresh and floral, featuring blackberry, raspberry, and violets on the nose and palate. The wine is soft and round with a noticeable minerality, silky tannins mark a lengthy finish. Country: Argentina Region: Mendoza Grape Variety: Malbec Year: 2022

name: Chablis Premier Cru Vau de Vey 2022
description: Fruity and mineral nose. Fresh and lively on the palate, with a beautiful minerality that opens up to notes of citrus and white-fleshed fruit. Precise and salivating finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape variety: 100% Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Domaine des Hâtes Chablis Premier Cru 'Fourchaume' 2023
description: A top Premier Cru vineyard noted for growing on similar contours as the Grand Crus above the right bank of the Serein. Pierrick's vines average 25 years with some up to 35 years old. The wine is aged in stainless steel for 75% and in aged barrels for 25% giving a wine of excellent complexity and depth. A distinguished white wine that presents complex aromas of green apple, citrus zest, and distinctive flint notes. The palate is characterized by its crisp acidity and pronounced minerality, culminating in a refined, lingering finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Chablis – Domaine Des Hâtes 2023
description: This wine has a detailed, wet-stone bouquet that unfolds nicely in the glass. The palate is well balanced, with crisp acidity, fine tension and admirable sappiness that keeps the taste buds salivating. Showcasing the classic characteristics of the Chablis region. It features bright flavors of green apple, lemon, and flint, complemented by crisp acidity and a mineral finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: The Balvenie 14Yo The Week of Peat
description: Tales Of Character Written In Whisky For a week a year, The Balvenie distills a batch of peated malt , resulting in a Whisky rich in honey, vanilla and citrus notes with of delicate smokiness . The key ingredient to make whisky the way it used to be made. It started with a batch of Speyside peat, for extra peatiness. Using smoke from a heavily peated furnace, like in the very old days when every farm burned peat from the land. Tasting notes Nose: Gentle sweet peat smoke, lighter floral notes and delicate butterscotch honey. Palate: Velvety and round to taste with honey, vanilla, citrus flavour with an extra layer of delicate smokiness Finish: Gentle smoke with a lingering and creamy vanilla sweetness.

name: Mijenta Tequila Reposado
description: Aged approximately 6 to 8 months in a blend of American white oak, cherry, and acacia casks presenting a more mature and fuller expression with a long finish on the palate. Tasting notes Nose: A delicate and inviting vanilla nose with notes of bergamot, honey, preserved fruits and orange blossom flowers. Palate: Light golden hue, bright and transparent with a powerful body. Finish: Rich flavors of cooked agave, honey, vanilla with a mid-palate of cacao nibs. A long and generous finish on the palate.

name: 1800 GUACHIMONTON
description: Explore the New Pinnacle of Taste, the first and only añejo tequila to be finished in orange tequila liqueur casks. Tasting Notes Colour: Amber, with golden nuances and coppery sparkles Nose: Fresh citrus orange, honey, caramel, wood, ripe fruit Palate: Velvety, soft, pleasantly bitter Finish: Fresh and persistent orange sensation

name: Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Riserva 2021
description: Chianti Riserva offers an intense ruby red color and a persistent fruity bouquet with hints of blackberries, vanilla, and spices. Its rich, well-structured body features flavors of ripe cherry, plum, and spice, with soft tannins and a warm, velvety finish that lingers with a touch of red fruits. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese

name: Heaven Sake Baby Junmai Daiginjo 300ml
description: This playful sake is a delicate balanced Junmai Ginjo blend with a dry yet fruity aroma and a crisp finish. Crafted in Japan by Hakushika, sake baby brings brings notes of jasmine, violet, silky pears and white plum into your glass

name: Heavensake Junmai Daiginjo Orange 720ml
description: Introducing Regis Camus’ latest collaboration with Urakasumi brewery to create a smooth, pure and elegant Sake. Marked by a vibrant orange cap and bottled in HEAVENSAKE’s signature black glass bottle this multi-layered blend is made with two yeasts proprietary to Urakasumi including the famous “Kyokai 12”. The rices are a secret blend of Yamada Nishiki rice and a local variety from the Miyagi.

name: Heavensake Junmai Daiginjo 720ml
description: Heavensake Junmai Daiginjo is delicately fruity with a note of sweetness. Balanced to perfection by our master blender Regis Camus, this gem from the Dassai brewery will leave you in awe. A collaboration between acclaimed French cellar master, Regis Camus, and Asahi Shuzo (of Dassai fame), this premium sake is a knock-out on every level. The striking sleek black bottle has a classic ginjo aroma of apple and tropical fruit is followed by fresh berries and grapes, developing into a clean crisp finish.

name: Heavensake Junmai Ginjo Label Azur 720ML
description: Heavensake Junmai Ginjo has spring floral nose. The signature teardrop bottle has a bright, citrus-y aroma gives way to a lightly sweet honeycomb and tropical fruit flavours . Fruity and full-bodied on the palate with a silky finish. This collaboration between acclaimed French cellar master, Regis Camus and Urakasumi is all about elegance and warmth.

name: Octomore 15.1
description: Peated to 108.2 PPM and distilled from 100% Scottish barley, in a combination of bourbon barrels and re-charred ex-bourbon casks. Demonstrating refined strength of character, balancing smooth vanilla custard and sweet charred oak with heady peat smoke. Nose: Caramel and vibrant citrus open on the nose, delicately wrapped in Octomore’s dry, earthy peat smoke. Spicy aniseed, vanilla and smooth custard follow, with a tropical fruit, geranium and a hint of ginger complementing the sweet malt. Palate: Immediate heat on the palate is balanced with sweet dry malt and earthy smoke. A refreshing medley of mango, banana and apricot jam cuts through the heady peat, beautifully rounded with vanilla custard and toffee. A drop of water allows the smoke to open and brings subtle marine notes and warm sand. Finish: Peat smoke, vanilla and sweet charred oak settle on the finish, with a fresh marine crispness

name: Clase Azul Tequila Blanco Ahumado
description: An innovative, un-aged tequila that fuses ancestral techniques with contemporary elegance. Clase Azul Blanco Ahumado captures the transformative force of fire on blue agave, resulting in a refined spirit with subtle smokiness and volcanic character. Production details The agave is slow-cooked in a pit oven lined with firewood and volcanic stone, imparting delicate notes of smoke. The result: a brilliantly clear, full-bodied tequila that honors tradition and elevates flavor. Tasting notes Color : Brilliantly crystal clear with silver highlights. Aroma : Smoked agave, fresh plum and red apple. Palate : Smoked agave and fresh lemon with a mineral front that gives way to a silky finish with smoky undertones. Decanter State-of-the-art design: a subtly textured ceramic base evoking volcanic stones and a glass top reflecting the gentle smoky character of the spirit.

name: Peyrassol Reserve Des Templiers Rosé Cotes De Provence 2022
description: The wine is pale pink in color with silver highlights. This wine delivers from the first moment; a cocktail of fruits reminiscent of citrus zest. These first impressions are confirmed as soon as the wine hits the palate and continue pleasantly in a set that manages to marry freshness and roundness. Perfect on its own or enjoy with a family style meal of paella, jambalaya or marinated beef. Country: France Region: Provence Grape Variety: 30% Grenache, 25% Cinsault, 20% Syrah, 15% Mourvèdre, 10% Vermentino

name: Araucano Chardonnay 2023
description: Intense and complex nose. Ripe fruits such as pear are oven baked apples. Scents of subtle oak, vanilla on the back. The palate is deep, ample, supple, with a lot of fruits aromas. A long aromatic persistence and a palate built on ripe grape which confers to the wine an elegant structure. Country: Chile Region: Central Valley Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Piccini Prosecco Ice
description: Discover the freshest soul of Prosecco in its demi-sec style, where elegance and originality redefine taste. Serve it over ice and let yourself be surprised by an explosion of unconventional freshness. Country: Italy Grape Variety: Glera Tasting notes: Bright straw-yellow with elegant bubbles. On the nose, it bursts with ripe pear, white peach, and acacia blossom. The palate is silky and refreshingly sweet, with hints of citrus and honeyed apple. Its crisp finish invites another sip, especially served over ice.

name: Pouilly-Fuissé Tète de Cuvée, Château Fuissé 2023
description: The Pouilly-Fuissé Tête de Cuvée from Château Fuissé displays a luminous golden color and a beautifully balanced texture. Aromas of ripe apple, peach, and grapefruit blend with hints of almond and vanilla. Elegant and dry, this refined Burgundy white offers a harmonious, complex palate and a lingering, graceful finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Pouilly-Fuissé Le Clos Monopole 1er Cru, Château Fuissé 2023
description: The elegant Pouilly-Fuissé Le Clos Monopole 1er Cru from Château Fuissé shines with a bright golden hue and a beautifully balanced texture. Aromas of green apple, orange, hazelnut, and subtle toasted wood lead to a refined, dry palate that’s smooth and harmonious. This youthful Burgundy white concludes with a long, graceful finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Château Fuissé Bourgogne Blanc 2023
description: The 2023 Château Fuissé Bourgogne Blanc is a dry white wine crafted entirely from Chardonnay grapes. It offers bright aromas of citrus, green apple, and white flowers, with a vibrant, mineral-focused palate and a clean, refreshing finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Echezeaux Grand Cru, Domaine Mongeard Mugneret 2022
description: A deep, luminous red wine with garnet and violet hues, offering evolving aromas of spices, leather, and dark fruits, complemented by hints of violets and fresh cherries in its youth. On the palate, it is rich, harmonious, and refined, showcasing the full elegance and complexity of exceptional Pinot Noir from Grands-Echezeaux. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Vosne-Romanée Premier Cru "En Orveaux", Domaine Mongeard Mugneret 2022
description: Thanks to its magnificent exposure, the Vosne-Romanée 1er Cru "En Orveaux" appellation boasts a deep ruby color and aromas of red fruits, blackcurrant, and raspberry. Its rich and full-bodied bouquet gives it a style that is both silky and rustic. It possesses the freshness and roundness that allow it to rival other Premier Cru wines of Vosne-Romanée, as well as a sensual vinosity. This wine displays a wonderful balance. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Vosne-Romanée, Domaine Mongeard-Mugneret
description: A brilliant ruby-red wine with purple highlights, offering enticing aromas of red fruits, cherry, and sweet spices; elegant and refined on the palate with notes of cherry, raspberry, and licorice, perfectly paired with roast duck or mushroom risotto. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Beaune Premier Cru "Les Avaux", Domaine Mongeard Mugneret 2022
description: The wines from “Les Avaux” are very deep and dark in colour. The bouquet is very varied and complex, with animal notes suggestive of leather and aromas of red and dark fruits, including red berries, blackcurrants and morello cherries. Silky and dense, in the mouth the Beaune 1 er Cru “Les Avaux” has great distinction, and is very well balanced as well as warm and round. There are firm but not excessive tannins magnificently blended with savours of dark cherries with underlying meaty nuances. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Bourgogne Hautes Côtes De Nuits La Croix, Domaine Mongeard-Mugneret 2022
description: The wines of the Hautes-Côtes-de-Nuits express remarkable purity, marked by their freshness and the vivid flavors of red and black fruits such as redcurrant, raspberry, and blackcurrant. When enjoyed in their youthful prime but not too early the Pinot Noir shows generous fruitiness. As it matures, it develops more complex notes reminiscent of game and forest floor. Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Country: France Region: Bourgogne Year: 2022

name: Les Fiefs De Lagrange St-Julien 2018
description: It features a medium body, smooth tannins, and balanced acidity, leading to a harmonious finish. This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats and hearty dishes, reflecting the elegance of the St-Julien. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2018

name: Côtes Du Rhône "Parallèle 45" White 2024
description: Parallèle 45 is named after the famous latitude where great wines are born worldwide. It spans across France and passes over the cellars of Maison Paul Jaboulet Aîné. A classic since 1950, Parallèle 45 is celebrated around the globe for its exceptional quality and generous character. A subtle combination of the Rhône Valley’s iconic grape varieties unveils floral and fruit aromas, citrus notes, and a touch of exquisite freshness. This refreshing wine pairs beautifully with seafood, salads, and light Mediterranean dishes. Country: France Region: Côtes du Rhône Grape Variety: Viognier/ Grenache Blanc/ Roussanne/ Clairette / Marsanne

name: Cognac Rémy Martin LOUIS XIII
description: The finest and most precious eaux-de-vie, made using grapes grown in Grande Champagne, the premier cru of the Cognac region, are carefully blended over the years to create the cognac inside every LOUIS XIII Classic decanter. Provenance and time are the very essence of LOUIS XIII cognac. Each drop represents a finely tuned craft passed down from one generation of Cellar Master to the next. The eaux-de-vie are slowly aged in old Limousin tierçons (traditional aged French oak casks). Every sip is a taste of time. LOUIS XIII COGNAC, THE MASTERPIECE Colour: mahogany, amber, fascinating, glimmering, radiant, eye-catching. Liquid: harmonious; spontaneous, a realm of fragrance, a firework of aromas, a myriad of aromas, multifaceted, a dense harmony of flowers, fruits and spices. DECANTER: REBIRTH OF A REGAL TREASURE No two of these decanters are the same. Hand-crafted by skilled artisans from the finest European crystal houses, each decanter is individually numbered and unique. The distinctive design, featuring 10 distinctive spikes on each side Inspired by a Renaissance artefact found on the battlefield of Jarnac that had occurred in 1569, “gourde annulaire”. A masterpiece, a unique circular shape symbolizing balance and perfection in Renaissance art, a fleur-de-lys evoking Louis XIII style. Aesthetic, radiance, harmony, enhancement, clarity, ode, majestic, regal, graceful, intriguing, iconic. As well as an ode to craftsmanship, uncompromising, mastery, visionary minds, human hands, human skill, intricate, artefact, hand-crafted, unique creation.

name: Lacoste-Borie Pauillac 2019
description: Lacoste-Borie Pauillac 2019 is an elegant red wine with enticing aromas of blackcurrants and cedar. It offers a medium to full body, refined tannins, and vibrant acidity, finishing smoothly. Perfect with roasted meats and aged cheeses. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot Year: 2019

name: Soto de Torres Ibéricos Rioja Crianza 2021
description: Opaque cherry red. Rich fruit aromas (cherry, black plum jam) with spicy (green peppercorn) and smoky notes. Intense, warm, with firm tannins nicely structured by oak aging and a backbone of subtle fruit acidity. A rich wine showcasing vibrant cherry and plum flavors, accented by hints of vanilla and spice. With its smooth tannins and well-balanced acidity, it offers a long, elegant finish. Country: Spain Grape Variety: Garnacha Tinta, Tempranillo Year: 2021

name: Château Bonnet Bordeaux 2021
description: It offers a well-structured profile with smooth tannins and balanced acidity, culminating in a harmonious finish. This versatile Bordeaux pairs beautifully with roasted meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses, reflecting the traditional elegance of the region. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot Year: 2021

name: Baron D'Arignac Rouge Medium Sweet
description: A delicious melange of gorgeous rich, red, mouthwatering fruits like ripe cherries and berries with light notes of watermelon Country: Spain Grape Variety: 90% Tempranillo & 10% Grenache

name: Glenfiddich 16 ASTON MARTIN F1
description: LIMITED-EDITION PARTNERSHIP WITH ASTON MARTIN F1 TEAM: This 16 Year Old Single Malt is a tribute to instinctive mastery, born from the Glenfiddich and Aston Martin Formula One Team partnership uniting craftsmanship and cutting-edge innovation. Matured in American oak wine casks, new American barrels and second-fill bourbon casks, this whisky offers deep complexity, mellow sweetness and a silky, refined texture. Serve neat to appreciate the smooth mouthfeel and rich flavour. A luxurious choice for celebrations, after-dinner enjoyment or premium gifting moments throughout the year. Tasting Notes Nose : Rich biscuity cheesecake, maple syrup, and caramelized ginger with toasted oak notes Taste : Indulgent, confectionary sweet with a silky, syrupy mouthfeel. Fresh fruit salad and Chantilly cream Finish : Super smooth with a sustained sweetness

name: Mount Gay Black Barrel Rum
description: Robust & Bold Black Barrel is robust and bold, crafted from a blend of intense and aromatic rums, aged in American whiskey casks and finished for six months in deeply charred bourbon casks. Woody and buttery notes are balanced with toasted vanilla, toffee and orange zest, perfect for spirit-forward cocktails. Tasting Notes: Nose: Toasted oak and butter notes balances with dried fruit and spices Palate: Bold and aromatic with notes of orange zest, black pepper, toasted vanilla and toffee Body: Warm, medium body with a long finish

name: Mount Gay Eclipse Rum
description: Crisp & Aromatic Eclipse is the embodiment of the Mount Gay style, body and aroma by which the Master Blender Trudiann Branker uses to blend every variety of Mount Gay rum. Eclipse is distilled in traditional copper port and column stills, then matured in ex-American whiskey casks, giving the blend notes of fresh vanilla, almond, ripe banana and dark chocolate, perfect for cocktails. With elegance and body, it is perfect in classic rum cocktails like a Rum Punch, or enjoyed with your favourite mixer. Tasting Notes: Nose: Distinctive notes of vanilla and banana, with underlying notes of caramel, summer fruit and spice Palate: An oaky character with slight burnt notes Body: Light to medium body

name: Cheval Noir Bordeaux Rosé 2024
description: A historic brand of the Mähler-Besse estate, Cheval Noir Bordeaux is modernizing and is now available as a rosé with a completely new packaging! A rosé that highlights freshness and fruitiness. The harvest is deliberately early to preserve the brightness and liveliness of the fruit. Cheval Noir Bordeaux Rosé is a single-varietal wine, made 100% from Merlot. The wine has a bright color that catches the eye. The nose is rich, marked by floral notes (peony) and fresh fruit (raspberry). On the palate, a beautiful liveliness stands out, accompanied by an elegant aromatic structure that highlights citrus aromas. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot

name: Western Cellars Colombard Chardonnay USA 2022
description: Very aromatic, weak color with greenish spark. Combination of lime, tropical fruits, white berries acidity. A refreshing blend that showcases bright citrus and green apple flavors, complemented by subtle oak notes. Its crisp acidity and light body make it ideal for pairing with seafood, salads, or enjoying as a chilled sip on a warm day. Country: USA Region: California Grape Variety: Colombard Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Piccini Memoro 4 Elementi Nero D'avola 2023
description: Full-bodied with a smooth texture, showcasing dark fruit flavors and a touch of herbal notes. The wine has balanced acidity and soft tannins, contributing to a pleasant finish. Nero d'Avola Memoro offers a deep red color with aromas of ripe blackberries and notes of black pepper. The palate is rich and full-bodied, with flavors of dark cherry, plum and a touch of tobacco. The finish is long and velvety, leaving a lasting impression of dark fruit and subtle earthy nuances. Country: Italy Region: Sicily Grape Variety: Nero D'avola Year: 2023

name: Jp Chenet Chardonnay Blanc 2024
description: JP. CHENET is a French wine which really stands out above the fray. Its unique bottle reveals a piece of authenticity and savoir-faire that many others have tried to imitate. Jp Chenet Chardonnay reveals gourmet aromas of pear, mango and citrus. A fruity wine to be enjoyed at any time! A pure Chardonnay full of zesty character. Country: France Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2024

name: Jp Chenet Grenache Cinsault Rosé 2024
description: A refreshing rosé full of sun. A very light, shiny, salmon pink rosé wine. A very expressive bouquet that reveals aromas of fresh red berries and strawberries. Fine, fresh and elegant on the palate, ideally balanced. The perfect companion for salads, grilled dishes and spicy shellfish, which can also be enjoyed as an aperitif all year round. Country: France Grape Variety: Grenache

name: Château De Cathalogne Rouge 2022
description: The Bordeaux Rouge from Château De Cathalogne 2022 is a rich, elegant red wine from the heart of Bordeaux. With vibrant ruby color, it offers aromas of ripe red fruits like cherries and plums, complemented by sweet spices and a hint of vanilla from French oak aging. The wine is well-balanced, with smooth tannins and a lively acidity, making it both fresh and age-worthy. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot Year: 2022

name: Beaujolais Malvaux Moillard 2023
description: A fruity and fresh red wine made from Gamay grapes. It offers bright flavors of red berries and cherries, with a smooth, easy-drinking character. Country: France Region: Beaujolais Grape Variety: Gamay Year: 2023

name: Ombre Rosé Collines De La Moure 2023
description: A refreshing rounded rose with a nice acidity and a bouquet of red berries and white flowers. A vibrant wine with refreshing notes of strawberry, watermelon, and citrus. Its crisp acidity and light body make it perfect for warm days, pairing beautifully with seafood, salads, or simply sipping on its own. Country: France Region: Pays D'oc Grape Variety: Grenache Year: 2023

name: Vieux Château Des Combes 2021
description: An opaque color, outstanding ripeness. Dense with sweet tannins and an expansive, pure, perfumed style. Rich flavors of dark fruit and subtle oak. Its velvety texture and balanced acidity lead to a smooth, elegant finish, making it perfect for pairing with hearty dishes or enjoying on its own. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Carménère, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Merlot, Petit Verdot Year: 2021

name: Domaine Du Cheval Blanc 2023 Rouge
description: Smooth and medium-bodied, featuring soft tannins and balanced acidity, culminating in a pleasant finish. This wine pairs well with grilled meats, pasta dishes, and rustic fare, showcasing the elegance of its terroir. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec, Merlot Year: 2023

name: Domaine Du Cheval Blanc 2024
description: With a smooth texture and zesty acidity that leads to a clean finish. Perfect for pairing with seafood, salads, and light dishes, this wine beautifully highlights the charm of its terroir. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Year: 2024

name: Château Saint Martin 2023
description: Ruby red in colour, on the nose, aromas of cassis and red fruits with notes of vanilla. Silky tannins. Well-balanced in acidity. Savoury and classic red wine in style. A vibrant wine with notes of red berries, cherry, and a hint of spice. Its smooth tannins and refreshing acidity create a well-rounded finish, making it ideal for pairing with grilled meats or enjoying on its own. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot Year: 2023

name: Château Barade Bordeaux Rouge 2022
description: Château Barade Bordeaux Rouge features a smooth, medium body with well-integrated tannins and a balanced acidity, leading to a satisfying finish. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Merlot, Petit Verdot Year: 2022

name: St-Rémy XO Brandy
description: Recognized with multiple awards, St-Rémy XO results from a longer maturation in small French oak casks. St-Rémy XO takes its rich and complex taste from the selection of rich French eaux-de-vie, chosen for their ageing potential, and matured for a longer period in small French oak casks only. Perpetuating the legacy from our previous Master Blender, St-Rémy XO is the perfect brandy for moments of refinement and indulgence, recognised for its elegance, roundness and ability to linger in the palate. Tasting Notes - Rich & Complex Appearance : Luminous amber, with a rich golden aura. Nose: Mature nose underpinned with echoes of oak, and delicate vanilla aromas, layered with hints of ripe fruits and honey. Palate: A rich palate of flavors. Subtle notes of wood and vanilla are enriched with flavors of gingerbread, candied apricots, dates, figs and nuts. This complex taste is subtly spicy and offers a long finish.

name: St-Rémy VSOP Brandy
description: St-Rémy VSOP embodies the iconic and historical St-Rémy taste. Launched in 1980, St-Rémy VSOP embodies the iconic taste that made St-Rémy famous around the globe. Its delicate and balanced style results from the selection of delicate wine eaux-de-vie, coming from a wide variety of vines and terroirs, then matured in small casks.It is the right choice for a great authentic taste. Tasting Notes Delicate & Balanced Appearance: Amber-yellow lit with glints of gold. Nose: The vivacity quickly yields to fruity notes of apricot, peach, gooseberry and wild strawberry. Floral aromas blend subtly with tones of vanilla and wood. The abiding sensation is pleasing and harmonious. Palate: What the nose promises, the palate provides. Delicate and balanced mouth, with fruits and wood flavours, and a grand vanilla finale.

name: Bruichladdich Port Charlotte 10
description: Port Charlotte 10 year old is conceived, distilled matured and bottled only on Islay. Made from 100% Scottish barley, it is trickle distilled through tall, narrow-necked stills for a balanced, heathery style of barbeque smoke. Tasting notes Nose: The smoke is calmed by the marine, ozone character. While the smoke is always discernible on the nose it is dry and earthy in its style, allowing the oak to come forward with waves of golden caramel, fudge, vanilla custard, hints of ginger, nutmeg and clove. There is citrus fruit, coaxed from the glass with a drop of water, gentle lemon meringue and clementine. Breathe deeply and the floral aromas of wild thyme, heather and sea pink transport you to the Atlantic coast. Palate: On the palate there is a noticeable delicacy and softness in texture and style. Again, the balance of flavour is superb as the smoke wraps loosely around the sweetness drawn from deep within the oak. Coconut, vanilla custard and lemon honey combines with smoked oysters and sun baked salty sand. Finish: The finish is sublime. Smoky, sure, but with the soft sweetness of fudge and malted barley. Orange, mango and Banoffee pie signal the depth and quality of the oak. The many layers interchange on each sip. As the smoke comes and goes so too do the notes of ripe apple and apricot, beautifully intertwined with malt and oak sweetness and that typical Port Charlotte style dry smoke.

name: Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2014 8 AGED YEARS
description: Celebrate the purest expression of terroir with Bruichladdich Islay Barley 2014. Fully traceable and high provenance, a medley of apricot and peach complements the cereal-forward single malt, with a subtle maritime note nodding to the whisky’s all Islay harvest, distillation and maturation. Tasting notes Nose: Delicate floral notes along with sweet malt and ripe grain open on the nose. Hints of pepper and soft spices follow before the dram reveals soft stoned fruits and creamy vanilla. Creamy vanilla, a hint of coconut, butterscotch, and brown sugar come from the oak, alongside delicate notes of nutmeg and hazelnut. Fruit notes continue to open, with fragrant peach, honeyed melon, pear drops and warm banana bread. Palate: Creamy vanilla and lemon are immediate on the palate, with a peppery nutmeg spice giving way to sweet malt, warm porridge and popcorn. The depth of flavour and creamy, viscous texture is typical of our Islay barley style, with the natural oils from the barley enhanced with layers of sweet citrus, tropical fruit and fragrant peach. The combination of American and French oak makes for a beautifully balanced expression, with a drop of water bringing out subtle marine notes Finish: Sweet, stoned fruits settle on the palate with creamy vanilla custard and a touch of coconut, while a delicate floral note lingers.

name: Bruichladdich The Classic Laddie Scottish Barley
description: A signature bottling and the definitive Bruichladdich. Showcasing the classic, floral and elegant Bruichladdich house style, The Classic Laddice is made from 100% Scottish barley, trickle distilled, non-chill filtered and colouring free. Clean, fresh and lively. The oak and the grain work in perfect harmony. Tasting notes Nose: Barley sugar and a hint of mint open before moving into freshly cut wild flowers; buttercup, daisy, meadowsweet, myrtle, primrose and cherry blossom. Delicate zephyrs of spindrift and sea pinks are a reminder that this spirit is matured exclusively beside the sea. Over time, and with the addition of a little water, caramelised fruit notes come to the fore, with hints of lemon drops, honey, tangerine and tablet. Palate: Refined and refreshing, sweet oak and barley notes come together in perfect harmony. Ripe green fruits, brown sugar and sweet malt follow, showcasing the remarkable flavour of the Scottish barley used in this single malt. Finish: Smooth and well rounded, the finish showcases the elegant balance between the sprightly, vibrant fruit and the subtle sea-spray notes.

name: Jose Cuervo Reserva De La Familia Extra Añejo
description: Jose Cuervo Reserva De La Familia is the world's first extra-añejo tequila, evokes notes of rich oak, toasted almonds, vanilla and cinnamon with a complex and smooth finish. Tasting notes Nose: Nut notes, fruits Palate: Tropical fruit, clove and vanilla Finish: Ginger, and pepper

name: Château La Croix Saint-Vincent
description: Presents a deep, rich red color. On the nose, it reveals an enticing bouquet of ripe red berries, layered with subtle hints of spice, herbs, and a touch of vanilla. The palate is elegantly balanced, offering a well-structured body and silky, refined tannins for a smooth and harmonious finish. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: 80% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Franc Year: 2019

name: Don Julio 1942
description: Don Julio 1942, Aged at least for 30 months in American white-oak, this a remarkably smooth and incredibly complex tequila with notes of tropical fruits, agave and a hint of cinnamon spice. Tasting notes Nose: Rich caramel and chocolate Palate: Warm oak, vanilla and roasted agave Finish: Lingering oak and rich vanilla

name: 1800 Silver
description: 1800 Silver, made with 100% blue weber agave, The nose is rich with fruity and floral agave notes, the flavor is clean and refreshing with notes of angelica root. Tasting notes Nose: Rich with fruity and floral agave notes Palate: Clean and refreshing with notes of angelica roots Finish: Light and floral

name: 1800 Reposado
description: 1800 Reposado, crafted using 100% blue weber agave grown in volcanic soil and handpicked at peak maturity, a special selection of white tequilas are rested in new American and French oak casks. Tasting notes Nose: Slightly doughy bread Palate: Clean, peppery and spice hints Finish: Spice fades and liquorice finish

name: 1800 Añejo
description: 1800 Añejo is aged in new French and American oak barrels. This dark amber spirit boasts an oaky vanilla aroma, nutty with toffee flavor and peppery spice finish. Tasting notes Nose: Oak, vanilla aroma Palate: Toffee, and nuts flavors Finish: Long finish spicy finish

name: 1800 Milenio
description: 1800 Milenio, After a long and delicate aging process the extra-aged tequila is matured for a short period in French Oak casks creating balanced, soft, and unique flavor. Tasting notes Nose: Soft, sweet, floral, fruit, agave Palate: Clean, delicate, balanced and smooth Finish: Medium with fruity peppery fade

name: 1800 Cristalino
description: 1800 Cristalino is a crystal clear añejo tequila with deceptive depth, presented in a stunning crystalline bottle. 100% Weber blue agave is handpicked at its peak of maturity, aged in French and American oak barrels, married together, then finished in port wine casks. The result is an ultra-premium tequila that offers the complexity of an Añejo with the smoothness of a Blanco. Its aroma reveals subtle oak and vanilla, while the flavor profile offers nuanced notes of nut and citrus. The finish is silky, crisp, and lightly touched by the sweetness of port wine. Ideal for sipping neat, on the rocks, or enhancing your favorite cocktails, to celebrate life's special moments with taste. Tasting notes Nose: Dry and dusty with some fruits and minerals Palate: Sweet with pepper and some bitter notes Finish: Neat, smooth, and light with hints of citrus at first and after leaves hints of vanilla

name: Hendrick's Oasium Gin
description: Discover a refreshingly curious new Hendrick's Gin oasis Here is an astonishingly exquisite expression of Hendrick’s Gin to make a welcome oasis of every shared cocktail hour. This is no mirage, meet the 8th glorious expression of Hendrick’s Gin! LIMITED RELEASE GIN: Only in the desert can you truly understand refreshment. So, the plucky Hendrick’s Master Distiller Ms. Lesley Gracie travelled to just such a place for inspiration (yes, she really did!). After a game of camel polo she saw the most welcome sight – the vivid colours of the oasis! This is no mirage! Captivated by this lush paradise and the party of spectacular beasts in attendance, Gracie had an idea. By combining the aromatic herbs and bright fruits of a desert oasis she could create a new expression of Hendrick’s like no other. From the Oasis came forth Oasium (pronounced oh-ace-e-yum). Silky verdant green notes sing in delicious harmony with fresh aromatic herbs and a wonderfully fresh citrus finish. The classic juniper character of Hendrick’s Gin reaches new heights with a romantic entwinement of lush green aromas, deep delicate herbal tones, and a small touch of invigorating citrus. Ideal for a classic Gin & Tonic, or venture into vibrantly effervescent territory with an Oasium Fizz, starring pink grapefruit in a flavor tour de force. Tasting notes Nose: The classic juniper character of Hendrick's Gin reaches new heights with a romantic entwinement of lush green aromas, deep delicate herbal tones, and a small touch of invigorating citrus Palate: silky verdant green notes sing in delicious harmony with cooling herbs and citrus Finish: Wonderfully fresh citrus finish.

name: Mijenta Blanco
description: Mijenta Blanco, aromatic, elegant and complex, with unfolding notes of cantaloupe, honey and cinnamon, An outstanding generous and round finish. Tasting notes Nose: Aromas of cooked agave, vanilla and caramel Palate: Rich flavors of cooked agave, vanilla, fresh fruit Finish: Nice and long

name: Château Haut-Brion Rouge 2019
description: Elegant and complex, Château Haut-Brion red presents mineral aromas and a unique complexity. Its strength lays in the finish, which is surprisingly long. This aromatic persistence is due to its very noble origins. Superb deep crimson colour. At first, the bouquet is both subtle and intense, with ripe fruit notes. The aromatic complexity of this wine comes to the fore with aeration. Starts out wonderfully smooth and delicate on the palate, becoming full-bodied yet never aggressive. The tannins are tight-knit, subtle and alluring, with no hardness whatsoever. The finish is long and aromatic. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot: 48.7%, Cabernet Franc: 8.1%, Cabernet Sauvignon: 43.2% Year: 2019

name: Aloxe-Corton Les Paulands 1er Cru, Domaine Caroline Frey Rouge 2019
description: In the glass, this wine shows a deep ruby-red hue. The nose is vibrant and fruit-forward, offering layers of blackcurrant, blackberry, and cherry. On the palate, it reveals a generous body and refined complexity, enhanced by a touch of appealing sweetness. A graceful, lingering finish brings elegance and harmony to the overall tasting experience. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2019

name: Volnay, Domaine Caroline Frey Rouge 2019
description: Brilliant in appearance with ruby highlights, this wine offers a rich and precise nose of blackberries and cherries, wrapped in toasted, oaky notes. On the palate, it is well-balanced, combining body, fruit, and flesh with impressive depth and a beautiful, lingering finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2019

name: Savigny-Les-Beaune Clos Des Guettotes Rouge, Domaine Caroline Frey 2019
description: A deep garnet color catches the eye, while the nose is immediately expressive, bursting with aromas of black fruits and spices. On the palate, the wine reveals a beautifully rich texture, dense, juicy, and vibrant. Its extraordinary balance makes it remarkably enjoyable even at a young age. Country : France Region : Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2019

name: Cheval Noir Bordeaux Blanc 2024
description: This white Bordeaux wine results from a wonderful selection of Sauvignon. Cold Maceration and Process using non-fermented matter at the bottom of the Vat confer fullness and smoothness on tasting. This fruity wine with a hint of citrus fruit gives a long-lasting after-taste. This wine comes from vines grown on hillside slopes. The harvest is considered 'early' to achieve wines that emphasize freshness. The winemaking style reflects the intention to express the Sauvignon Blanc grape and its richest aromas. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc

name: Piccini Collezione Privata Toscana IGT 2021
description: Mario Piccini opens the doors of his cellar, inviting you to taste his "Collezione Privata" (Italian for "Private Collection"). This selection has been meticulously curated by Mario Piccini himself, and his signature on each bottle stands as a personal guarantee of the wine's quality. Country: Italy Grape Variety: 40% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Syrah, 20% Sangiovese Tasting notes: It showcases a deep red hue, reminiscent of luxurious brocade. The bouquet reveals its rich and opulent essence, adorned with hints of spices, chocolate, ripe plums, and blackberries. The sip is marked by subtle sweetness, accompanying towards a prosperous and full-bodied experience. Flavors of licorice, resin, and ripe fruits dance on the palate, pleasing the senses. The supple tannins contribute to a velvety texture, weaving a lingering and profound finish.

name: Piccini Collezione Privata Toscana IGT Bianco 2024
description: Mario Piccini opens the doors of his cellar, inviting you to taste his "Collezione Privata" (Italian for "Private Collection"). This selection has been meticulously curated by Mario Piccini himself, and his signature on each bottle stands as a personal guarantee of the wine's quality. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: 40% Vermentino, 40% Chardonnay, 20% Trebbiano Tasting notes: On the nose, vibrant aromas of ripe citrus fruits mingle with hints of tropical pineapple and delicate floral notes. The palate is greeted with a crisp acidity and a harmonious balance between the zesty lemon, ripe peach, and subtle herbal undertones. The wine finishes with a lingering, refreshing minerality, leaving a lasting impression of elegance and finesse.

name: Piccini Martina Vermentino Toscana IGT Bianco 2024
description: Vermentino, a jewel of Tuscan viticulture, is a grape that thrives under the Mediterranean sun and coastal breezes of this storied region. Its ability to express the unique character of the terroir makes it a beloved choice for both locals and wine enthusiasts worldwide. This varietal captures the essence of Tuscany's coastal elegance, offering a crisp and harmonious wine that speaks to the region's dedication to quality and innovation. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Vermentino Tasting notes: This vermentino stands out for an aromatic bouquet of white flowers, citrus and Mediterranean herbaceous notes. The palate is fresh and savory, with a pleasant acidity that enhances the sensations of yellow fruit. The finish is long and mineral, with an elegant persistence.

name: Piccini Martina Vermentino Toscana IGT Rosato 2024
description: Nestled in the southern Tuscany, the Maremma region is a land of wild nature, pristine coastlines, and unique biodiversity. Here, for years, the Piccini family has interpreted the essence of the terroir, just as our Vermentino which inherits its name and personality from Martina, Mario Piccini’s sister. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: 85% Vermentino, 15% Syrah Tasting notes: It presents a delicate pale pink color. On the nose, it offers a moderately intense bouquet, with floral notes of broom flowers and tea roses, which give way to a mineral freshness. The subtle spiciness from the Syrah adds complexity, enhancing the wine’s aromatic profile. On the palate, it is dry and moderately intense, with a medium structure that balances a pleasing smoothness. The finish is savory and refreshing, leaving a delightful, lingering taste that invites another sip.

name: Piccini Elisa sangiovese Rosato Toscana IGT 2024
description: In the heart of Tuscany, where rolling hills cradle the vineyards, the Sangiovese grape takes on a graceful new life as a rosé. This delicate wine reflects the soul of its land, balancing the vibrant freshness of ripe red berries with a whisper of floral elegance. Named in honor of Elisa, sister of Mario Piccini, this rosé embodies family heritage and the passion for winemaking that has defined the Piccini legacy. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese Tasting Notes: This wine features delicate copper hues and a complex bouquet of fresh red fruits, citrus, and white flowers. On the palate, it stands out for its freshness and liveliness, with a pleasant acidity balancing subtle fruity undertones. The finish is elegant, with mineral hints and a light aromatic persistence.

name: Piccini Elisa Sangiovese Bianco Toscana IGT 2024
description: The Sangiovese grape, renowned for its bold red wines, undergoes a fascinating transformation when vinified in white. By gently pressing the grapes and swiftly separating the juice from the skins, this process avoids the extraction of the grape’s typical red pigments, yielding a crisp, golden-hued wine. The result is an elegant expression of Sangiovese, showcasing its vibrant acidity and delicate aromas of citrus, white flowers, and subtle stone fruits. This innovative approach offers a fresh perspective on a classic varietal, blending tradition with creativity to craft a wine that's both distinctive and versatile. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Sangiovese Tasting Notes: This wine offers a delicate bouquet of white flowers, citrus fruits like lemon and grapefruit, and subtle hints of green apple and pear. On the palate, it is fresh and vibrant, with a balanced acidity that enhances its crispness. The finish reveals light mineral nuances and a pleasant persistence.

name: Luz del Alba Cabernet Sauvignon Red
Joseph Drouhin Chablis Grand Cru Les Clos 2020
description: A great wine, perhaps the one most able to express what the terroir of Chablis really is like. The colour is pale gold yellow, with greenish hints. Refined nose, with aromas of lily (« fleur de lys »), honey or preserved lemon. Astounding depth and velvety sensation (gras) on the palate, with some delicate marine nuances. Intense and long aftertaste. After 5 or 6 years, even more complex and subtle aromas develop in the wine. A wine of incomparable finesse. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2020

name: Joseph Drouhin Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru 2022
description: One of the greatest wines of Burgundy, to be tasted with awe and reverence. It has an intense golden hue. On the nose, there are some subtle tones of rose, fresh almond, citrus, honey, exotic wood and spice. Majestic and well balanced on the palate. Generous and lively at the same time. Intense and complex aftertaste. All the aromas mingle and linger for quite a long time afterwards. A wine of undeniable majesty Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Chablis Premier Cru 2023 Mont De Milieu
description: A top Premier Cru vineyard noted for growing on similar contours as the Grand Crus above the right bank of the Serein. Pierrick's vines average 25 years with some up to 35 years old. The wine is aged in stainless steel for 75% and in aged barrels for 25% giving a wine of excellent complexity and depth. A distinguished white wine that showcases intricate aromas of citrus, green apple, and flinty mineral notes. On the palate, it offers a well-structured profile with vibrant acidity and a refined, lingering finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2023

name: Beluga Gold Line Vodka 700ml in leather Gift Pack
description: Step into the spotlight and make a statement with Beluga Gold Line vodka . This flawless jewel in the Beluga crown stands as the pinnacle of vodka artistry, a blend of the unequaled craftsmanship and expertise of our Beluga master distillers, resulting in a liquid masterpiece that captivates the senses. A truly exceptional vodka, Beluga Gold Line has a unique serving ceremony, the special wax-sealed cork should be opened with the elegant hammer and brush that accompany the bottle. Beluga Gold Line complex palette makes it an essential for the most discerning of drinkers. With an exquisitely crisp taste, Beluga Gold Line is bold and luxurious, and is the perfect vodka for your martini. Tasting notes: Clear and pure taste, light notes of grains and wheat reminiscent of alpine herbs Food Pairing: black caviar, red meat dishes and red fish Beluga Gold Line OPENING ritual: 1. Cover the neck of the bottle with a serviette which keeps the sealing wax from spreading around; 2. Smash a serviette covered bottle neck with a special hammer attached to a bottle; 3. Clear the remaining sealing wax with the brush on the other end of the hammer; 4. Remove muselet; 5. After the opening, the bottle should be closed with the cork and remain standing on the table in the ice-bucket; 6. The muselet and the hammer should be left on the saucer on the table as well

name: Beluga Noble Vodka 1.5 L
description: Beluga Noble vodka is a world-renowned, premium brand, produced at the vibrant Adriatic Riviera, in Montenegro. With precise attention to the distillation process, Beluga Noble vodka is created from the finest grain spirit and pure spring water. It has a delightfully smooth, balanced taste, an excellent choice for your martini. Tasting notes: Fresh and elegant wheat taste with a distant hint of flowers Food Pairing: red and black caviar, tartare & cold meat cuts

name: Beluga Noble Vodka 700 ML
description: Beluga Noble vodka is a world-renowned, premium brand, produced at the vibrant Adriatic Riviera, in Montenegro.
