name: Croix Canon 2018
description: This wine boasts a beautiful, dark, and intense color. The bouquet is refined and expressive, offering layers of ripe raspberry and blackberry, complemented by subtle spice and a hint of vanilla. On the palate, it opens smoothly with a light, elegant touch, revealing a complex and well-structured character. With a powerful tasting profile, it has excellent aging potential, suited for cellaring over 5 to 10 years. Country: France Region: Bordeaux, Saint-Emilion Grape Variety: 80% Merlot 20% Cabernet Franc Year: 2018

name: Château Figeac Saint-Emilion 2018
description: This wine presents an intense and deep purple hue, hinting at its richness and depth. On the nose, it opens with fresh, vibrant aromas of wild berries and ripe fruit, gradually unfolding into subtle mineral notes reminiscent of graphite. The palate is well-balanced, showcasing refined tannins and concentrated black fruit flavors, culminating in a distinctive saline finish that adds complexity and elegance. Château Figeac Saint-Emilion 2018 is a superb expression of the vintage, offering perfect harmony between rounded Merlot, elegant Cabernet Franc, and silky Cabernet Sauvignon. Country: France Region: Bordeaux, Saint-Emilion Grape Variety: 37% Merlot, 33% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Cabernet franc Year: 2018

name: Ségla Margaux 2016
description: Extremely attractive aromas of currants, raspberries and blueberries follow through to a full body with silky tannins, and a beautiful balance and fruit, tannin and acidity harmony. Showcases vibrant flavors of red fruits and subtle spice. Its smooth tannins and well-balanced structure lead to a long, elegant finish, making it an ideal companion for a variety of dishes or perfect for sipping on its own. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2016

name: Château Tour de Pez Saint-Estèphe 2022
description: Full-bodied with robust tannins and balanced acidity, leading to a long, elegant finish. This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, hearty stews, and aged cheeses, showcasing the classic depth and complexity of the Saint-Estèphe appellation. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot Year: 2022

name: Domaine Ott Château De Selle Jeroboam 3 Liters
description: A subtle balance between structure and finesse, this wine is a perfect illustration of the precision required to make a rosé, the rigorous process that celebrates the flesh of the fruit and the very heart of the grape. The wine is a reflection of the complexity of its limestone hillsides and arid soil; austerity bathed in dazzling sunshine. Elegant and well-balanced, featuring crisp acidity and a smooth, refreshing finish. This refined rosé pairs beautifully with seafood, salads, and light Mediterranean dishes, embodying the essence of Provence. Country: France Region: Provence Grape Variety: Shiraz/Syrah, Mourvedre, Cinsault, Grenache

name: Château Pontet-Canet 2020
description: The 2020 vintage of Château Pontet Canet is a deep, rich wine showcasing the power and elegance typical of Pauillac. With a blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon, it offers intense aromas of black fruit, such as cassis and blackberry, with hints of pencil shavings and tobacco. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot Year: 2020

name: Château Roquefort Bordeaux Blanc 2024
description: Pale, transparent yellow with a bright and shining clarity, Floral bouquet with jasmine, hawthorn or acacia, and lemon blossom, Generous and full-bodied, showing mandarin, pear, lychee and pineapple, balanced by vivid freshness and fine acidity. A good length with succulent sweetness and minerality. Country: France Region: Entre‑Deux‑Mers, Bordeaux Grape Variety: 85% Sauvignon Blanc, 15% Sémillon Year: 2024

name: Château Roquefort 2022
description: Clear, bright ruby-red with cherry highlights, Varietal character of Merlot shows groseille (red currant) and black cherry, with underlying vanilla and licorice hints, Supple entry, full-bodied with red fruits and Morello cherry, a vanilla‑licorice finish, and soft yet present tannins. Country: France Region: Entre‑Deux‑Mers, Bordeaux Grape Variety: 85% Merlot, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2022

name: Château Bellevue Figeac St-Emilion 2020
description: Château Bellevue Figeac 2022 presents a deep ruby red hue. The nose opens with vibrant aromas of cassis, blackberry, and mulberry, gently accented by vanilla, spice, and subtle tobacco. On the palate, it is gracefully balanced, featuring ripe, plush tannins and a medium-bodied, velvety texture. A refined structure and earthy-mineral undertones add complexity, leading to a smooth and persistent finish. Country: France Region: Saint‑Émilion Grand Cru, Bordeaux Grape Variety: 85% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Franc, 5% Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2020

name: Suntory Roku Gin + Glass
description: Roku Japanese Craft Gin: Roku is a perfectly balanced, exceptional gin combining six distinctive Japanese botanicals with eight traditional botanicals. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, Roku is the award winning gin that offers the best of every season. Tasting notes Nose: Cherry blossom and green tea provide a floral and sweet aroma. Palate: Complex, multi layered, yet harmonious flavor of various botanicals. Traditional gin taste in the base, plus characteristic Japanese botanical notes with yuzu as the top note. Smooth and silky texture. Finish: The crisp Japanese sansho pepper brings a little spiciness to the finish.

name: Provence Rose By Ott 2023
description: The nose is delicate and fruity with notes of white peach and apricot mixed with passion fruit and mango. The taste is full, fresh and crisp with echoes of the fruity aroma amplified by citrus zest and sweet spices. With a crisp acidity and elegant finish, it’s perfect for sipping on warm days or pairing with light dishes like seafood and salads. Country: France Region: Provence Grape Variety: Syrah, Cinsault, Grenache Year: 2023

name: Almaza Light Beer Pack Of 6
description: Exp Date :18-6-2026

name: Piccini Bianco Toscana 2024
description: A fruity wine, lively palate with citrus fruit and mineral undertones. Country: Italy Region: Tuscany Grape Variety: Chardonnay, Trebbiano, Vermentino

name: Patron Silver Tequila 1 LTR
description: Patrón Silver features a crystal clear color with aromas of fruits and citrus, The palate is smooth and sweet, showcasing citrus and pepper notes, the finish is clean with lingering notes of pepper. Tasting notes Nose: Citrus, and fruity Palate: Smooth and sweet with notes of pepper Finish: Lingering notes of pepper

name: Dimple 15Yo 1 LTR
description: Dimple 15 Years old blended scotch whisky has a distinctive and unique three-sided bottle, which has become a unique feature of this product, Rich, Soft and complex. Tasting notes Nose: Notes of spice and caramel Palate: Honey and toffee, a wee bit of smoke Finish: Fudge, toffee and caramel

name: RIEDEL White Wine/Champagne Glass/Spritz Drinks (Set of 2)
Piemonte Pinot Nero 2022 La Scolca
description: Intense and brilliant ruby. Fragrant, exuberant in its youth with rose and raspberry: into its maturity it tends to a rich and complex “bouquet” of spices and evolved scents. Intense body, rich, important and warm, with a complex pleasantness that vanishes into a delicate almond memories. Country: Italy Region: Piemonte Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Nero Year: 2022

name: La Scolca Gavi Dei Gavi Etichetta Nera 2023
description: Intense, long, continuous, persistent, from fruited to flowery to stage of development. Highly typical, flinty accents; almonds and hazelnut in the finale. La Scolca Gavi dei Gavi Etichetta Nera, an exquisite Italian white wine. Known for its crisp acidity and elegant notes of green apple and white flowers, this wine offers a refreshing finish. Perfect with seafood or light pasta, it’s a true expression of the Gavi region's excellence. Country: Italy Region: Piemonte Grape Variety: Cortese Year: 2023

name: Château Dubois Claverie 2020
description: The wine is round and generous with crushed red cherries, cranberry fruit, cassis, good mouth-feel and density, and bright red acidity going into the midpalate. A refined wine with vibrant berry flavors and subtle spice. Its smooth finish and excellent balance make it perfect for grilled meats or sipping on its own. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2020

name: Valpolicella Ventiterre 2020
description: Ruby red in color, this Valpolicella offers aromas of wild berries, black currants, black cherries, and spices, with hints of chocolate. On the palate, the wine is dry and fresh with velvety texture.

name: Château Fonfroide Rosé 2018
description: Pale in color, this crisp wine offers a touch of yeastiness that contrasts with the red-currant fruits. It has plenty of bright acidity as well as a tangy, zesty aftertaste. Country: France Region: Bordeaux Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot

name: Jp Chenet Sauvignon Blanc 2023
description: JP. CHENET is a French wine which really stands out above the fray. Its unique bottle reveals a piece of authenticity and savoir-faire that many others have tried to imitate. Bursting with freshness, a highly aromatic, very light wine. Country: France Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2023

name: Aurora Rosé 2023
description: This wine has a blush pink color. The nose is of a medium intensity with fresh red berries ( raspberries and strawberries). The palate is medium bodied with notes of strawberry and raspberry and a medium to high acidity, and a long lasting silky finish. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: 100% Cabernet Franc

name: Aurora Cuvée du Patron
description: A nose of pearl and yellow apples followed by secondary aromas of honeycomb and buttery brioche. This wine is full-bodied, silky, voluminous with medium flavor intensity and primary flavors of apple and pear followed by butter and toast. This lively yet balanced wine presents a harmonious picture of yellow fruit, subtle toast and a creamy long-lasting finish. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay

name: Aurora Cuvée N 2024
description: Aurora Cuvee N pays homage to the winemaker's wife, Nathalie, whose fondness for Sauvignon Blanc blossomed during their travels to Sancerre. This wine boasts a vibrant green hue with subtle purple undertones. Delighting the palate are prominent flavors of citrus fruit, melon, and gooseberry. It presents a medium intensity on the palate, accompanied by lively acidity and hints of grapefruit. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: 100% Sauvignon Blanc

name: Aurora Crystal 2024
description: The color is a bright, clear gold. The nose is intense, featuring aromas of yellow apple, pear, and bananas. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with medium acidity and flavors of yellow fruits. These primary flavors are complemented by secondary notes of biscuit and a creamy mouthfeel, resulting from stirring the lees during. Country: Lebanon Region: Batroun Grape Variety: Chardonnay

name: Vina Sol White 2024
description: Medium-bodied profile with bright acidity and a clean finish. Crisp and fruity whites are dry, medium-dry or medium-sweet. They are typically crisply acidic, which balances their rich fruitiness. You can discern yellow plum, apple and peach notes in this wine. Crisp acids create a fresh finish. Perfect for pairing with seafood, salads, and light dishes, this wine embodies the sunny spirit of its origins. Country: Spain Region: Catalunya Grape Variety: Parellada, Grenache Blanc Year: 2024

name: Barolo Tradizione Marchesi Di Barolo 2020
description: The color is garnet red with ruby hues. The aroma is intense and persistent with clean scents of spices, cinnamon, absinthe, tobacco and rose bush. The taste is full and elegant and with soft tannins. Country: Italy Region: Piemonte Grape Variety: Nebbiolo

name: Barbaresco Tradizione Marchesi Di Barolo 2021
description: It showcases elegant flavors of red cherry, rose petals, and earthy notes, with well-structured tannins and a long, harmonious finish. Country: Italy Region: Piemonte Grape Variety: Nebbiolo Year: 2021

name: Araucano Cabernet Sauvignon 2019
description: Beautiful, very deep red robe with cherry glints. Very aromatic nose, characterized by intense fruit, with fresh blackcurrants and complex notes of thyme and garrigue. Powerful on the palate, coated with concentrated tannins, that nevertheless show great finesse. The finish is very long, full flavored and complex. A bold wine featuring rich flavors of dark berries, plum, and hints of spice. Its firm tannins and balanced acidity create a smooth finish, making it perfect for pairing with grilled meats or enjoying on its own. Country: Chile Grape Variety: Cabernet Sauvignon Year: 2019

name: Malbec Alta Bio Rouge 2023
description: This wine showcases a brilliant ruby color, inviting and vivid in the glass. On the nose, it reveals intense aromas of ripe red fruits, beautifully accented by subtle hints of black pepper. The palate is structured and well-balanced, delivering a long, lingering finish with delicate nuances of chocolate and coffee that add depth and sophistication. Country: Argentina Region: Mendoza Grape Variety: 100% Malbec

name: Chateauneuf-Du-Pape Les Cedres 2022
description: Expect rich black cherry and raisiny notes on the nose and palate. The texture is soft with a wild game, pepper, garrigue finish. This wine presents a dark, intense red hue, a visual testament to its concentration and maturity. On the nose, it reveals deep aromas of wild berries, intertwined with hints of leather, aromatic herbs, and an elegant touch of oak. On the palate, it is both powerful and balanced, showcasing flavors of black cherry and garrigue, supported by a beautifully structured tannic backbone that adds depth and aging potential. Country: France Region: Rhone Valley Grape Variety: Grenache, Cinsault, Syrah, Mourvedre Year: 2022

name: Crozes Hermitage Les Jalets Rouge 2022
description: Crozes-Hermitage 'Les Jalets' originates from terraced vineyards in Les Chassis, named after the pebbles deposited by alpine glaciers, reminiscent of Châteauneuf-du-Pape. Aromas of black fruits and spices, with silky and refined tannins. Full-bodied experience with well-integrated tannins and lively acidity, culminating in a long, smooth finish. This wine pairs beautifully with grilled meats, hearty stews. Country: France Region: Vallée du Rhône Grape Variety: 100% Syrah

name: Humo Blanco Cabernet Sauvignon Bio Rouge 2023
description: Organic red wine from Chile’s Colchagua Valley. Made from 100% Cabernet Sauvignon, it offers bold aromas of blackberry, grilled pepper, and vanilla. With 14.5% alcohol, it’s full-bodied and smooth, balanced by a fresh eucalyptus finish ideal with lamb, pork, or aged cheeses. Country: Chile Grape Variety: 100% Cabernet Sauvignon

name: Volnay 1er Cru Brouillards 2022 Violot-Guillemard Rouge
description: Its color is a deep ruby red. The nose is fresh and delicate, featuring floral scents like violet and rose, along with hints of red and black fruits. On the palate, it shows a well-balanced structure with noticeable fruit and tannins. The finish is long and memorable Country: France Region: Volnay, Côte de Beaune, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Volnay 2022 Violot-Guillemard Rouge
description: Vivid crimson hue with lively mixed red fruits. It offers a balanced, medium-length finish without any dryness. Hints of redcurrant emerge on the finish. Country: France Region: Volnay, Côte de Beaune, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune En Château Clos Monopole - Violot-Guillemard 2022
description: Its color is intense red. Its nose is fresh, floral, and fruity. Its palate is delicious and crisp with controlled tannins. Country: France Region: Hautes-Côtes de Beaune, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Vosne-Romanée - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2022
description: A prestigious red Burgundy with layers of dark cherry, violets, exotic spices, and subtle oak. Velvety in texture and impeccably balanced, this wine offers a luxurious expression of one of Burgundy’s most sought-after villages. Country: France Region: Vosne-Romanée, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Volnay - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2023
description: Elegant and perfumed, this Volnay is a charming Pinot Noir with floral notes, red berries, and silky tannins. Lighter in body but complex, it embodies the grace of the Volnay appellation. Country: France Region: Volnay, Burgundy Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Pommard - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2023
description: Known for its robust style, this Pommard presents rich red fruit, forest floor, and savory spice. A full-bodied Burgundy with refined tannins and a long, expressive finish. Country: France Region: Pommard, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Nuits-Saint-Georges Les Grandes Vignes - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2023
description: A deeper, more muscular expression of Pinot Noir, this cuvée from a prestigious site delivers ripe plum, black cherry, and earthy spice. Firm tannins and aging potential balance its concentrated fruit core. Country: France Region: Nuits Saint-Georges, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Gevrey-Chambertin - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2023
description: From one of the Côte de Nuits’ most renowned villages, this Pinot Noir is structured and complex, with dark berry fruit, hints of smoke, and a touch of oak. A wine of power and elegance, ideal for cellaring or enjoying with rich dishes. Country: France Region: Gevrey Chambertin, Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune - Arnaud Baillot Rouge 2023
description: This Pinot Noir showcases bright red cherry and raspberry aromas with delicate spice and earthy undertones. Light-bodied yet expressive, it’s a classic example of the finesse and purity of fruit typical of the Hautes-Côtes de Beaune. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Pinot Noir

name: Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune - Arnaud Baillot Blanc 2023
description: A fresh and vibrant white Burgundy, this Chardonnay from the Hautes-Côtes de Beaune offers notes of green apple, citrus, and white flowers, underpinned by a subtle minerality. Crisp acidity and a clean finish make it an elegant, easy-drinking wine. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay

name: Cabinet d’Oeno-Curiosités - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Sommelier Box, Gift Box A secret place... which opens its doors to a collection – useful – of Wine Tools; but also to the memory of beautiful shared tastings, trips to the vineyards, visits to winemakers... A collection which, over time, becomes intimate and personal. Cabinet of Oeno-Curiosities: The Art of Tasting Inspired by the cabinets of Renaissance amateurs where a personal collection of unique objects was grouped in a room or a piece of furniture, the Cabinet of Oeno-Curiosities contains the Wine Tools essential to any tasting ritual. In solid walnut wood , placed on a piece of furniture or hung on a wall like a painting, discreet when closed, theatrical when open, the Cabinet of Oeno-Curiosities notably reveals: the Oeno Motion Wood & Chrome in hand-veneered wood, the Chrome Bimetal , the Chrome Metal Boy , the Gard'Vin On/Off metal . Personal and unique, the Cabinet of Wine Curiosities will be enriched through journeys through the vineyards or visits to winemakers with the story of each exceptional tasting . Indeed, dedicated in particular to connoisseurs, the Cabinet of Wine Curiosities will welcome wine corks in its center as so many imperishable souvenirs. A true piece of high-end craftsmanship in the pure tradition of French tablet-making, each Cabinet of Oeno-Curiosities is unique, just like each collector.

name: Verseur Aérateur Souple - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Flexible wine pourer - Pack of 5 Clean cut-off flow for a spotless tablecloth. Gentle oxygenation and revelation of the wine's aromas. Flexible Aerator Pourer: Precision and oxygenation An innovation linked to a design deposit from L'Atelier du Vin, the Flexible Aerating Pourer offers a 2-in-1 service. Shaped like a feather, the Flexible Aerating Pourer cuts the flow of poured wine , ensuring precision when serving while avoiding unsightly stains on tablecloths. The Pourer's great flexibility also allows this little feather to fit any bottle neck . The Soft Aerating Pourer features a raised oxygenation zone to gently reveal the wine's aroma. Its silver color plays with the wine's reflections, enhancing the colors, and serving becomes a ritual. The Flexible Aerating Pourer comes with a pouch for stylish storage of the five reusable pourers. An effective and essential tool for enthusiasts and amateurs alike.

name: Bilame - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Black metal bi-blade corkscrew The Bilame Corkscrew, a historic professional tool from L'Atelier du Vin since 1949 (patent date), easily extracts corks while leaving them intact, even those that are old and fragile. The cork is not pierced, and therefore does not crumble. The Bilame can also be used to reseal an opened bottle. Legend has it that the Bilame was very popular with certain waiters, who used it to take a few centilitres from bottles, "top them up" with water, and reseal them without leaving any trace of tampering. Instructions for using the bimetallic corkscrew 1. Insert the tip of the longer blade first, then the tip of the shorter one. 2. Push the blades in one after the other, using a rocking motion. 3. Once the blades are in, pull the Bi-Blade Corkscrew out by turning its handle.

name: Soft Machine Crystal - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Crystalline design. Ergonomic prowess. Easy to grip. Through the transparency of the polycarbonate handle, this Soft Machine Crystal ® edition highlights the ingenuity of its rack mechanism . Holding the cork vertically for extraction in a single continuous movement , this unique gear distinguishes the Soft Machine ® from other sommelier corkscrews, which require uncorking in two stages. Made of steel and chrome alloy, the support lever, the worm and the cogs absorb the pressure while multiplying the force of the hand. In finesse, the opening gesture is fluid and gentle like a caress.

name: Oeno Motion Trésor - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Lever corkscrew set The Oeno Motion Trésor is a unique gift. At first glance, it appears as a mysterious wooden box, lacquered in a delicate red. Its fine, high-definition laser engravings evoke the revisited aesthetic of antique trunks. Stamped L'Atelier du Vin, it suggests to connoisseurs the mark of a precious oenology jewel box. Once the box is opened, a deep emotion suddenly emanates from it, when its centerpiece is revealed. An authentic vertical lever corkscrew from the Oeno Motion collection, wisely positioned in its case, stands ready to open exceptional bottles.

name: Chic Set Night - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Corkscrew and wine preservation set Here, brought together in a pretty graphic box, is a duo of essential tools for opening and preserving wine. Chic Set Night: Chic, a gift and a Chic gift Here, gathered together in a beautiful, graphic box, are a pair of essential tools for opening and preserving wine. A pair that will make a great gift. No bottle can resist Chic Monsieur® Night . This worm-action corkscrew is world-renowned for its attractive shape, ease of use, and elegance. The attractive ergonomics and high technicality of the Gard'Vin On/Off , a vacuum pump for preserving the soul of opened bottles, have enabled it to become an absolute benchmark in Wine Tools for over twenty years. A must-have for any enthusiast, Chic Set Night is dressed in elegant black to fit into the kitchen or on the most beautiful tables and bring chic without ostentation. It's a safe bet that those who receive it as a gift will say: Oh, Chic Set Night!

name: Oeno Box Sommelier - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Chrome-plated metal lever corkscrew The ideal box set for easily opening all bottles, discovering the best vintages and mastering the essential wine and food pairings for successful gourmet dinners. Black box of oenology. In this sommelier's secret chest, you'll find an authentic professional lever corkscrew. Each opening is clean and precise, whatever the type of bottle. Inexhaustible, your chrome-plated metal bottle opener comes with a spare wick and a Wine Ring ® ring . To clip onto the neck to honor your bottle of wine, this jewel absorbs drips during service. The Oeno Box Sommelier ® box also contains a precious pocket Millésimes guide in cardholder format, recalling the vintage years in France from 1977 to 2020 and providing indicative notes on the wines of Burgundy, Bordeaux, Loire, Alsace and the Rhône Valley. Finally, you'll find in your oenological treasure box a printed table of food and wine pairings , to guide you towards the right choices.

name: Oeno Box Connoisseur 1 - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Sommelier Box, Gift Box - This set is sold without a bottle. This set brings together L'Atelier du Vin's iconic tools for opening, serving, and preserving still and sparkling wines. Oeno Box Connoisseur: Gift for connoisseurs In the pure tradition of French tablet making , the Oeno Box Connoisseur brings together the iconic tools of L'Atelier du Vin in a solid maple wood and birch plywood case . The Oeno Motion Wood & Chrome , the Chrome Bilame , the Chrome Metal Garçon , and the Gard'Vin On/Off metal are brought together here in a beautiful box so that the service and preservation of still and sparkling wines are placed under the sign of excellence and joy. A piece of high-end craftsmanship , each Oeno Box Connoisseur is unique because it is handmade. Accompanied by a bottle of wine or champagne, this is a gift that will thrill the five senses of the person who receives it.

name: Up & Down - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Lever Corkscrew and Champagne Preserver Stopper Set Brought together in the Up & Down box, these two sommelier tools are the masters of tasting time, from the first drop to the last bubble. It will preserve all the effervescence of your bottle of champagne or sparkling wine, so you can enjoy it better tomorrow. In moments of great joy, as in more serious moments; during a special occasion or a more intimate dinner; sometimes we open a bottle, sometimes we close it. Up & Down is the set that accompanies you in opening your finest bottles as well as in preserving them. Whether the mood is festive or more conservative, these wine tools follow your desires. The set includes two essentials for wine lovers. The best of L'Atelier du Vin's wine tools, in a handmade case: the Bubble Cork – Silver , with its remarkable ergonomics, guarantees the perfect preservation of your bottles of still and sparkling wines such as champagne. The Oeno Motion Leather&Silver , an iconic creation from L'Atelier du Vin, is the corkscrew of a lifetime. It has a handmade handle, covered in genuine leather and comes with a removable wick protector, made of genuine leather. A capsule cutter is integrated into the corkscrew. A bottle of special oil, for regular lubrication over the years, completes the set.

name: Oeno Motion Gold – Nomad - L'atelier
description: There is chic in the Oeno Motion Gold – Nomad. The chic of supple matte black leather on the exterior meets the chic of smooth, technical black leather to prevent wine stains on the interior. Responsibly sourced leathers, tanned entirely in Italy. Timeless chic that develops a patina over time. In keeping with the Nomad Collection, the Oeno Motion Gold – Nomad case contains the essential L'Atelier du Vin corkscrew, presented here in a golden amber tinted version. Its black natural leather handle gives it softness and allows for a pleasant gesture for opening bottles. Aesthetic to the end, a leather wick protector completes the incomparable style of the Oeno Motion Gold. Take it out for special evenings, give it as a gift, or treat yourself for a pure chic and shocking moment.

name: Gard’Vin On/Off Power - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Electric wine pump Technology is in the air. T he Gard'Vin On/Off Power extends the shelf life and tasting window of precious wines after opening. Thus, we can say that it provides a proud service to sommeliers, wine merchants and also to lovers of good wines. Its little extra: its technology which allows efficient and precise vacuum sealing. The air absorption is automatic, it is indicated by an audible signal and by a white LED in the different beams indicating the stages of the operation. The motor cuts itself off once the air vacuum is obtained. The great vintages have some good days ahead of them. Gard'Vin On/Off Power Electronic Vacuum Pump Fully automated, the vacuum pump used by many oenologists, wine merchants and restaurateurs presents itself with elegance and humility at the tasting table. A little gem of technology, the Gard'Vin On/Off Power allows you to extend the life of wines after opening, to better extend the tasting window. Thanks to its 3 valve conservation stoppers , these are as many great vintages that you can keep to taste them for several more days, without losing a single drop.

name: Chic Monsieur - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Steel worm corkscrew Chic Monsieur® was born from the desire to pay homage to the tool by revealing its bare, unadorned structure, reconnecting with a simple and purely functional form. A thin, curved stainless steel ribbon, designed like an arch above the neck, Chic Monsieur® features an expressive head that makes it easy to grip, and a worm screw system that simplifies cork removal.

name: Chic Monsieur Night - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Black worm corkscrew This worm-action corkscrew is as simple as it is effective. Its lightness and intuitive operation make it a must-have in the kitchen, living room, cellar, and more. With the Chic Monsieur® Night, bottles are uncorked easily and continuously. This L'Atelier du Vin classic uses the principle and shape of the tuning fork to assert a pure aesthetic and optimize pulling efforts. The advantages of the Chic Monsieur® Night: Polycarbonate structure: strong, durable, very light and recyclable. Handle designed for optimal grip. Tightened “legs” to ensure the best possible support on the neck of the bottle.

name: Chef Sommelier - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Sommelier corkscrew in wood and steel Thick and “easy to hold”, with a strict design. Ebony and steel . Two noble materials, united in a strict and refined design, for a corkscrew that combines robustness and elegance. The Chef Sommelier is designed for those who prioritize solidity and efficiency without compromise. Its thickness offers a perfect grip, allowing easy and secure handling to open each bottle with the precision of a true sommelier. Equipped with a grooved bit , a foil cutter, and a bottle opener , this corkscrew is a complete tool that stands out thanks to its ingenious double support notch. Thanks to its double lever system (popular with hotel and restaurant professionals), the cork is extracted in two stages: the first delicately removes half of the cork, while the second releases the cork from the bottle with greater amplitude. The solid wood facets are handcrafted . Thus, each Chef Sommelier corkscrew is unique, highlighting the beauty of the wood and the craftsmanship. More than just a tool, the Chef Sommelier becomes an extension of the connoisseur's hand, offering a firm and comfortable grip. Every detail is designed to optimize effortless efficiency, making this accessory a must-have for any discerning wine lover.

name: Le Vigneron – L'Atelier Du Vin
description: The Vigneron is the “direct extraction” corkscrew for all tables and all bottles. The T-shaped corkscrew: simplicity and robustness A simple design . An elegant design . Proven effectiveness . The Le Vigneron T-shaped corkscrew has it all. The wick , the centerpiece of the tool, easily inserts into the cork for a smooth extraction. Every detail of the design of this classic corkscrew is thought out to offer an optimal user experience. Its ergonomic design allows for a comfortable and secure grip. In addition, the high-quality materials used guarantee exceptional durability , resisting wear and tear over time. The minimalist design of the T-shaped corkscrew stands out for its simplicity and elegance. The duo formed by these two tools embodies the vision of L'Atelier du Vin: to offer wine accessories that are as beautiful as they are functional . At the Winegrower's Table The gesture is natural and precise . Designed by Marc Venot , Le Vigneron is a pure example of his design philosophy, which can be summed up by the correct use of an object that you keep for a long time. Its stainless steel body coated with a PVD skin guarantees exceptional longevity. The Vigneron stands the test of time with elegance and finds its place at any table, bringing a touch of sophistication to every occasion. To protect delicate surfaces, the Le Vigneron T-shaped corkscrew features a waterproof synthetic leather pad. This pad ensures a smooth and secure fit on glass tables or other sensitive surfaces, preventing any scratches or damage. With this T-shaped corkscrew, each bottle opening becomes a ritual imbued with respect for the wine and its history. This corkscrew is not only a practical tool , but also a work of art that enhances the tasting experience. Using Le Vigneron means choosing sustainability and authenticity , while paying homage to winemaking traditions.

name: Oeno Motion Wood & Black - L'atelier Du Vin
description: Compact and rugged, the Oeno Motion Wood & Black vertical lever corkscrew ensures quick and safe opening of any wine bottle that crosses its path. At first glance, its swaying curve, enhanced by the matte black technical coating, gives it a devastating charisma. Unperturbable, its powerful jaw with integrated foil cutter is suitable for most neck diameters. To open a bottle with the Oeno Motion Wood & Black corkscrew, simply position its treated steel worm above the cork and operate its lever with an ergonomic handle , nobly adorned with solid walnut. In a fluid movement combining strength and finesse, the extraction is clear and effortless. A simple additional back and forth movement of the lever is enough to remove the cork from the tool. To achieve this very high level of reliability and ergonomics, the Oeno Motion Wood & Black corkscrew has undergone numerous technical improvements each year. Particular attention has been paid to the quality and strength of the metal used in the wear parts, which are subject to high pressure when the mechanism is in operation. This flawless collector's bottle opener has become a benchmark among wine-tasting accessories. Lever corkscrew/ Tiger of metal, and dressed in wood.

name: Oeno Motion Wood & Chrome - L'Atelier Du Vin
description: Oeno Motion lever corkscrew Corkscrew. A sommelier's toy. Opening a beautiful bottle is a real pleasure with this superb vertical lever corkscrew. This chrome-plated metal and solid wood finish lends a proud look to its curved design, hinting at the fluidity of its mechanism. A signature winemaking accessory from L'Atelier du Vin, the Oeno Motion Wood & Chrome vertical lever corkscrew is, above all, a powerful wine tool, perfected year after year. In particular, the metal selected for the wear parts offers unmatched resistance over time, which makes all the difference in the long term compared to other systems that are vulnerable due to their screws and gears. This is how our registered Oeno Motion design has become the ergonomic and reliable bottle opener that oenologists, sommeliers and wine merchants use every day.

name: Johnnie Walker Black Ruby
description: Bold Never Tasted So Sweet A vibrant new blend delivering an indulgently sweet flavor experience, Johnnie Walker Black Ruby is the latest interpretation of our iconic blended Scotch Whisky, Johnnie Walker Black Label. Elevate cocktails with its deliciously sweet and smooth fruity flavors. A smooth Blended Scotch Whisky loaded with notes of fruit flavor. Tasting notes Nose: Sweet fruit and a hint of spice Palate: Bold tones of berries and deep honeyed sweetness wrap around rich notes of figs, plums and maraschino cherries Finish: Smooth sweetness from wine and bourbon casks with a lingering delicate smokiness Color: Glowing with deep berry red tones

name: Almaza Rosé NRB 6 x 25cl
description: EXP DATE : 13/6/2026

name: Pascal Jolivet Edition No. 1 Coteaux du Giennois 2023
description: Beautiful expression of Sauvignon Blanc with floral and quince notes. The minerality and suppleness of this wine are in perfect balance. Country: France Region: Loire Grape variety: Sauvignon Blanc

name: Joseph Drouhin Nuits-Saint-Georges Damodes Premier Cru 2022
description: Striking deep garnet hue. The nose reveals rich wild berry aromas complemented by subtle touches of truffle and liquorice. On the palate, it is bold and layered, with refined tannins adding elegance. The finish is full of flavor, accented by delicate spicy notes. A wine with outstanding potential for ageing. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Vougeot Petits Vougeots 2022
description: This wine displays a vibrant, deep red hue. On the nose, it is both powerful and elegant. The palate reveals notes of violet along with an array of red and dark fruits such as raspberry, Morello cherry, and blackcurrant. As it matures, it develops more complex aromas of forest floor, truffle, and liquorice, all supported by a smooth, rounded, and lush texture characteristic of the appellation. The finish is persistent and lingering. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot noir Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Chorey-les-Beaune 2020
description: A very pleasant wine. Bright, clear red color. Aromas are surprising in their intensity and fruit. On the palate, a tender, supple, graceful, round body. Very flavorful in the aftertaste, with a hint of blackberry jam. When the wine gets older, wild blackberry is the dominant aroma. After 3 or 5 years, the wine takes on a distinctive smell of truffle and undergrowth evolving towards notes of venison. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape variety: Pinot noir Year: 2020

name: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre Sauvage 2023
description: Very great complexity and minerality. Exceptional texture with persistent salinity. Country: France Region: Loire Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2023

name: Pascal Jolivet Pouilly-Fumé 2023
description: Enjoy the elegance of Pascal Jolivet Pouilly-Fumé, a vibrant Sauvignon Blanc. With crisp notes of citrus, green apple, and flint, this wine offers a refreshing minerality. Ideal for seafood or enjoyed solo, it beautifully reflects the unique terroir of the Loire Valley. Aromas of white fleshed fruits with earthy undertones. This wine will charm with its brilliance and crisp. Country: France Region: Loire Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2023

name: Joseph Drouhin Gevrey-Chambertin 2022
description: Gevrey-Chambertin is a wine with a beautiful, bright ruby color. Intensely fruity on the nose, the aromas are reminiscent of black cherry, wild blackberry and liquorice. The woody character is subtle and marries delicately with the other aromas. As the wine evolves, there are more complex notes, such as mild spice, nutmeg and leather. Later still, mushroom and damp earth nuances make their appearance. Although present on the palate, tannin is never astringent but blends itself harmoniously with the natural freshness and "gras" (velvety texture) of the wine. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Chassagne-Montrachet 2022
description: Experience the depth of Chassagne-Montrachet, a distinguished Chardonnay from Joseph Drouhin. This wine features lush fruit, elegant oak, and a hint of minerality, offering a creamy texture balanced by vibrant acidity. A generous and elegant wine. Intense nose of flower, brioche and candied lemon aromas, evolving towards nuances of grilled hazelnut and spice as the wine matures. On the palate, the wine is straightforward, with a nice texture and finesse. It has a long aftertaste where floral and gingerbread notes dominate. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Vosne-Romanée 2022
description: Supreme elegance! Beautiful color, with intense and bright reflections. The diversity of the aromas is striking: wild cherry, nutmeg, camphor wood, fine leather... Later on, the wine takes on a subtle aroma of truffle, producing the most varied palette. With its perfect balance between tannin and acidity, the wine has a fleshy, sturdy body. Powerful and long aftertaste. A wealth of harmonious sensations characterizes this great Burgundy. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Chablis Grand Cru Bougros 2022
description: A prestigious white wine made from Chardonnay grapes. It offers intense flavors of green apple, citrus, and mineral notes, complemented by a rich, creamy texture and a long, elegant finish. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Nuits-Saint-Georges 2022
description: An elegant wine that captivates with its rich flavors of dark cherry and spice. With well-integrated tannins and a balanced acidity, it offers a smooth, lingering finish. Perfect for pairing with roasted meats or savoring on its own, this wine showcases the essence of Burgundy in every sip. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Merlot Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin La Forêt Bourgogne Chardonnay 2022
description: Offers a creamy texture balanced by refreshing acidity, leading to a clean, mineral-driven finish. Full of life! A bouquet of citrus aromas, and then we find honey and vanilla. In the mouth, it's funky, spontaneous, striking. Really charming! Composed like a perfume. We have a good palette of aromas and flavors : Bourgogne Nord Auxerrois, for the freshness and character, Côte d'Or for finesse and elegance, Mâconnais to the south for the charm and fruitiness. With this structure, La forêt is a faithful wine, and we rediscover these traits from year to year. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Joseph Drouhin Côte De Nuit-Village 2022
description: A delightful red Burgundy with well-balanced flavors. It boasts a bright ruby hue and on the nose, you'll find rich aromas of wild cherry, liquorice, and subtle spices, transitioning to hints of forest floor and mushrooms. On the palate, it offers a perfect harmony of tannins, acidity, and a velvety texture. The finish is marked by a lingering taste of red berries. Country: France Region: Bourgogne Grape Variety: Pinot Noir Year: 2022

name: Pascal Jolivet Attitude Sauvignon Blanc 2023
description: “Attitude” has a nice freshness on the palate, a frank attack, delicate aromas of lime, citrus fruits, green apple and kiwi. The minerality gives the wine a long finish, finesse and elegance. Very pleasant wines on their own or accompanied by seafood, asparagus, grilled fish and goat cheese Country: France Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2023

name: Pascal Jolivet Sancerre Blanc 2023
description: Features bright flavors of citrus, green apple, and white flowers, with a crisp acidity and a mineral backbone. Unique & typical style of the house. Feminine wine, all elegance with a perfect balance. Dry, natural fruit and mineral. Country: France Region: Loire Grape Variety: Sauvignon Blanc Year: 2023

name: Olivier Leflaive Puligny-Montrachet Les Levrons 2021
description: Puligny derives from Pulynie (village on water). In the 14th Century, a Levron referred to a haunt for hares! This wine is underlined by a hint of lemongrass and citrus fruits (grapefruit). A frank and straight wine with a good length. Country: France Region: Puligny-Montrachet Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay Year: 2021

name: Olivier Leflaive Meursault Narvaux 2022
description: This word derives from Latin language "vallis" which means valley: in French: " un val, des vaux". This wine, with its discreet but delicate nose of white peach and its dry finish, is distinguished by its elegance and sobriety, offering a subtle and pleasant tasting. This wine will fully express itself in a few years. Country: France Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay Year: 2022

name: Olivier Leflaive Bourgogne Les Setilles 2021
description: A signature wine from the House. Sétilles is the cadastral name of the place in the village where Olivier Leflaive's cellar is located. This wine is expressive. The aromas of yellow fruits, peach, roasted almonds and lemon peel dominate on a mineral background. The attack is full and warm with a slightly smoky finish. Country: France Grape Variety: 100% Chardonnay. Year: 2021

name: Piccini Millerighe Pinot Grigio 2024
description: Straw yellow tones. White fruit aromas such as apple and pear on the nose and palate are accompanied by light herbal nuances. Piccini Millerighe Pinot Grigio will be perfect with seafood, poultry, vegetarian dishes and mushrooms. Country: Italy Region: Northern Italy, Veneto, Delle Venezie Grape Variety: Pinot Grigio

name: RIEDEL Bar Single Malt Vinum (Set of 2)
ESPOLON REPOSADO 70CL
description: This is the El Espolòn Reposado Tequila, produced by Destilladora San Nicolas in Los Altos. After distillation, which includes playing rock music in the factories to "inspire" the agave, the Reposado is matured in American oak barrels for six months. Following that, it's handsomely bottled, with a label bustling with skeletons and roosters.

name: ESPOLON BLANCO
description: Blanco tequila from Destilladora San Nicolas in Los Altos, made with 100% blue agave and bottled without ageing. The name "Espolòn" comes from the spur of the rooster's foot, an important bird in Mexican culture. In fact, a rooster also makes an appearance on the unique label, which is also inspired by Dia de los Muertos - Day of the Dead. Yes, it is a skeleton riding a rooster. Yes, we agree that this is awesome

name: ESPOLON ANEJO BOURBON
description: With its bright reddish-gold hue and balanced profile, this Tequila will engage and amaze your palate. Its aroma balances roasted agave and earthy wood with a touch of butterscotch. With one sip, you’ll discover its medium-to-full body, and velvety mouthfeel that ties it all together. Take in notes of caramel, vanilla, dried fruit, and chocolate to deliver an Añejo experience like no other.

name: TAMDHU 21 YEARS SPEYSIDE SINGLE MALT
description: Tamdhu 21 Year Old is the oldest expression in the core collection, matured exclusively in hand-selected American and European Oloroso sherry oak casks. Bottled at 47.5% ABV, with natural colour and no chill-filtration, this limited release offers waves of rich oak, festive fruit, and warming spice, a whisky that rewards patience.

name: 1800 ANEJO
description: Using 100% Weber blue agave, picked at their peak — anywhere from 8-12 years old — Añejo is aged in French Oak barrels for a minimum of 14 months. Its finish is described as spicy and well rounded with flavors of toasted oak, vanilla and butterscotch. This deep, luxurious tequila is ideal for sipping.

name: MONIN SIROP DE CARAMEL LIGHT
description: MONIN Caramel Sugar Free is made with sucralose which is a no-calorie sweetener. Sucralose is derived directly from sugar: it offers a sweet sensation without the usual metallic after taste that you experience with other sweeteners.

name: CASA DRAGONES BLANCO
description: Small batch, 100% Blue Agave silver tequila, crafted to deliver the true essence of agave through an innovative process that focuses on purity, for a crisp, smooth taste that is perfect to enjoy on the rocks or in signature craft cocktails.

name: CASA DRAGONES REPOSADO MIZUNARA
description: Casa Dragones Reposado Mizunara is the first tequila rested exclusively in new Mizunara casks, a rare oak native to Japan and traditionally used for aging Japanese whiskies. This delicately rested tequila delivers subtle notes of orange blossom, apricot and coffee bean. "A tequila to celebrate the finest Mexico can offer" - The New York Times.

Long round finish, with notes of cacao, spicy black pepper. - Food & Wine Top Picks 2020

name: CASA DRAGONES JOVEN
description: Small batch, master blend of 100% Blue Agave silver and extra aged tequila, rested in new American Oak barrels, for a complex, smooth taste that is perfect for sipping and pairing with food. 96 points Best Tequila Rating by Wine Enthusiast.

ELMIR INDIA PALE ALE

description: A bright, citrusy and unoaked expression of Australian Chardonnay from Victoria The Victorian region has soils that are sandy loams deriving directly from granite and gneissic bedrocks This Chardonnay clone has a distinctive tangerine peel character Bright sunny days and cool nights allowed for exceptional flavour development Picked at night to ensure the cooler climate gives exceptional character to the whole terroir from the area and delivering a well rounded Chardonnay suitable for all occasions

description: Chalong Bay Lunar Series Antipodes is a limited-edition, high-proof Thai rum (62.1% ABV) made from pure sugarcane juice and aged 20 months in ex-bourbon barrels in France. Bold and aromatic, it delivers fresh cane, citrus, spices, and a long, honeyed finish. Perfect for collectors and lovers of powerful Agricole-style rums.

name: GLENBEY WHISKEY 70 CL
description: From the glens of Scotland to the shores of Lebanon, Glenbey is the first ever Premium Scottish whisky to have a Lebanese Signature. The first whisky born in Scotland, bottled in Lebanon. The best of both worlds, Blend of grain and malt High grade ingredients, Scottish knowhow and Lebanese production.

name: NINO SIN AMOR ENSAMBLE
description: Carefully produced from an exclusive selection of 8-15 year old ANGUSTIFOLIA AND POTATORUM agaves. This mezcal captures the essence of the Mexican countryside in every sip.

name: TALISKER 10YO
description: A classic Island dram from the Isle of Skye. Aged for a minimum of 10 years in American oak casks, this welcome member of Diageo's Classic Malts series has been recognized numerous times for its excellence.

name: VINTAGE 1983 EARLY LANDED GRANDE CHAMPAGNE WOOD. BOX
description: A very rare 1987 vintage cognac from top producer Hine, aged initially Jarnac and then shipped to England to be further matured and released as an 'Early Landed' Cognac

name: BERONIA VERDEJO RUEDA 2024 WHITE
description: A wine produced from two different harvests in the same vineyard- Following careful selection, the Verdejo grapes were picked in two rounds, with an earlier crop and a later crop vinified separately.

name: MICHEL COUVREUR OVERAGED MALT WHISKY 52%
description: Crafted from meticulously selected old malts and bottled at natural strength, this cask-strength edition offers a powerful yet harmonious profile. Rich aromas of dark chocolate, walnut, and dried figs unfold into a long, warm finish that highlights Michel Couvreur’s mastery of sherry cask maturation.

name: MICHEL COUVREUR OVERAGED MALT WHISKY 43%
description: A refined marriage of mature single malts aged for over twelve years in sherry casks deep within Burgundy cellars. Elegant and smooth, it reveals notes of dried fruits, nuts, and soft oak, delivering a timeless, well-balanced whisky with remarkable depth and finesse.

name: COMPASS BOX NECTAROSITY
description: The Compass Box Nectarosity is a blended Scotch whisky (46% ABV) crafted from select malt and grain whiskies aged in first-fill bourbon and virgin American oak casks. Rich and smooth, it offers layers of honey, lychee, apricot, pineapple, toffee, and vanilla, with a sweet, lingering finish reminiscent of cinnamon buns. Non-chill-filtered and naturally coloured, Nectarosity highlights Compass Box’s signature balance of fruit-forward elegance and oak-driven indulgence.

name: COMPASS BOX FLAMING HEART 25TH ANNIVERSARY
description: The Compass Box Flaming Heart 25th Anniversary Edition is a limited blended malt Scotch (48.9% ABV) celebrating 25 years of Compass Box’s innovative blending. Made from select peated whiskies including Laphroaig, Talisker, and Benrinnes, and matured in custom French oak casks, it delivers a bold harmony of smoky richness and lively spice. Expect aromas of maritime peat and fruit, a palate of clove, pepper, and dried apricot, and a long, smoky finish. With only 9,384 bottles released worldwide, it’s a collectible expression that perfectly embodies Compass Box’s artistry and passion for whisky craftsmanship.

name: MURRAY McDAVID - ALLT A BHAINNE 15 YO

description: Excessive is a refined sparkling rosé that reinvents the art of celebration. This alcohol-free drink combines the pleasure of fine bubbles with a new vision of conviviality – that of limitless festivities. It was born from the lyrics of a song by Carla Bruni , whose spirit has infused the very heart of this vintage!

MONIN SIROP AMARETTO
description: MONIN Amaretto syrup is based on the classic Italian sweet, almond-flavored liqueur. Characterized by the distinctive flavor of the 'mandoria-amara' or bitter almond, the name Amaretto means 'a littlebitter' in Italian.

name: MONIN SIROP DE CREME BRULEE
description: MONIN Crème Brûlée syrup combines burnt caramel notes with a strong vanilla base for perfect coffee based recipes and enticing cocktails' just try it and make it great.

name: MONIN SIROP DE CHAI TEA
description: Masala Chai - or Chai, for short, means spiced tea. Chai has been enjoyed in India for centuries; although, it is prepared differently and several regional variations exist. The ingredients of a Chai beverage generally include tea, heavy milk, several spices and a sweetener.

name: MONIN SIROP CERISE
description: MONIN Blueberry syrup captures the taste and aroma of the wild mountains to make fragrant fruity cocktails, smoothies and dessert drinks.

name: MONIN SIROP DE MURES (BLACKBERRY)
description: MONIN Blackberry syrup delivers vibrant colour and authentic flavour to iced teas, lemonades, cocktails, sodas and smoothies.

name: MONIN SIROP DE LAVENDRE
description: Delicious as a fragrant martini, refreshing iced-tea or mixed with a honey accent, MONIN Lavender adds a surprising floral twist to many drinks.

name: MONIN SIROP DE GINGEMBRE
description: MONIN Ginger syrup embodies the wonderful warming combination of fragrant sweetness and biting spice.

name: MONIN SIROP DE FRAMBOISE
description: A fragile, soft fruit that doesn't travel well, the exquisite red berry flavor of raspberry is always accessible with MONIN Raspberry syrup.

name: MONIN SIROP DE POP CORN
description: MONIN Popcorn syrup will add a roasted popcorn flavor with a hint of nuttiness in any coffee beverages and help craft unexpected classic cocktails suchas colada or martinis.

name: MONIN SIROP DE MYRTILLE (BLUEBERRY)
description: Create romantic ruby red cocktails or elegant, exotic teas with the floral and red fruit flavours of MONIN Hibiscus syrup.

name: MONIN SIROP DE SPECULOOS
description: MONIN Speculoos syrup has the perfect biscuit taste that will add a sweet and gourmet touch to your cocktails, coffees and favorite pastries.

name: MONIN SIROP DE SANGRIA MIX
description: MONIN Sangria includes the traditional flavors of red sangria, simply add wine, orange juice and ice. The fruit medley, cinnamon spiced flavor will also add a wonderful rich accent to non-alcoholic drinks.

name: MONIN SIROP DE ROSE
description: Create your own romance with MONIN Rose and dream-up exquisite cocktails, delicately perfumed teas and aromatic milky drinks to stir the senses.

name: MONIN PUREE PASSION FRUIT
description: Nothing emulates a taste of the tropics quite like the exotic flavor of Passion Fruit. The sweet, tangy and fragrant rich fruit is basically a vacation for your taste buds and our Passion Fruit Purée will take your cocktails, lemonades, iced teasand smoothies on a trip to paradise too.

name: COMPASS BOX ORCHARD HOUSE
description: New to the Compass Box Malt Whisky Collection, Orchard House brings together some of Scotland’s famously fruity distilleries such as Linkwood and Clynelish. Designed to make a feature of distillate character over oak richness, Orchard House uses whiskies purchased by us as new make spirit, before ageing in our own specification of casks. It is the most in-house whisky we have ever made. As the label shows, there is an abundance of fresh fruit notes on show, from ripe apple to banana and wildstrawberry.

name: DASSAI 23 JUNMAI DAI GINJO
description: As the Asahi Shuzo house’s high-end vintage, this dai-ginjo sake embodies the pinnacle of elegant, refined Japanese creation. The fruit of cutting-edge technology and respect for tradition, this isone of the most famous sakes on the market.

name: DASSAI 45 JUNMAI DAI GINJO

name: DASSAI 39 JUNMAI DAI GINJO
description: Dassai 39 saké is the second highest quality of the range after Dassai 23. Sweet and mellowed, it opens to a beautiful and fresh finish.

name: DASSAI 39 JUNMAI DAI GINJO
description: DASSAI 39 JUNMAI DAI GINJO

name: PATRON REPOSADO EL ALTO 75CL
description: PATRÓN EL ALTO, the exceptionally aged tequila, is passionately crafted from the highest-quality 100% Blue Weber Agave that is cultivated in the highest parts of Jalisco, Mexico, where the sweetest agave grows. The unique blend of PATRÓN Extra Añejo, Añejo and Reposado results in a unique high-end tequila that beckons to be savored.

name: CRODINO 0% ABV - PACK OF 4
description: Crodino Spritz 0.0% is a non-alcoholic Spritz that brings the Italian spirit of aperitivo combined with an upbeat personality and a distinctively rich and bittersweet taste to enrich the non-alcoholic drinking experience. Crodino was first created in 1965, in Northern Italy, using a unique recipe of high-quality herbs, spices, woods and roots. The rich bouquet of ingredients is expertly blended and infused for up to six months to release their full aromatic potential and achieve the surprisingly rich flavour profile of Crodino.

name: FRENCH BLOOM LA CUVEE VINTAGE 2022 0% ABV
description: La Cuvée 2022 Blanc de Blancs is an exceptional vintage French Sparkling wine with 0.0% alcohol, revealing a great complexity and character when tasted, like a fine wine full of singularity. Its paradox lies in the complexity of its aromas and flavors, reminiscent of a great, mature sparkling wine in its peak maturity, even though it is a relatively young alcohol-free wine.

name: FRENCH BLOOM LE ROSE 0% ABV
description: With a well-balanced complexity, the Rosé oscillates between minerality and freshness to reveal at its heart a true floral bouquet with vibrant notes. A majestic burst of rose petals meets the acidity of freshly picked red fruit, combined with notes of dry white peach. French Bloom's signature French Chardonnay wine accents with a touch of Pinot-Noir are enhanced by these bright, sparkling aromas.

name: FRENCH BLOOM LE BLANC 0% ABV
description: French Bloom Le Blanc Alcohol Free is a non-alcoholic sparkling wine from France. Produced from organically farmed grapes, this alternative apéritif is produced from French sparkling Gensac spring water, fermented grape juice and lemon juice. Similar to a sparkling white wine, Le Blanc offers mineral freshness with tropical notes, granny smith apple, citrus fruits and white flowers.

name: FRENCH BLOOM L'EXTRA BRUT BLANC DE BLANC 0% ABV
description: L'Extra Brut is a precise, alcohol-free sparkling wine that sets the standard for alcohol-free enjoyment. Made from 100% organic Chardonnay, this 0.0% alcohol, sulfite- and sugar-free Blanc de Blancs seduces with its complexity, beautiful acidity, and vibrant minerality. L'Extra Brut draws its character from the unique terroir of Limoux, in Languedoc, a region where the oceanic climate and limestone-rich soils shape exceptional wines.

name: FRENCH BLOOM LE ROSE 0% ABV
description: With a well-balanced complexity, the Rosé oscillates between minerality and freshness to reveal at its heart a true floral bouquet with vibrant notes. A majestic burst of rose petals meets the acidity of freshly picked red fruit, combined with notes of dry white peach. French Bloom's signature French Chardonnay wine accents with a touch of Pinot-Noir are enhanced by these bright, sparkling aromas.

name: FRENCH BLOOM LE BLANC 0% ABV
description: French Bloom Le Blanc Alcohol Free is a non-alcoholic sparkling wine from France. Produced from organically farmed grapes, this alternative apéritif is produced from French sparkling Gensac spring water, fermented grape juice and lemon juice. Similar to a sparkling white wine, Le Blanc offers mineral freshness with tropical notes, granny smith apple, citrus fruits and white flowers.

name: LA ADELITA REPOSADO
description: Crafted with 100% blue agave, this reposado tequila boasts a smooth and complex palate. Its delicate balance of oak and agave flavors provides a nuanced drinking experience that is both satisfying and memorable. With a medium to full body, it delivers a warm, lingering finish that leaves a lasting impression.

name: LA ADELITA EXTRA ANEJO
description: La Adelita Tequila Extra Añejo is an ultra-premium tequila that showcases the true art of aging, crafted from 100% Blue Weber agave and aged for a minimum of three years in hand-selected American oak barrels. This extraordinary aging process delivers a complex, rich, and smooth tequila, ideal for sipping and savoring.

name: CELOSA TEQUILA ROSA 70CL
description: Celosa is a 100% organic, ultra-premium joven rosa tequila rested in aromatic red wine barrels sourced from Napa Valley, CA. Produced in our single-estate

name: BELLE RIVE GIN
description: Belle Rive Mediterranean Gin is a sophisticated creation born in Grasse, conceived with the artistry of perfumery to promise a burst of sunny flavors. Encased in an elegant art deco bottle designed by artist Marie Field and bottled in Cognac, Belle Rive is a French Mediterranean gin that encapsulates the essence of aromatic florals with a refreshing citrus twist.

name: GOUVERNEUR RUM 1648 XO
description: This impressive rum combines a selection of rhum agricole and molasses rums from Marie-Galante, Guadeloupe, and the Dominican Republic, blended on the island of Saint-Martin. With generous layers of poached fruit and toasted spice, it's a supreme sipper, and ought to shine in spirit-forward cocktails.

name: MAHANI MEZCAL JOVEN
description: An artisanal Joven mezcal from Oaxaca that is made exclusively with espadin agave, creating aromas of honey, aromatic herbs and soft smoke that fill the nose.

name: MACALLAN 18 YEARS DOUBLE CASK
description: The Macallan Double Cask 18 Years Old, a perfectly balanced single malt whisky matured for 18 years in both American and European sherry seasoned oak casks. Sherry seasoned American oak adds delicate vanilla to the subtle spice of European oak, delivering a whisky with a sweeter, warmer taste and character.

TAITTINGER BRUT RESERVE 37.5CL
description: Produced each year from the first pressings of Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier and Chardonnay this is the definitive cuvée of Champagne Taittinger. It is a carefully balanced blend of wines from up to twenty-five different 'crus'. It also includes a proportion of reserve wine to ensure consistency from year to year. Prior to release the Brut Reserve is aged for 3-4 years giving the wine depth whilst allowing the component parts to become fully integrated. Such a high proportion of Chardonnay is seldom found among the great Champagnes.

name: CHATEAU LAGRANGE, LES FIEFS DE LAGRANGE, 2021
LES JAMELLES, SYRAH, 2022
description: Syrah, a grape variety originating in the Rhone Valley that has become very popular internationally, thrives in the Languedoc region. This is a rich, powerful wine that combines aromas and flavors of red fruit and a touch of menthol with a refreshing finish reminiscent of forest undergrowth. Les Jamelles Syrah boasts deep color and a syrupy consistency. Its wild fruit (raspberry, redcurrant, blackcurrant) and floral (violet) aromas harmonize with flavors of spices, vanilla and cinnamon, along with a touch of mint.

name: NITO JUNMAI-DAIGINJO OMACHI 48
description: A gorgeous lily scent and a concentrated sweetness like yellow peach. Soft impression with acidity melting in the trolley sweetness

name: ROSEBLOOD WHITE 2024
description: A taut, airy wine. Roseblood conjures up the imagination and celebrates Nature through a double echo of the snake, a vibrant symbol of metamorphosis and seduction, and the rose, sweet and wild.

name: ROSEBLOOD ROSE 2024
description: Discover the 2024 vintage: vibrant, fresh and elegant. Roseblood offers an escapade in the hinterland of Provence, in the heart of the Château d’Estoublon, its gentle way of life and its exceptional know-how. Roseblood is the fruit of this radiant and generous nature and invites us to explore the Garden of Eden of Estoublon.

name: DOMAINE DES TOURELLES RED 2022
description: A wine with minimal intervention, a true expression of the Bekaa Valley, the juxtaposition of ripe dark fruit against a vibrant juicy core reflects the hot, dry days and cool nights of the valley. GRAPES: Syrah (40%), Cabernet-Sauvignon (40%), Cinsault (15%), Carignan (5%).

name: ALASIA GAVI DI GAVI DOCG 2024
description: Produced from Cortese grapes grown in the Gavi region of Southern Piemonte. The colour is clear, pale, straw yellow with a delicate scent. The palate is fresh clean and elegant. A modern Gavi, textural, concentrated and food-friendly. Accompanies appetisers and fish dishes.

name: MIRABELLO PINOT GRIGIO 2024
description: Produced from selected Pinot Grigio grapes grown in the Veneto and harvested during the first 2 weeks of September. The grapes were crushed and gently pressed and the juice allowed to settle and clarify before cool fermentation at 16 to 18C in temperature controlled stainless steel tanks. The wine was bottled young after a period of 3 to 6 months ageing on fine lees in stainless steel tanks.

name: DDT VIEILLES VIGNES CINSAULT 2022 75CL
description: Cinsault has been farmed in the Bekaa Valley since the mid-19th century before being replaced by new imported varieties. In 2014, Domaine des Tourelles decided to revive this grape by searching out very old Cinsault vines, over 50 years of age, and fermenting the wines in concrete tanks using wild yeasts and nothing else to offer the purest expression of that grape. The result is a supple wine that beautifully reflects the terroir of the Bekaa Valley, with an aging potential of several years. 100% Cinsault.

name: JOHNNIE WALKER BLACK LABEL 1L
description: To celebrate 200 years of Johnnie Walker, Johnnie Walker's Black Label has been released with a fashion-inspired, limited-edition design- A bold new bottle created for one of the most iconic whiskies around – Johnnie Walker Black Label- Johnnie Walker Black Label is a rich, smooth Scotch whisky made using an only single malt and grain whiskies that have each spent 12 years in a cask growing into a vibrant body of flavour- The result is deep layers of sweet fruit, spice and vanilla – all wrapped in a cloak of smoke- Official Tasting Notes

LOS SIETE MISTERIOS PECHUGA
description: A rich, full-bodied Pechuga from Los Siete Misterios that is made in small batches in Santiago Matatlan. This Pechuga is triple distilled, but before the third distillation a blend of fruit and spices is added to the still and a raw chicken breast is suspended in the still. This process adds layers of rich, fruity flavours and aromatic, herbal smoke.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS ARROQUENO
description: Los Siete Misterios Arroqueno is an icon of Los Siete Misterios, and over time has become a favourite amongst agave enthusiasts. Agave Arroqueno is one of the oldest and largest agaves available, that can take between 12 and 25 years to grow.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS COYOTE
description: Siete Misterios Coyote is a mezcal made from Agave Americana L. The result is a fruity and sweet mezcal with a long finish

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS MEXICANO
description: Siete Misterios Mexicano is made with 100% agave Mexicano, which is very rare in the region surrounding Sola de Vega, Oaxaca. For this reason, this mezcal is the most rare of all the current Siete Misterios releases. In the first five years of production, they’ve only released a total of just less than 1,000 bottles. So if you see this mezcal, make sure you try it. Like other Siete Misterios mezcal, this is milled by hand and distilled in a clay pot still.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS ESPADIN
description: Siete Misterios Espadin was the first mezcal expression that Siete Misterios released. While on a trip into the Sierra, they visited the small community of Sola de Vega. The mezcal they tasted there was all hand milled and clay pot distilled, which they noted as giving the mezcal sweeter and spicier features compared to mezcal made in other regions. After tasting this mezcal, they knew that it was the one they needed to release. At about 50% ABV, this mezcal is smooth, and it is always distilled to proof.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS ENSAMBLE ESPADIN CUISHE
description: A full-bodied, herbal mezcal from Los Siete Misterios that is made with a blend of Espadin and Cuishe agave, creating notes of dewy garden herbs, burnt grass, barbecued pineapple, roasted agave and charred orange peel throughout the palate.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS TOBALA
description: Tobala mezcal pays homage to the sacred traditions of the village of Sola de Vega, in the Oaxaca region. The highest quality Tobala agave is roasted and distilled in a clay still. Considered the 'king of agaves' among wild agaves, Tobala is renowned for its complexity and balance. This expression presents notes of tropical fruit, herbs, piloncillo (panela) and damp earth.

name: LOS SIETE MISTERIOS DOBA-YEJ
description: Released by Siete Misterios, this Mezcal is elaborated exclusively from agave Espadin. First expression from the range to be made in a copper still rather than the clay pot still, Doba Yej can either come from Santiago Matatlan or San Luis del Rio, as each batch is created by a different mezcalero. Fruity, floral and sweet, with prominent citrus notes.

name: CARLSBERG BEER 33 cl
description: Carlsberg Pilsner, is inspired by the beer of the same name first created by Carlsberg in Denmark in 1904. It is a lager beer characterized by medium intensity hopping which enhances the herbaceous and resinous aromas coming from the expertly selected varieties of hops used. An extremely balanced sip in which the bitter note is balanced by the sweetness of barley malt, giving this special beer characteristic hints of cereals and a particular golden colour.

name: EL TEQUILEÑO REPOSADO RARE 75CL
description: This beguiling rare reposado from El Tequileño is made from 100% blue agave grown in the highlands of Jalisco. Fermented with natural yeast, and influenced by the 150-year-old mango trees that grow nearby, it’s distilled in copper pot stills and cut with volcanic spring water from El Volcan de Tequila. It’s aged in ginormous 25,000l American oak barrels, known as a Pipón, for six years, resulting in a unique and complex Tequila.

name: EL TEQUILEÑO AÑEJO GRAN RESERVA 75CL
description: A beautifully aged Tequila from El Tequileño, made from a blend of its finest añejo (aged 1-3 years) and extra añejo (aged for at least 3 years) Tequilas. All are made from 100% blue agave from the highlands of Jalisco, distilled in copper pot stills and cut to bottle strength with volcanic mineral water from El Volcan de Tequila, before being aged in American and French oak. A Tequila with great complexity and depth. Enjoy neat.

name: SCARABUS ISLAY SINGLE MALT 30 YO 70CL
description: A mysterious Islay single malt aged for an impressive three decades, Scarabus 30 Year Old is a dream dram for fans of well-matured peated whisky. Bottled by Hunter Laing & Co. from an undisclosed Islay distillery, this rare release is presented without chill-filtration or added colour at 42.6% ABV, ensuring every drop remains as nature intended.

name: ARDNAHOE BHOLSA 70CL
description: An exciting opportunity to check out the single malt from Islay's Ardnahoe distillery following its inaugural release in 2024. Bholsa is matured predominantly in oloroso sherry casks and bottled without added colour or chill filtration at a generous 50% ABV for a splendid profile of rich dried fruits, juicy stone fruits, and balanced peppery peat.

name: ARDNAHOE INFINITE LOCH 70CL
description: The first core release from Islay's Ardnahoe Distillery, Infinite Loch was matured in a combination of bourbon and oloroso sherry casks. This single malt Scotch whisky was bottled at the distillery's preferred strength of 50% ABV, without artificial colouring or chill-filtration. The name was inspired by Loch Ardnahoe, located a stone’s throw from the distillery, who claim it's known on Islay as the ‘Infinite Loch’ because no one knows the extent of its ‘hidden depths’.

name: MONIN VANILLE SYRUP

When it’s time to charge, just leave the case on your iPhone and snap on your MagSafe charger, or set it on your Qi2.2- or Qi-certified charger. name: Dyson V12 Detect Slim Submarine Vacuum Cleaner
description: Dyson V12S Detect Slim Submarine™ Complete Gold SV46 Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine™ Complete Gold “V12? Didn’t they release a different ‘V’ earlier this year?” Yes, Dyson last released the Dyson v15 detect absolute back in January 2023, which has a much more powerful suction power of 240AW and a bigger bin size at 0.54L—versus the Dyson V12 Detect Slim’s 150AW of suction power and 0.35L. So, the Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine is an improved version of 2021’s dyson v12 detect Absolute with the added superpower of being a wet vacuum too. Don’t get me wrong, the 150AW of suction power is more than enough to do the trick of deep cleaning your home. Compared to the Dyson V15 Detect Absolute, it’s also lighter at 2.2kg (minus the wet roller head, which I’ll get into later) versus the former’s 3.08kg. The run time remains the same at up to 60 minutes on Eco mode. It’s also fitted with the same Dyson Hyperdymium motor that spins at up to 125,000rpm. WHAT’S DIFFERENT? Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine™ Complete Gold Besides the obvious Dyson Submarine wet roller head, Dyson V12s Detect Slim Submarine comes with the familiar Optic Fluffy Cleaner Head, except it has kicked up its laser illuminating abilities to twice its power, making it even easier to spot the faintest of dust particles. In addition, with the HEPA filtration system, it can capture 99.99 per cent of particles as small as 0.1 microns (previously only up to 0.3 microns) and expel cleaner air in return. And if seeing is believing, the piezo sensor (also more casually known as ‘Acoustic Dust Sensing’) will share all that proof in real-time via the LCD screen, detailing the size and number of particles. The sensor, like before, will also automatically adjust the suction power according to the floor type and dust amounts. Side note: The wand is also slightly longer than its predecessor. description: A highly durable gravel tyre for training on roads and trails.32mm width for added comfort. How to measure tyre wear To measure the wear on your road tyres and to know when they need replacing, you need to inspect the tread. Signs of wear include: - tread starting to fray - the appearance of a series of micro cracks - low tread depth - the carcass becomes visible. In all these cases the tyre is worn and needs replacing. How to remove a tyre To remove your tyre, deflate the inner tube until no more air comes out. Then separate the tyre from the rim with a tyre lever. How to fit a tyre To put the tyre back on, insert one side of the tyre into the rim. Next, inflate your inner tube to approximately 30% before putting it into the tyre (inflating it beforehand reduces the risk of pinching the inner tube). Then, insert the other side of the tyre into the rim, starting on the side opposite the valve. Before inflating the inner tube all the way, check to make sure it isn't pinched between the tyre and the rim. How to inflate your tyre correctly Inflate the tyre with caution. The recommended pressure is indicated on the tyre's sidewall and its product sheet (available online). Before each outing, make sure that your tyres are at the correct pressure for your ride. The professional's advice During inflation, it is important to obtain the right pressure depending on the terrain and especially depending on the weather. If you ride in rainy weather, feel free to lower the tire pressure to increase its grip. When riding in dry weather, you can increase the pressure for better performance. Provides the best balance between good traction on trails, a comfortable ride (32mm wide), and high performance on paved roads. Is also very long lasting. Compatibility For 700x25 to 700x32 inner tubes and 700 (28") wheels. Grip Provides excellent grip on trails (gravel) and road. The JIS L 1099 B1 test measures the water vapour that passes through the fabric in 24h, in grams per sqm. The higher this value is, the more breathable the fabric. description: Designed for young adventurers, this waterproof Quechua jacket offers reliable protection against bad weather. How is the water resistance of the MH500 children's jacket measured? The resistance of a fabric is measured by the height of a water column in mm that can be supported by the fabric (test based on the JIS 1092 standard).The higher the water pressure, the more waterproof the fabric. This WTP jacket can withstand a pressure of 5,000mm of water (equivalent to a rain shower of 1h). To approve this, the MH500 WTP rain jacket was placed for 1h in a shower with a volume of 60L of water/sqm/h. This test reproduces the average conditions of a rain shower in the mountains. Colour retention test: the colour fastness is verified to ensure that the colours do not bleed when coming into contact with saliva. Ageing test: repeated washing should not affect the fabric's properties, behaviour, thickness or appearance. How breathable is the MH500 waterproof jacket? Component breathability is measured by its thermal evaporative resistance (RET). This is its capacity to let water vapour generated by the body during physical activity escape and therefore avoid water accumulating on the skin. The lower the RET, the more breathable the fabric.
